patterns.summary: Repartitioning Ray Data caused massive local disk spill leading to exhaustion.
patterns.action: Attach a larger dedicated NVMe SSD for spilling.

patterns.summary: Gradient clipping calculated a NaN norm due to exploding gradients in embedding_layer on V100_32GB (FP32).
patterns.action: Investigate the source of NaN gradients in the backward pass and verify loss scaling.

patterns.summary: Gradient clipping calculated a NaN norm due to exploding gradients in attention_qkv on V100_32GB (FP32).
patterns.action: Investigate the source of NaN gradients in the backward pass and verify loss scaling.

patterns.summary: Gradient clipping calculated a NaN norm due to exploding gradients in attention_proj on V100_32GB (FP32).
patterns.action: Investigate the source of NaN gradients in the backward pass and verify loss scaling.

patterns.summary: Gradient clipping calculated a NaN norm due to exploding gradients in mlp_dense_1 on V100_32GB (FP32).
patterns.action: Investigate the source of NaN gradients in the backward pass and verify loss scaling.

patterns.summary: Gradient clipping calculated a NaN norm due to exploding gradients in mlp_dense_2 on V100_32GB (FP32).
patterns.action: Investigate the source of NaN gradients in the backward pass and verify loss scaling.

patterns.summary: Gradient clipping calculated a NaN norm due to exploding gradients in layer_norm_1 on V100_32GB (FP32).
patterns.action: Investigate the source of NaN gradients in the backward pass and verify loss scaling.

patterns.summary: Gradient clipping calculated a NaN norm due to exploding gradients in layer_norm_2 on V100_32GB (FP32).
patterns.action: Investigate the source of NaN gradients in the backward pass and verify loss scaling.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Tensors must have the same shape.*in.*AllGather.*tensor_model_parallel.*
patterns.summary: Mismatched tensor shapes between TP ranks during vocabulary or embedding AllGather. Ranks have inconsistent vocab sizes or input sequences.
patterns.action: Ensure the model configuration '--make-vocab-size-divisible-by' is set correctly and the vocabulary size is synchronized across all ranks.

patterns.summary: Mismatched vocab label targets across parallel vocabulary ranks during VocabParallelCrossEntropy computation.
patterns.action: Ensure label tensors are correctly duplicated / broadcasted across all TP ranks in the data parallel group before calling cross entropy.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*during ColumnParallelLinear forward.*
patterns.summary: CUDA Out of Memory during ColumnParallelLinear forward pass. Memory exceeded during projection of hidden states to the 4h dimension.
patterns.action: Decrease the micro-batch size, enable activation recomputation, or increase the TP size to shard layer weights further.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*during RowParallelLinear forward.*
patterns.summary: CUDA Out of Memory during RowParallelLinear forward pass. Memory exceeded when allocating output buffers or gathering activations.
patterns.action: Decrease sequence length or micro-batch size, or use sequence parallelism to shard activation memory across TP ranks.

patterns.summary: Dtype mismatch in pipeline send/recv (e.g. Stage N sends FP16, Stage N+1 expects BF16 due to inconsistent model casting).
patterns.action: Ensure all pipeline stages run with the identical precision setting (either --fp16 or --bf16 flag uniformly set).

patterns.re: NCCL error in:.*p2p\.cc:.*peer.*failed to respond.*PP stage.*
patterns.summary: Point-to-point NCCL communication failure between adjacent pipeline ranks. Indicates network routing error or network card failure.
patterns.action: Verify inter-node network routing, check for packet drops on the high-speed interface, or restart the network switch port.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Pipeline stage communicator initialization timed out.*
patterns.summary: Pipeline stage communicator initialization timed out. Usually due to nodes failing to contact the master rendezvous point.
patterns.action: Check MASTER_ADDR and MASTER_PORT. Ensure they are reachable from all nodes on the high-speed network interfaces.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Out of memory.*pipeline communication buffer.*
patterns.summary: Allocation failure of the pipeline communication buffer. High hidden sizes lead to huge send/recv buffer footprints on boundary ranks.
patterns.action: Reduce hidden size or model sequence length, or set --no-persist-layer-norm to reclaim GPU memory.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*1F1B warmup.*activations.*
patterns.summary: OOM during the warmup phase of 1F1B where activations build up before backward starts. Often happens in early pipeline stages (e.g. stage 0).
patterns.action: Use activation checkpointing specifically for early pipeline stages, or reduce the global batch size.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: shape.*is invalid for input of size.*inside MoE AllToAll collective.*
patterns.summary: Mismatched token counts causing AllToAll hang in Expert Parallelism (EP). Ranks routed uneven token numbers without padding.
patterns.action: Enable '--moe-token-dropping' to enforce expert capacity, or implement variable-length AllToAll communication (AllToAllv).

patterns.re: NCCL WARN.*InfiniBand memory registration failure.*3D parallel.*
patterns.summary: InfiniBand memory registration failure under deep 3D parallel model sizing. System locked memory limits are exceeded.
patterns.action: Increase locked memory limits (ulimit -l unlimited) on all compute nodes in the cluster.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Error in split operations on world communicator.*3D topologies.*
patterns.summary: Error in split operations on world communicator for custom hybrid topologies. Ranks attempted to split communicator with duplicate colors.
patterns.action: Verify rank assignment colors in initialize_model_parallel() and ensure TP, PP, and DP color mappings are unique.

patterns.re: AssertionError: Mismatched slice sizes in ZeRO optimizer state partitioning.*
patterns.summary: Mismatched slice sizes in ZeRO optimizer state partitioning across DP/TP, indicating parameters are not divisible by DP/TP world size.
patterns.action: Ensure layer parameters are padded to be a clean multiple of the DP size * TP size.

patterns.summary: Receiver Not Ready (RNR) retry limit exceeded.
patterns.action: Increase RNR retry count in NCCL IB config.

patterns.summary: CUDA unspecified launch failure dropping NCCL context.
patterns.action: Check dmesg for Xid errors and reduce clock speeds.

patterns.summary: CUDA context destroyed unexpectedly before NCCL abort.
patterns.action: Check for OOM killer or segfault in user code.

patterns.summary: NVLink peer became unreachable during ring setup.
patterns.action: Reset NVLink state via nvidia-smi.

patterns.summary: Connection refused on NCCL listen port.
patterns.action: Ensure all ranks are launched simultaneously.

patterns.summary: Socket read zero bytes (EOF) prematurely.
patterns.action: Peer process likely segfaulted or was killed.

patterns.summary: Host OOM killer terminated NCCL proxy thread.
patterns.action: Add swap or reduce host memory usage.

patterns.summary: Mmap failed for CUDA IPC shared memory.
patterns.action: Ensure node has enough contiguous virtual memory.

patterns.summary: NCCL topology discovery failed for SP group.
patterns.action: Provide explicit NCCL_TOPO_FILE.

patterns.summary: Deadlock due to asymmetric collective calls.
patterns.action: Ensure all SP ranks execute the same communication blocks.

patterns.summary: Missing NCCL plugin (e.g. AWS OFI).
patterns.action: Install required network plugin and set LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

patterns.summary: The cuBLAS runtime-JIT SM90 split-K GEMM kernel in the torch nightly toolchain has a regression.
patterns.action: Pin the toolchain to the stable channel where the cuBLAS kernel does not fault.

patterns.summary: The Pallas interpret=True emulation path drops intermediate block writes when the grid tiling splits the last dimension into three or more blocks.
patterns.action: Disable interpret mode and run on TPU hardware, or adjust block_shape so tiling does not produce middle blocks.

patterns.re: ['"]ttg\.convert_layout['"] op does not have expected attribute ttg\.partition
patterns.summary: The Triton warp-specialization compiler pass fails to attach ttg.partition to a ttg.convert_layout op.
patterns.action: Disable warp_specialize hint to bypass the compiler pass.

patterns.summary: The virtualized GPU peer-to-peer aperture resolves the peer window to a private mirror local to the writer, so NCCL P2P mapping fails in passthrough.
patterns.action: Disable NCCL P2P (NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1) to route through shared memory, or fix the hypervisor VFIO clique.

patterns.re: contact table entry for rank \d+ advertises tcp4:\/\/
patterns.summary: The PRTE/PMIx out-of-band routing layer publishes an IPv4 contact address while nodes only have IPv6 configured.
patterns.action: Disable PRTE IPv4 out-of-band routing (oob_tcp_disable_ipv4=1) to force IPv6 for bootstrap.

patterns.re: Allocation was freed on stream 0x[0-9a-f]+ while stream 0x[0-9a-f]+ was still executing
patterns.summary: megatron-fsdp StorageResizeBasedBucketAllocator.free returns all-gather bucket to caching allocator without recording the compute stream.
patterns.action: Set overlap_param_gather=False to serialize stream execution and avoid the allocator race.

patterns.summary: Ray serve autoscaler v2 termination path fails to dedup duplicate instance ids, decrementing count below zero.
patterns.action: Patch the autoscaler to dedup instance IDs before terminate, or upgrade to a Ray version with the fix.

requiredEvidence.re: the same instance id appears twice in the termination batch

patterns.summary: The bundled NFD worker toleration matches taint value present but the cluster uses true, preventing scheduling and feature discovery labels.
patterns.action: Override the NFD worker toleration in helm values to match the cluster taint value true, or remove the taint.

requiredEvidence.re: nvidia-smi on the node reports \d+ healthy GPUs

patterns.summary: A TPU ICI link at the reported mesh coordinate is down, so the accelerator slice cannot provide the topology expected by the distributed program. This is a slice or platform health fault, not an XLA graph error.
patterns.action:
NOW: stop the run, preserve the failing mesh coordinate and worker identity, and request a fresh healthy slice rather than repeatedly restarting on the same allocation.
INVESTIGATE: verify every worker received the same topology and correlate platform maintenance or preemption events. Reproduce with the provider ICI health control if exposed.
PREVENT: gate multi-host jobs on slice health, record topology with every run, and retry allocation only through bounded infrastructure policy.
ESCALATE: if the link-down coordinate recurs on fresh allocation, provide timestamps, project, zone, slice topology, runtime version, and worker logs to the TPU service owner.
patterns.resumeFrom: latest checkpoint on a healthy TPU slice

patterns.summary: nvidia-peermem could not create another peer-direct mapping because the GPU BAR1 aperture has no usable space for it. Stale peer mappings, an undersized BAR1 window, or an unsupported platform layout can produce the same rejection.
patterns.action:
NOW: stop the affected job, confirm no stale RDMA or CUDA processes retain the GPU, and inspect BAR1 usage with nvidia-smi -q before retrying.
INVESTIGATE: compare the configured BAR1 size and current usage on a failing node with a healthy peer. Confirm Resizable BAR and Above 4G Decoding are enabled where the platform requires them.
PREVENT: validate BAR1 capacity and a peer-memory transfer during node admission, and drain nodes whose mappings are not released after jobs exit.
ESCALATE: if a clean node with free BAR1 space rejects the mapping, collect dmesg, lspci -vv, nvidia-smi -q, driver versions, and HCA topology for the platform vendor.
patterns.resumeFrom: job start after a clean peer-memory mapping succeeds

patterns.re: NCCL WARN Bootstrap[^\n]{0,140}Connection reset by peer
patterns.summary: An NCCL bootstrap TCP connection was accepted and then reset by a peer before communicator setup completed. The resetting rank may have exited, selected a different interface, or lost network reachability during initialization.
patterns.action:
NOW: identify the peer address in NCCL_DEBUG=INFO output and inspect that peer rank first. A process exit on the remote rank is more common than a local socket defect.
INVESTIGATE: compare NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME, address family, world size, and rendezvous values on every node. Test the selected interface and port in both directions.
PREVENT: render one shared launcher configuration for all ranks and run a multi-node nccl-tests bootstrap check before large jobs.
ESCALATE: if every rank stays alive and the point-to-point socket control still resets, collect firewall, conntrack, and switch telemetry for the exact five-tuple.
patterns.resumeFrom: job start after all ranks complete bootstrap

patterns.re: NCCL WARN Ring via NET\/Socket[^\n]{0,100}Connection refused
patterns.summary: An NCCL ring peer attempted a TCP connection before the expected listener was reachable. The destination rank may have crashed, advertised the wrong interface, or been blocked by host or network policy.
patterns.action:
NOW: find the destination host and port in NCCL_DEBUG=INFO output, then verify the destination rank is alive and listening.
INVESTIGATE: compare hostname resolution and NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME across nodes, then test the advertised address from the source node. Check container network namespaces and firewall rules.
PREVENT: pin the intended fabric interface, keep rank address resolution consistent, and run a two-node nccl-tests control after network changes.
ESCALATE: if the listener is present but the connection is still refused, preserve socket, firewall, and orchestrator events from both endpoints.
patterns.resumeFrom: job start after every ring peer is reachable

patterns.summary: The operating system or container memory limit killed the Raylet, which made the cluster unavailable. This is node memory exhaustion, not an object-store eviction or a recoverable worker-only failure.
patterns.action:
NOW: inspect the node kernel or container events for the Raylet OOM kill and preserve its peak resident memory before restarting the node service.
INVESTIGATE: separate Raylet heap, object store, and worker memory. Check cgroup memory.current and memory.events against the configured node limit.
PREVENT: leave headroom for Ray system processes, set realistic worker memory resources, and alert on node RSS and cgroup pressure before the hard limit.
ESCALATE: if Raylet memory grows while workload pressure is flat, capture Ray state and a heap profile to investigate a control-plane leak.
patterns.resumeFrom: job retry after the Raylet is healthy and node memory is bounded

patterns.summary: SGLang failed to acquire a radix-cache page lock while dynamic prefix eviction was mutating the cache. Extreme token pressure can expose the race, but repeated failure at moderate pressure indicates a cache implementation or version defect.
patterns.action:
NOW: lower running-request concurrency and disable or limit prefix caching for a confirmation run. Preserve the server stack trace before restarting.
INVESTIGATE: correlate the failure with token usage, eviction rate, and the exact SGLang and kernel versions. A clean run below the eviction threshold separates capacity pressure from an unconditional lock defect.
PREVENT: pin a tested SGLang stack and load-test cache eviction at the intended context and concurrency before rollout.
ESCALATE: if the lock failure reproduces below high-water pressure, provide the minimal request sequence and full stack to SGLang maintainers.
patterns.resumeFrom: request retry after the cache service is restarted with bounded pressure

patterns.re: DistCheckpointError[^\n]{0,100}Async checkpoint saving failed[^\n]{0,100}(write timeout|background thread)
patterns.summary: A background distributed-checkpoint writer missed its storage deadline. The job may continue computing while a rank is blocked on storage, but that checkpoint must not be treated as complete or recoverable.
patterns.action:
NOW: mark the timed-out checkpoint invalid and inspect every rank for the first write failure. Do not update the latest-checkpoint pointer.
INVESTIGATE: compare per-rank shard size, write duration, filesystem latency, and free capacity. Confirm all ranks used the same checkpoint ID and storage path.
PREVENT: publish completion only after every rank and metadata writer succeeds, retain the previous checkpoint, and alert on save latency before the timeout.
ESCALATE: if a small checkpoint times out on one node or prefix, preserve storage client metrics and server-side request IDs for the storage owner.
patterns.resumeFrom: previous verified checkpoint, never the timed-out save

patterns.re: flash_attn_func[^\n]{0,100}all NaN[^\n]{0,100}(scale factor reciprocal overflowed|FP8 E4M3)
patterns.summary: The FP8 attention scale or its reciprocal left the representable E4M3 range, so the kernel produced non-finite output. This is a scale-calibration failure before it is a general training-divergence failure.
patterns.action:
NOW: reject the non-finite step, restore the last finite checkpoint, and run the batch in BF16 while recording the FP8 amax and scale values.
INVESTIGATE: locate the first zero, infinite, or stale scale and verify the delayed-scaling history and update interval. Compare the same tensors with BF16 attention.
PREVENT: clamp scale reciprocals to a safe finite range, alert on amax and scale saturation, and validate FP8 recipes per model and GPU generation.
ESCALATE: if valid finite scales still produce NaNs only in flash_attn_func, preserve tensors, shapes, recipe, device capability, and versions for the kernel owner.
patterns.resumeFrom: last checkpoint before the first FP8 non-finite result

patterns.summary: The kubelet reclaimed memory on the node and killed the pod hosting one rank. The collective timeout on the other ranks is the EFFECT: they are blocked in a collective the dead rank can never join. The network is not implicated.
patterns.action:
Find the evicted pod and the node it sat on, then fix the memory ceiling rather than the fabric.

NOW: `kubectl get events --field-selector reason=Evicted --sort-by=.lastTimestamp` and `kubectl describe node <node>` to confirm which pod went and under what pressure.
INVESTIGATE: compare the container's memory limit against actual peak RSS. Host RAM is consumed by the DataLoader workers, pinned buffers and the checkpoint write, not only by the model.
PREVENT: set requests equal to limits for the trainer pods so they are Guaranteed QoS and are evicted last, and lower num_workers or prefetch_factor if peak RSS is genuinely at the ceiling.

patterns.re: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout: WorkNCCL.*
patterns.summary: NCCL watchdog timed out waiting for a collective to complete.
patterns.action: Check network connectivity or workload imbalance between ranks.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration before starting a new one.*
patterns.summary: A parameter was not used in the forward pass, breaking DDP reduction.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=True or ensure all parameters are used in forward.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: NCCL error in: .* unhandled system error
patterns.summary: NCCL failed to communicate over sockets.
patterns.action: Verify NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME is set correctly and ports are open.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Tensors must have the same number of elements.*AllReduce
patterns.summary: Ranks attempted to allreduce tensors of different shapes.
patterns.action: Ensure input data shapes match across all ranks or pad tensors before reduction.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Rank \d+ is calling collective \w+, but Rank \d+ is calling collective \w+.*
patterns.summary: Different ranks called different collectives, causing a deadlock.
patterns.action: Ensure all ranks execute the same communication operations in the same order.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate .* bytes. .* during DDP bucket allocation
patterns.summary: DDP gradient bucket allocation exceeded available GPU memory.
patterns.action: Reduce DDP bucket_cap_mb or batch size.

patterns.re: ValueError: Mixed precision is required but not configured correctly in FSDP.*
patterns.summary: FSDP mixed precision configuration is inconsistent across nodes.
patterns.action: Synchronize mixed precision policies across all FSDP instances.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: NCCL error in: .* unhandled cuda error
patterns.summary: DeepSpeed failed to initialize NCCL due to CUDA context errors.
patterns.action: Check GPU health, driver status, and ensure no other processes are holding the GPU.

patterns.summary: HuggingFace Accelerate failed to synchronize gradients.
patterns.action: Check if gradient_accumulation_steps is consistent across instances.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*
patterns.summary: Multiple forward passes or in-place modifications broke the DDP graph.
patterns.action: Avoid multiple forward passes on the same DDP instance without backward, or avoid in-place ops on parameters.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but found at least two devices.*
patterns.summary: A tensor was not moved to the correct GPU rank before DDP forward.
patterns.action: Ensure all inputs are moved to the local rank device before passing to the model.

patterns.summary: InfiniBand initialization failed for NCCL.
patterns.action: Check IB setup, or fallback to sockets using NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Tensor sharding failed in FSDP.*
patterns.summary: FSDP failed to shard a tensor, possibly due to unsupported shape or type.
patterns.action: Verify model parameter shapes are divisible by world size or use appropriate sharding strategy.

patterns.summary: PyTorch distributed initialization timed out.
patterns.action: Check if all nodes are reachable and master address/port are correct.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: The server socket has failed to listen on any local network address.*
patterns.summary: Master node could not bind to the specified MASTER_ADDR and MASTER_PORT.
patterns.action: Confirm MASTER_ADDR resolves to an interface that exists ON the rank-0 node itself (`ip -br addr` there, then `getent hosts $MASTER_ADDR`). errno 99 (EADDRNOTAVAIL) means the address is not local to that host, a common cause is exporting the login node's hostname to compute nodes. On SLURM derive it instead: export MASTER_ADDR=$(scontrol show hostnames "$SLURM_JOB_NODELIST" | head -n1).

patterns.summary: Failed to load sharded FSDP checkpoint.
patterns.action: Ensure world size matches or use a state dict consolidation utility before loading.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Module topology mismatch across ranks.*
patterns.summary: Different ranks have instantiated models with different architectures.
patterns.action: Ensure random seeds and conditional model initializations are deterministic across ranks.

patterns.summary: Nodes have mismatched NCCL versions.
patterns.action: Ensure PyTorch and NCCL versions are identical across the cluster.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Tensors must have the same dtype.*Broadcast
patterns.summary: Broadcast operation failed due to mismatched tensor data types.
patterns.action: Cast tensors to a common data type before broadcasting.

patterns.summary: TorchElastic worker crashed.
patterns.action: Check worker logs for the specific error causing the crash.

patterns.summary: Kubernetes killed a worker pod due to out-of-memory.
patterns.action: Increase pod memory limits or reduce RAM usage in data loaders.

patterns.summary: Kubernetes lost connection to a worker node.
patterns.action: Check cluster node health and network connectivity.

patterns.summary: Gloo backend timed out during initialization or communication.
patterns.action: Switch to NCCL for GPU communication or check network for CPU clusters.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: NCCL error in: .* invalid usage
patterns.summary: Invalid argument passed to NCCL collective.
patterns.action: Ensure tensor sizes and types are supported by NCCL.

patterns.summary: Invalid DeepSpeed ZeRO configuration.
patterns.action: Correct the DeepSpeed configuration file for the selected ZeRO stage.

patterns.summary: Kubernetes lost connection to a worker node during Checkpoint load.
patterns.action: Check cluster node health and network connectivity. (Observed in Reduce).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: The server socket has failed to listen on any local network address.* during Gather.*
patterns.summary: Master node could not bind to the specified MASTER_ADDR and MASTER_PORT during Backward pass.
patterns.action: Ensure MASTER_ADDR points to a valid interface on the rank 0 node. (Observed in Gather).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: The server socket has failed to listen on any local network address.* during AllReduce.*
patterns.summary: Master node could not bind to the specified MASTER_ADDR and MASTER_PORT during Checkpoint load.
patterns.action: Ensure MASTER_ADDR points to a valid interface on the rank 0 node. (Observed in AllReduce).

patterns.re: torchelastic.agent.server.api.LocalElasticAgent: Worker .* during Barrier.* failed with exit code .* during Barrier.*
patterns.summary: TorchElastic worker crashed during Evaluation loop.
patterns.action: Check worker logs for the specific error causing the crash. (Observed in Barrier).

patterns.re: CUDA out of memory.*allocating tensor.*during model load
patterns.summary: GPU memory exhausted while loading model weights into VRAM.
patterns.action: Increase tensor parallel size or use model quantization.

patterns.summary: System RAM exhausted while parsing safetensors into memory.
patterns.action: Increase system RAM or swap space for the vLLM container.

patterns.re: ValueError: No available memory for the cache blocks.*gpu_memory_utilization
patterns.summary: gpu_memory_utilization set too high, leaving no room for KV cache.
patterns.action: Decrease gpu_memory_utilization to 0.85 or 0.90.

patterns.summary: gpu_memory_utilization is too low, resulting in a tiny KV cache.
patterns.action: Increase gpu_memory_utilization to allocate more memory to KV cache.

patterns.summary: PyTorch memory allocator failed to reserve KV cache block tensors.
patterns.action: Ensure no other processes are consuming GPU memory.

patterns.summary: PagedAttention block allocator ran out of free GPU blocks.
patterns.action: Reduce max_num_batched_tokens or max_num_seqs.

patterns.summary: PagedAttention block allocator ran out of free CPU swap blocks.
patterns.action: Increase swap_space config in vLLM engine args.

patterns.re: RuntimeError.*swap space full.*cannot swap out request
patterns.summary: CPU swap space is full, causing request eviction to fail.
patterns.action: Increase swap_space parameter to at least 4-8GB.

patterns.summary: Python hit system memory limit during the batching loop.
patterns.action: Increase container memory limit or decrease batch size.

patterns.summary: Input sequence length exceeded the configured max_model_len.
patterns.action: Increase max_model_len or truncate input sequences.

patterns.summary: Input prompt is longer than max_num_batched_tokens.
patterns.action: Increase max_num_batched_tokens or use chunked prefill.

patterns.re: Prompt length.*exceeds total available KV cache blocks
patterns.summary: A single prompt is too large to fit in the entire KV cache.
patterns.action: Increase tensor parallel size to aggregate more KV cache memory.

patterns.summary: The requested generation length plus prompt length exceeds model context.
patterns.action: Reduce requested max_tokens or increase max_model_len.

patterns.summary: PagedAttention custom kernel crashed due to CUDA memory exhaustion.
patterns.action: Reduce block_size or gpu_memory_utilization.

patterns.summary: Sequence length exceeded the hardcoded limit in the PagedAttention kernel.
patterns.action: Ensure max_model_len is correctly configured for the kernel.

patterns.summary: Triton failed to compile an attention kernel due to host memory OOM.
patterns.action: Increase host RAM or swap space for Triton caching.

patterns.summary: FlashAttention kernel exceeded GPU shared memory limits (usually high block size).
patterns.action: Decrease KV cache block_size (e.g., to 16).

patterns.summary: FlashAttention-2 failed to allocate temporary workspace memory.
patterns.action: Lower gpu_memory_utilization to free up workspace RAM.

patterns.summary: xFormers backend ran out of memory during attention computation.
patterns.action: Switch to FlashAttention backend or reduce max_num_batched_tokens.

patterns.summary: A Ray worker process handling a tensor parallel rank was OOM killed.
patterns.action: Increase node memory limits or reduce model size.

patterns.summary: Ray cluster manager detected system memory exhaustion.
patterns.action: Provision instances with higher system RAM.

patterns.re: Ray task failed.*Object store out of memory
patterns.summary: Ray's plasma object store ran out of memory passing tensors.
patterns.action: Increase Ray object store memory configuration.

patterns.summary: Chunked prefill token limit is set too low for the block size.
patterns.action: Increase max_num_batched_tokens to at least block_size.

patterns.re: CUDA out of memory.*during chunked prefill
patterns.summary: A large prefill chunk caused a CUDA OOM spike.
patterns.action: Decrease chunk size or max_num_batched_tokens.

patterns.re: Prefix caching.*OOM storing radix tree node
patterns.summary: Prefix caching radix tree consumed all available host memory.
patterns.action: Disable prefix caching or increase host RAM.

patterns.re: Prefix caching.*failed to evict blocks.*KV cache full
patterns.summary: Prefix caching failed to evict unused blocks, stalling generation.
patterns.action: Check for bugs in vLLM prefix eviction logic or disable it.

patterns.summary: Prefix cache tried to swap blocks to CPU but swap was full.
patterns.action: Increase swap_space parameter.

patterns.summary: Concurrent LoRA requests exceeded the max_loras limit.
patterns.action: Increase max_loras in engine configuration.

patterns.re: CUDA out of memory.*loading LoRA adapter weights
patterns.summary: Loading additional LoRA adapters exhausted GPU memory.
patterns.action: Reduce max_loras, max_lora_rank, or gpu_memory_utilization.

patterns.summary: System RAM was exhausted caching LoRA adapters on CPU.
patterns.action: Increase system memory or limit the number of active LoRAs.

patterns.summary: A tensor parallel rank OOMed, causing a NCCL timeout on other ranks.
patterns.action: Check for memory imbalance across GPUs and reduce batch size.

patterns.summary: Rank 0 OOMed while broadcasting inputs to other ranks.
patterns.action: Ensure Rank 0 has enough memory overhead beyond KV cache.

patterns.summary: The final pipeline parallel stage ran out of memory.
patterns.action: Rebalance pipeline stages or reduce microbatch size.

patterns.re: Pipeline Parallel.*microbatch size too large.*CUDA out of memory
patterns.summary: Pipeline parallel microbatch size exceeded GPU memory.
patterns.action: Decrease microbatch size.

patterns.summary: Massive request preemption occurred due to memory pressure.
patterns.action: Reduce max_num_seqs to stabilize the scheduler.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine.*Runtime error: CUDA error 2.*out of memory
patterns.summary: The core vLLM engine hit a low-level CUDA OOM error.
patterns.action: Lower gpu_memory_utilization to provide more dynamic memory buffer.

patterns.summary: Failed to allocate memory pool for CUDA graphs.
patterns.action: Disable CUDA graphs with --enforce-eager or lower gpu_memory_utilization.

patterns.re: Failed to capture CUDA graph.*CUDA out of memory
patterns.summary: CUDA OOM occurred while capturing operations into a CUDA graph.
patterns.action: Reduce max_seq_len for CUDA graph capture or disable it.

patterns.re: Replaying CUDA graph.*CUDA error.*out of memory
patterns.summary: Executing a pre-compiled CUDA graph caused an OOM.
patterns.action: Check for tensor sizing mismatches or disable CUDA graphs.

patterns.summary: The uvicorn API server process was OOM killed by the OS.
patterns.action: Increase system memory limits or reduce API concurrency.

patterns.re: vLLM OpenAI API.*500 Internal Server Error.*CUDA out of memory
patterns.summary: OpenAI compatible API returned 500 due to underlying CUDA OOM.
patterns.action: Rate limit incoming requests to prevent memory spikes.

patterns.re: KV Cache.*Swapping in request failed.*no blocks available
patterns.summary: Failed to resume a preempted request because KV cache remains full.
patterns.action: Decrease max_num_seqs or increase KV cache allocation.

patterns.summary: CPU memory reserved for KV cache swapping is completely full.
patterns.action: Increase swap_space size in configuration.

patterns.summary: The request queue grew too large and consumed all Python RAM.
patterns.action: Implement a reverse proxy rate limit before vLLM.

patterns.summary: The tokenizer ran out of host memory encoding a massive input prompt.
patterns.action: Truncate prompts before sending to vLLM.

patterns.re: Speculative decoding.*Draft model.*CUDA out of memory
patterns.summary: The draft model for speculative decoding caused a GPU OOM.
patterns.action: Use a smaller draft model or lower gpu_memory_utilization.

patterns.re: Speculative decoding.*Target model OOM during verification
patterns.summary: The target model OOMed while verifying speculative tokens.
patterns.action: Reduce the number of speculative tokens.

patterns.summary: Batch processing too many speculative tokens exceeded memory.
patterns.action: Decrease num_speculative_tokens.

patterns.summary: Client disconnects caused KV cache blocks to leak and eventually OOM.
patterns.action: Upgrade vLLM to a version with proper disconnect cleanup.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine.*Deadlock due to swapped out requests
patterns.summary: Engine deadlocked trying to swap in requests with a full KV cache.
patterns.action: Decrease max_num_seqs to prevent deadlock conditions.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine.*Out of Memory during logprobs computation
patterns.summary: Computing high-dimensional logprobs for large vocabularies caused OOM.
patterns.action: Reduce the number of requested logprobs or max_num_seqs.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine.*CUDA out of memory in sample kernel
patterns.summary: The sampling kernel ran out of memory allocating random seeds/states.
patterns.action: Decrease max_num_seqs to reduce sampling state size.

patterns.summary: The final softmax layer exceeded memory for a large batch.
patterns.action: Reduce max_num_batched_tokens.

patterns.summary: Greedy decoding argmax kernel ran out of memory.
patterns.action: Lower gpu_memory_utilization to leave dynamic memory for kernels.

patterns.summary: Top-K/Top-P sampling kernels allocated too much temporary memory.
patterns.action: Reduce max_num_seqs or use greedy decoding if memory is tight.

patterns.summary: Beam search consumed too much KV cache and OOMed.
patterns.action: Reduce beam_width or max_num_seqs.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine.*beam search sequence length limit exceeded
patterns.summary: Beam search hit sequence length limits leading to memory overflow.
patterns.action: Reduce max_tokens for beam search requests.

patterns.summary: Generating multiple candidate sequences with best_of exhausted memory.
patterns.action: Reduce the best_of parameter in the request.

patterns.summary: Requesting multiple completions per prompt exhausted KV cache.
patterns.action: Reduce the n parameter in the request.

patterns.summary: PagedAttention v1 cannot handle the requested sequence length.
patterns.action: Enable PagedAttention v2 or reduce sequence length.

patterns.summary: Block size mismatch caused PagedAttention v2 to corrupt memory.
patterns.action: Ensure block_size is supported (typically 16 or 32).

patterns.summary: An unsupported model architecture caused memory leaks in vLLM.
patterns.action: Verify model is officially supported by the vLLM version.

patterns.re: Custom model.*KV cache shape mismatch OOM
patterns.summary: Model KV tensor shapes didn't match the allocated cache blocks.
patterns.action: Check model config.json for correct attention head configurations.

patterns.summary: Unpacking AWQ quantized weights during execution caused OOM.
patterns.action: Reduce batch size to compensate for unpacking overhead.

patterns.summary: GPTQ linear layer kernel ran out of memory.
patterns.action: Use Marlin kernel for GPTQ if available, or reduce batch size.

patterns.summary: SqueezeLLM quantization lookup table exceeded memory limits.
patterns.action: Lower gpu_memory_utilization to leave room for lookup tables.

patterns.summary: Marlin quantization kernel failed to allocate workspace.
patterns.action: Decrease gpu_memory_utilization to free up workspace RAM.

patterns.summary: BitsAndBytes 8bit optimizer ran out of memory (if training/tuning).
patterns.action: Reduce batch size or use 4bit quantization.

patterns.summary: Loading model in BitsAndBytes 4bit exhausted memory.
patterns.action: Check if the base model size fits in VRAM even at 4bit.

patterns.summary: PyTorch native allocator failed during vLLM initialization.
patterns.action: Set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF to manage fragmentation.

patterns.summary: CUDA Caching Allocator failed to reserve memory for KV cache.
patterns.action: Clear GPU memory before starting vLLM.

patterns.re: Unable to allocate KV cache.*try reducing gpu_memory_utilization
patterns.summary: KV cache allocation failed cleanly, prompting utilization reduction.
patterns.action: Follow the prompt and reduce gpu_memory_utilization.

patterns.summary: KV cache initialization step completely failed due to OOM.
patterns.action: Check GPU memory usage with nvidia-smi.

patterns.re: vLLM worker.*Watchdog timeout due to OOM
patterns.summary: Worker process stalled during an OOM event and hit watchdog timeout.
patterns.action: Increase watchdog timeout or fix the underlying memory leak.

patterns.summary: NCCL failed to allocate communication buffers on the GPU.
patterns.action: Set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 if NVLink is missing, or reduce memory utilization.

patterns.re: Kubernetes: Pod OOMKilled during vllm startup
patterns.summary: Kubernetes killed the vLLM pod during model loading due to RAM usage.
patterns.action: Increase the pod's memory requests and limits.

patterns.summary: Container hit its memory limit and was terminated.
patterns.action: Raise Kubernetes container memory limits.

patterns.re: Kubernetes: Node memory pressure, vllm evicted
patterns.summary: Node experienced memory pressure, evicting the vLLM pod.
patterns.action: Deploy on a node with more system RAM.

patterns.summary: Docker killed the vLLM container via SIGKILL due to OOM.
patterns.action: Increase Docker memory limits (e.g., --memory).

patterns.re: out of memory in docker daemon
patterns.summary: The Docker daemon itself ran out of memory managing the container.
patterns.action: Restart Docker daemon and increase host system swap.

patterns.re: vLLM client: Timeout due to server OOM
patterns.summary: Client connection timed out because the vLLM server crashed from OOM.
patterns.action: Implement server auto-restart and rate limiting.

patterns.summary: vLLM Prometheus metrics exporter consumed too much memory.
patterns.action: Disable metrics exporter if memory is extremely tight.

patterns.summary: Triton kernel register spilling caused compilation failure/OOM.
patterns.action: Use smaller block sizes or a different attention backend.

patterns.summary: FlashInfer backend ran out of memory.
patterns.action: Reduce max_num_seqs when using FlashInfer.

patterns.summary: FlashInfer failed to allocate its workspace memory pool.
patterns.action: Lower gpu_memory_utilization.

patterns.re: FlashInfer: KV cache layout unsupported OOM
patterns.summary: Unsupported KV cache layout in FlashInfer caused memory bloat.
patterns.action: Switch back to standard FlashAttention backend.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine: aborted request due to OOM
patterns.summary: Engine forcefully aborted a specific request to prevent global OOM.
patterns.action: Ensure clients handle request abortions gracefully.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine: ignored sequence due to OOM
patterns.summary: Engine ignored a sequence from continuous batching due to memory limits.
patterns.action: Reduce max_num_batched_tokens.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine: step\(\) takes too long due to swapping
patterns.summary: Thrashing between GPU and CPU swap caused the engine step to timeout.
patterns.action: Reduce max_num_seqs.

patterns.summary: The initial CUDA graph profiling run caused an OOM.
patterns.action: Disable CUDA graphs or lower utilization.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine: max_num_seqs exceeded available memory
patterns.summary: Configured max_num_seqs mathematically exceeds available KV blocks.
patterns.action: Lower max_num_seqs in engine config.

patterns.summary: Chunked prefill size config exceeds batched token limits.
patterns.action: Align chunk size with max batched tokens.

patterns.summary: Excessive token padding in uneven batches exhausted memory.
patterns.action: Use chunked prefill to reduce padding waste.

patterns.summary: Sliding window attention buffers exceeded available memory.
patterns.action: Reduce window size or max_num_seqs.

patterns.summary: LongRoPE context extension scaling buffers caused OOM.
patterns.action: Decrease max_model_len when using LongRoPE.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine: YaRN rope scaling OOM
patterns.summary: YaRN RoPE scaling configuration exceeded memory limits.
patterns.action: Ensure scaling factor matches available VRAM capacity.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine: Dynamic NTK scaling OOM
patterns.summary: Dynamic NTK context scaling dynamically exhausted memory.
patterns.action: Cap maximum sequence length to prevent unbounded NTK scaling.

patterns.re: vLLM Engine: block_size=32 OOM on small GPU
patterns.summary: A block size of 32 on a low VRAM GPU caused rapid memory fragmentation and OOM.
patterns.action: Reduce block_size to 16.

patterns.re: AssertionError: AWQ weights shape.*not divisible by group_size
patterns.summary: AWQ group size does not perfectly divide the hidden dimension.
patterns.action: Adjust AWQ group size (e.g., 128) to divide the layer dimension.

patterns.summary: Weight-only quantization plugin is disabled or missing.
patterns.action: Enable the weight-only quantization plugin during engine build.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: W4A16 GEMM is not supported on this CUDA device
patterns.summary: W4A16 GEMM kernel is not supported on the current hardware.
patterns.action: Run on an Ampere or newer GPU, or use a different quantization format.

patterns.re: TRT internal error.*failed to allocate workspace for context FMHA
patterns.summary: GPU out of memory during engine compilation due to huge max_input_len.
patterns.action: Lower the max_input_len parameter or disable context FMHA if unnecessary.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: gpt_attention_plugin must be enabled for this architecture
patterns.summary: The model architecture requires the gpt_attention_plugin to function.
patterns.action: Enable gpt_attention_plugin during engine compilation.

patterns.re: ValueError: Checkpoint missing layer .* for pipeline rank .*
patterns.summary: Checkpoint shards do not cover all pipeline ranks.
patterns.action: Ensure the checkpoint was partitioned correctly for the target PP degree.

patterns.summary: A weight shard file is missing when using iterative loading.
patterns.action: Verify the converted checkpoint directory contains all shard files.

patterns.re: AssertionError: Llama3 vocab_size must be 128256, got .*
patterns.summary: Llama 3 vocabulary size is incorrectly specified in the config.
patterns.action: Set vocab_size to 128256 for Llama 3 models.

patterns.re: AssertionError: layer_norm_epsilon .* mismatch between config and builder
patterns.summary: Layer norm epsilon differs between checkpoint config and build arguments.
patterns.action: Align the epsilon values or let the builder auto-detect from config.

patterns.re: AssertionError: Draft model vocabulary size .* does not match target .*
patterns.summary: Speculative decoding draft model vocabulary does not match the target model.
patterns.action: Use a draft model trained with the same tokenizer.

patterns.summary: Whisper checkpoint conversion failed due to missing cross-attention weights.
patterns.action: Ensure the Whisper conversion script properly maps cross-attention layers.

patterns.re: ValueError: enable_context_fmha cannot be used with max_input_len > 32768
patterns.summary: Context FMHA plugin limits input length to 32768.
patterns.action: Disable context_fmha for very long context sequences.

patterns.re: KeyError: 'v_proj' scaling factor missing for SmoothQuant
patterns.summary: SmoothQuant calibration failed to generate scales for the v_proj layer.
patterns.action: Ensure the calibration captures all linear layers in the attention block.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expected position_ids in input tensor list
patterns.summary: Engine expects position_ids but they were not provided.
patterns.action: Ensure position_ids are passed during inference or rebuild engine without them.

patterns.summary: Requested beam width is too large for the configured memory.
patterns.action: Reduce max_beam_width.

patterns.summary: Chunked prefill requires paged KV cache to be enabled.
patterns.action: Enable paged_kv_cache.

patterns.re: AssertionError: tokens_per_block must be a power of 2
patterns.summary: KV cache block size must be a power of 2.
patterns.action: Set tokens_per_block to 64 or 128.

patterns.re: ValueError: Cannot enable both top_k and beam_search simultaneously
patterns.summary: Conflicting decoding modes specified.
patterns.action: Choose either Top-K sampling or Beam Search.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Repetition penalty plugin not enabled in engine
patterns.summary: Inference requested repetition penalty but plugin is missing.
patterns.action: Rebuild engine with repetition penalty plugin enabled.

patterns.re: TypeError: stop_words_list must be a list of lists of token ids
patterns.summary: Invalid format for stop words list.
patterns.action: Format stop words as a nested list of integers.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Bad words list exceeds maximum allocated memory
patterns.summary: Too many bad words specified.
patterns.action: Reduce the size of the bad words list.

patterns.re: ValueError: early_stopping is only valid for beam search
patterns.summary: Early stopping parameter applied to non-beam search decoding.
patterns.action: Remove early_stopping flag or switch to beam search.

patterns.re: ValueError: length_penalty is only valid for beam search
patterns.summary: Length penalty parameter applied to non-beam search decoding.
patterns.action: Remove length_penalty flag or switch to beam search.

patterns.re: ValueError: Temperature cannot be 0.0 for sampling
patterns.summary: Sampling requires a temperature > 0.
patterns.action: Use greedy search or set temperature > 0.

patterns.re: ValueError: top_p must be between 0 and 1
patterns.summary: Invalid top_p value.
patterns.action: Set top_p between 0.0 and 1.0.

patterns.summary: Top K value exceeds vocabulary size.
patterns.action: Set top_k to a value less than the vocabulary size.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Random seed not initialized for sampling
patterns.summary: Sampling requested but random seed is missing.
patterns.action: Provide a valid random seed.

patterns.summary: Medusa heads configuration missing for Medusa model.
patterns.action: Ensure Medusa configuration is present in config.json.

patterns.summary: Invalid format for Medusa tree choices.
patterns.action: Format medusa_choices as a valid nested list.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Prompt tuning table not provided
patterns.summary: Prompt tuning enabled but table not provided.
patterns.action: Provide prompt tuning embeddings table.

patterns.re: UNAVAILABLE in AllReduce.*TPU v3-128.*collective communication failed.*instance_39
patterns.summary: Collective AllReduce failed with UNAVAILABLE on v3-128.
patterns.action: Restart the TPU pod or check network health.

patterns.re: INTERNAL in ReduceScatter.*TPU v5e-256.*collective communication failed.*instance_50
patterns.summary: Collective ReduceScatter failed with INTERNAL on v5e-256.
patterns.action: Restart the TPU pod or check network health.

patterns.summary: Cross-replica AllReduce timed out waiting for peers in TPU pod.
patterns.action: Check for straggler nodes or uneven shard workloads.

patterns.re: XLA::HBM out of memory in AllGather.*Allocated: [0-9]+ GiB, Requested: [0-9]+ GiB.*instance_86
patterns.summary: TPU High Bandwidth Memory exhausted during AllGather.
patterns.action: Decrease batch size or enable activation checkpointing.

patterns.re: INTERNAL in AllGather.*TPU v4-64.*collective communication failed.*instance_94
patterns.summary: Collective AllGather failed with INTERNAL on v4-64.
patterns.action: Restart the TPU pod or check network health.

patterns.summary: Cross-replica CollectivePermute timed out waiting for peers in TPU pod.
patterns.action: Check for straggler nodes or uneven shard workloads.

patterns.summary: Trial actor OOMed.
patterns.action: Reduce batch size.

patterns.summary: Kernel killed trial.
patterns.action: Increase instance RAM.

patterns.summary: System failed to allocate memory.
patterns.action: Enable swap or use larger node.

patterns.summary: Serve replica OOMed.
patterns.action: Reduce max_concurrent_queries.

patterns.summary: Kernel killed serve replica.
patterns.action: Increase instance RAM.

patterns.summary: System failed to allocate memory.
patterns.action: Enable swap or use larger node.

patterns.summary: Cannot put object to Plasma.
patterns.action: Delete old ObjectRefs.

patterns.summary: Failed to alloc shm.
patterns.action: Increase /dev/shm size.

patterns.summary: cuBLAS alloc failed.
patterns.action: Reduce model size.

patterns.summary: CUDA malloc OOM.
patterns.action: Check for memory fragmentation.

patterns.summary: cuBLAS alloc failed in serve.
patterns.action: Reduce request size.

patterns.summary: CUDA malloc OOM in serve.
patterns.action: Restart replica to defrag memory.

patterns.summary: Actor crash during init.
patterns.action: Check __init__ for errors.

patterns.summary: Actor failed to start.
patterns.action: Check resource requirements.

patterns.re: Failed to map batch: memory limit
patterns.summary: map_batches OOM.
patterns.action: Reduce batch_size in map_batches.

patterns.summary: Block alloc failed.
patterns.action: Reduce partition size.

patterns.summary: Worker killed for memory.
patterns.action: Profile worker memory.

patterns.summary: Monitor killed worker.
patterns.action: Decrease max_concurrency.

patterns.summary: Spilling objects.
patterns.action: Ensure disk is fast (NVMe).

patterns.summary: Replica unresponsive.
patterns.action: Check for deadlocks.

patterns.summary: Deployment restarting.
patterns.action: Fix deployment bugs.

patterns.summary: Alloc memory for checkpoint failed.
patterns.action: Use Cloud storage.

patterns.re: Failed to create TensorRT execution context
patterns.summary: Not enough GPU memory to allocate TensorRT execution context.
patterns.action: Reduce the number of model instances or free up GPU memory.

patterns.re: out of bounds memory access in TensorRT
patterns.summary: TensorRT kernel attempted to read outside allocated tensor bounds.
patterns.action: Verify input shape and data types are strictly correct.

patterns.re: TensorRT engine expects INT8 but got FP32
patterns.summary: Client provided float32 data but the TRT binding expects int8.
patterns.action: Cast data to correct type on client side or fix config.pbtxt.

patterns.summary: Input dimensions are larger than the max limits in the TRT profile.
patterns.action: Re-export TRT engine with larger optimization profile max bounds.

patterns.summary: Using explicit batch engine with implicit batch configuration.
patterns.action: Set max_batch_size=0 in config.pbtxt for explicit batch TRT engines.

patterns.summary: ONNX Runtime failed to initialize environment.
patterns.action: Check ONNX backend shared library compatibility.

patterns.re: Failed to register CUDA Execution Provider
patterns.summary: Triton's ORT backend cannot find CUDA libraries.
patterns.action: Ensure CUDA paths are correct and ORT backend is compiled with CUDA.

patterns.re: Shape inference failed for ONNX model
patterns.summary: ONNX graph contains invalid operations or mismatched shapes.
patterns.action: Fix the ONNX export script to generate valid shape information.

patterns.re: Dynamic axis expansion led to excessive allocation
patterns.summary: Unbounded dynamic axes resulted in an impossible memory allocation request.
patterns.action: Clamp dynamic shapes before sending requests to Triton.

patterns.summary: Requested too many threads for ORT CPU execution.
patterns.action: Lower intra_op_num_threads in model configuration.

patterns.summary: The model expects a weight initializer that is missing.
patterns.action: Re-export the ONNX model with correct weights included.

patterns.summary: The Python backend worker process was killed, often due to system OOM.
patterns.action: Increase system memory or reduce Python model memory footprint.

patterns.summary: Python process ran out of RAM.
patterns.action: Profile memory usage in model.py or increase host memory.

patterns.summary: model.py took too long to initialize.
patterns.action: Increase the python backend initialization timeout.

patterns.summary: The model file is not a valid TorchScript file.
patterns.action: Save the model using torch.jit.script or torch.jit.trace properly.

patterns.summary: Input tensor shape does not match what the TorchScript model expects.
patterns.action: Update config.pbtxt or correct the client request shapes.

patterns.re: Expected all tensors to be on the same device
patterns.summary: Model expects inputs on one device, but received on another.
patterns.action: Ensure the model correctly uses the passed device in TorchScript.

requiredEvidence.re: Expected all tensors to be on the same device

patterns.summary: The model executed but returned no outputs.
patterns.action: Fix the forward method to return a valid tensor or tuple of tensors.

patterns.summary: Triton expects Tensors or Tuples, but model returned a Dict.
patterns.action: Modify the TorchScript model to return a tuple of tensors.

patterns.re: Half precision cast failed in PyTorch
patterns.summary: Model expects FP16 but config.pbtxt specifies FP32.
patterns.action: Change data_type to TYPE_FP16 in config.pbtxt.

patterns.summary: Requests waited in the dynamic batcher longer than allowed.
patterns.action: Increase queue delay or check if the backend is stalled.

patterns.re: Requests have incompatible shapes for dynamic batching
patterns.summary: Cannot batch requests because non-batch dimensions differ.
patterns.action: Pad requests on the client side or disable dynamic batching.

patterns.re: Invalid priority level for dynamic batcher
patterns.summary: Client requested a priority queue that is not configured.
patterns.action: Adjust priority_levels in the model configuration.

patterns.re: Failed to allocate memory for merged batch
patterns.summary: OOM while trying to concatenate tensors for the batch.
patterns.action: Reduce max_batch_size to limit allocation size.

patterns.re: Request dropped due to queue policy
patterns.summary: Queue was full and policy is set to drop new requests.
patterns.action: Handle drops on client via retries or increase queue size.

patterns.re: Different number of inputs in batched requests
patterns.summary: Requests have missing optional inputs, preventing batching.
patterns.action: Ensure all requests in a batch provide the same input tensors.

patterns.re: Sequence requires START flag for new sequence
patterns.summary: Client sent a request for an unknown sequence ID without the START flag.
patterns.action: Set sequence_start=True on the first request of the sequence.

patterns.summary: All sequence slots are occupied by active sequences.
patterns.action: Increase the number of sequence slots or reduce sequence duration.

patterns.summary: A sequence was idle for too long and its state was purged.
patterns.action: Increase max_sequence_idle_microseconds if clients are slow.

patterns.summary: Control tensor (like START/END) could not be mapped to the backend.
patterns.action: Ensure control inputs match the names in config.pbtxt.

patterns.summary: Too many new sequences are waiting for a free slot.
patterns.action: Increase sequence slot count or implement client-side backoff.

patterns.re: START flag received for already active sequence
patterns.summary: Client sent a START flag for a sequence ID that is already running.
patterns.action: Ensure unique sequence IDs for new streams or send END for the old one.

patterns.summary: A request in the sequence had a different shape than the first one.
patterns.action: Pad inputs to a consistent shape across the entire sequence.

patterns.summary: One of the models in the ensemble returned an error.
patterns.action: Check the logs of the specific component model that failed.

patterns.summary: The client's gRPC deadline was reached before Triton responded.
patterns.action: Increase timeout on the client side.

patterns.summary: Browser client blocked due to missing CORS headers.
patterns.action: Run Triton behind a reverse proxy that adds CORS headers.

patterns.summary: Client tried to connect via HTTPS/SSL, but Triton is not configured for it.
patterns.action: Configure Triton SSL certs or disable SSL on the client.

patterns.summary: Client requested input from a shared memory region that isn't registered.
patterns.action: Register the shared memory region before inference.

patterns.re: Model failed to load within timeout
patterns.summary: A large model took too long to load from disk/network.
patterns.action: Increase model load timeout in Triton settings.

patterns.re: Triton server out of host memory
patterns.summary: The host system ran out of RAM, crashing Triton.
patterns.action: Increase system memory or limit Triton's caching.

patterns.re: NaNs detected in backward pass of flash_attn_cuda.*fp16
patterns.summary: FP16 precision overflow caused NaNs in backward pass.
patterns.action: Switch to BF16 for better dynamic range.

patterns.summary: Deterministic backward algorithms generated unstable gradients.
patterns.action: Set deterministic=False for FlashAttention.

patterns.summary: Variable length attention backward exceeded memory limits.
patterns.action: Check max_seqlen_q and max_seqlen_k for accurate limits.

patterns.summary: GPU stopped responding during long-running attention kernel.
patterns.action: Check system power supply or reduce sequence length.

patterns.summary: Graphics exception triggered by malformed instruction in kernel.
patterns.action: Recompile FlashAttention with matching CUDA version.

patterns.summary: Incorrect tensor strides caused memory violations in backward pass.
patterns.action: Call .contiguous() on Q, K, V tensors before passing to FlashAttention.

patterns.summary: Dropout mask memory access violation during backward.
patterns.action: Verify dropout state and RNG offset match forward pass.

patterns.re: FlashAttention.*head dimension must be a power of 2
patterns.summary: Some implementations require power of 2 head dimensions.
patterns.action: Use 64, 128, or 256 for head dimensions.

patterns.re: RNG state tracker error in flash_attn_bwd
patterns.summary: Megatron RNG tracker failed to synchronize for dropout.
patterns.action: Verify tensor parallel RNG synchronization.

patterns.summary: CUDA graphs replay corrupted dropout RNG state.
patterns.action: Re-capture CUDA graphs or disable dropout during capture.

patterns.summary: Passed RNG state when dropout was disabled.
patterns.action: Do not pass RNG state when dropout is 0.

patterns.re: causal=True not supported with arbitrary cu_seqlens in this version
patterns.summary: Old FlashAttention version lacking causal varlen support.
patterns.action: Update FlashAttention.

patterns.re: vLLM paged attention backward .* flash_attn conflict
patterns.summary: vLLM customized attention conflicted with standard flash_attn module.
patterns.action: Use vLLM's internal attention kernels.

patterns.summary: Graph break caused by data-dependent shape/value from torch.nonzero.
patterns.action: Use torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic or rewrite to avoid data-dependent control flow.

patterns.summary: Graph break caused by data-dependent shape/value from torch.item.
patterns.action: Use torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic or rewrite to avoid data-dependent control flow.

patterns.summary: Graph break caused by data-dependent shape/value from torch.tolist.
patterns.action: Use torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic or rewrite to avoid data-dependent control flow.

patterns.summary: Graph break caused by data-dependent shape/value from torch.unique.
patterns.action: Use torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic or rewrite to avoid data-dependent control flow.

patterns.summary: Graph break caused by data-dependent shape/value from torch.bincount.
patterns.action: Use torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic or rewrite to avoid data-dependent control flow.

patterns.summary: Graph break caused by data-dependent shape/value from torch.masked_select.

patterns.re: Failed to initialize NVML: No devices were found
patterns.summary: NVML cannot find any NVIDIA GPUs on the system.
patterns.action: Verify GPU hardware is seated and PCI devices are visible via lspci.

patterns.summary: NVIDIA device plugin could not start its gRPC server.
patterns.action: Check for conflicting services on the device plugin port.

patterns.re: Failed to connect to Kubelet: connection refused
patterns.summary: Device plugin cannot connect to the kubelet device plugin API.
patterns.action: Verify kubelet is running and device plugin API is enabled.

patterns.summary: Permission denied when mounting GPU device node.
patterns.action: Check AppArmor/SELinux policies and cgroup permissions.

patterns.summary: CLI lacks permission to update container cgroups.
patterns.action: Ensure container runs with necessary privileges or runtime is configured correctly.

patterns.re: module verification failed: signature and\/or required key missing
patterns.summary: Secure boot prevented loading the unsigned NVIDIA driver.
patterns.action: Sign the kernel module or disable Secure Boot.

patterns.summary: Requested MIG profile is not supported by the GPU.
patterns.action: Check supported MIG profiles using nvidia-smi mig -lgip.

patterns.summary: MIG operations failed because MIG mode is off.
patterns.action: Enable MIG mode via nvidia-smi -mig 1.

patterns.re: Failed to communicate with NFD master: timeout
patterns.summary: NFD worker timed out reaching the master.
patterns.action: Verify network connectivity between NFD worker and master.

patterns.re: DCGM Exporter: Failed to initialize NVML
patterns.summary: DCGM exporter could not initialize NVML.
patterns.action: Ensure NVIDIA driver is loaded and functional.

patterns.summary: Containerd cannot find the requested CDI spec for the GPU.
patterns.action: Ensure nvidia-container-toolkit generated the CDI specs.

patterns.summary: NVIDIA prestart hook failed during container creation.
patterns.action: Verify nvidia-container-cli is functioning correctly.

patterns.summary: Host PCI subsystem exhausted memory space for GPU BAR.
patterns.action: Enable Above 4G Decoding and Resizable BAR in BIOS.

patterns.re: device plugin for nvidia.com\/gpu is unresponsive
patterns.summary: Kubelet lost connection to the NVIDIA device plugin.
patterns.action: Restart the NVIDIA device plugin daemonset.

patterns.re: Failed to mount MPS control pipe
patterns.summary: Container failed to mount the NVIDIA MPS control pipe.
patterns.action: Ensure the MPS daemon is running and pipes are shared.

patterns.summary: Process exceeded its allocated MPS memory limit.
patterns.action: Increase the MPS active thread percentage or memory limit.

patterns.summary: P2P access between GPUs is blocked by hardware or topology.
patterns.action: Check NVLink status and ACS settings.

patterns.summary: No InfiniBand/RoCE devices found in the container.
patterns.action: Ensure MOFED is installed and devices are mounted.

patterns.summary: Permission denied opening InfiniBand uverbs device.
patterns.action: Fix device permissions or grant container IPC_LOCK.

patterns.summary: nvidia-container-toolkit executable is missing.
patterns.action: Install nvidia-container-toolkit on the host.

patterns.re: GFD: Failed to detect driver version
patterns.summary: GPU Feature Discovery cannot determine the NVIDIA driver version.
patterns.action: Ensure NVML is accessible to the GFD pod.

patterns.re: GFD: NVML device get count failed
patterns.summary: GFD could not get the number of GPUs from NVML.
patterns.action: Verify driver installation and NVML health.

patterns.re: CUDA validation failed: cannot load libcuda.so
patterns.summary: GPU Operator validator could not load CUDA.
patterns.action: Check if driver installation completed successfully.

patterns.summary: Driver validation script returned an error.
patterns.action: Check dmesg for NVIDIA driver load failures.

patterns.re: Failed to attach BPF program for cgroups
patterns.summary: System failed to attach device cgroup BPF program.
patterns.action: Verify kernel support for cgroup v2 device controller.

patterns.summary: GPU time-slicing configuration map contains errors.
patterns.action: Validate the replica count and syntax in the configmap.

patterns.summary: DCGM host engine process is not responding.
patterns.action: Restart the nv-hostengine service.

patterns.summary: SELinux denied access to an unlabeled file/device.
patterns.action: Restore SELinux contexts on GPU device nodes.

patterns.summary: NVIDIA SELinux policy module is not installed.
patterns.action: Install the nvidia-container-toolkit-selinux package.

patterns.summary: NVIDIA persistence daemon failed to start.
patterns.action: Check if nvidia module is loaded and /dev/nvidia0 exists.

patterns.summary: Permission denied accessing NVIDIA capability device.
patterns.action: Verify device plugin config and cgroup rules.

patterns.summary: EFA device unavailable or libfabric missing.
patterns.action: Verify EFA driver and libfabric-aws.

patterns.summary: Insufficient memlock limits for EFA.
patterns.action: Increase memlock limits to infinity in limits.conf.

patterns.summary: Requested libfabric provider is not installed.
patterns.action: Install correct libfabric provider or check FI_PROVIDER.

patterns.summary: Receiver Not Ready retries exceeded.
patterns.action: Check network congestion or increase FI_EFA_RNR_RETRY.

patterns.summary: Receive Completion Queue overrun.
patterns.action: Increase CQ size or reduce message burstiness.

patterns.summary: Transmit Completion Queue overrun.
patterns.action: Increase TX CQ size or throttle outgoing traffic.

patterns.summary: Memory Registration failed.
patterns.action: Check memlock or maximum number of MRs supported by hardware.

patterns.summary: EFA driver loaded but no device detected.
patterns.action: Ensure instance type supports EFA and it is attached.

patterns.summary: Message size exceeds EFA maximum transfer unit.
patterns.action: Enable EFA chunking or reduce message size.

patterns.summary: EFA connection timed out during initialization.
patterns.action: Check security groups and network routing between nodes.

patterns.re: modprobe: FATAL: Module efa not found
patterns.summary: EFA kernel module not installed.
patterns.action: Install AWS EFA driver pack.

patterns.summary: EFA kernel module version mismatch with user space library.
patterns.action: Update EFA user space tools and reload kernel module.

patterns.summary: EFA device is exclusively locked by another process.
patterns.action: Ensure no zombie processes are holding EFA device.

patterns.summary: EFA hardware generating excessive interrupts.
patterns.action: Update firmware or check hardware health.

patterns.summary: PCIe Advanced Error Reporting detected hardware fault.
patterns.action: Replace instance or check PCIe topology.

patterns.summary: IOMMU blocking EFA DMA operations.
patterns.action: Configure intel_iommu=on iommu=pt in GRUB.

patterns.summary: EFA driver ring buffer exhausted.
patterns.action: Increase EFA ring buffer size using ethtool.

patterns.summary: Configured MTU is too small for EFA operations.
patterns.action: Set MTU to 9000 for EFA interfaces.

patterns.summary: EFA physical link is down.
patterns.action: Check VPC attachment and hardware status.

patterns.summary: EFA driver failed to initialize hardware.
patterns.action: Review dmesg for detailed error codes and update driver.

patterns.re: ERROR: ld.so: object '.*libfastsocket.so' from LD_PRELOAD cannot be preloaded
patterns.summary: GCP Fast Socket library missing or incorrect path.
patterns.action: Verify libfastsocket.so installation and update LD_PRELOAD path.

patterns.summary: GCP Fast Socket failed to initialize.
patterns.action: Check dmesg for Fast Socket module errors.

patterns.summary: Mismatch between Fast Socket library and kernel module.
patterns.action: Update GCP Fast Socket packages.

patterns.re: FastSocket: not supported on this kernel
patterns.summary: Kernel version incompatible with Fast Socket.
patterns.action: Use a GCP recommended kernel version for Fast Socket.

patterns.summary: NCCL Fast Socket plugin failed to load.
patterns.action: Ensure NCCL Fast Socket plugin is installed and in LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

patterns.re: FastSocket: falling back to standard TCP
patterns.summary: Fast Socket encountered an error and fell back to standard TCP.
patterns.action: Investigate Fast Socket logs for the cause of fallback.

patterns.summary: Fast Socket out of memory.
patterns.action: Increase system memory or check for leaks.

patterns.summary: Fast Socket could not create a new socket.
patterns.action: Check file descriptor limits.

patterns.summary: Fast Socket failed to bind to a port.
patterns.action: Check for port conflicts or missing permissions.

patterns.summary: Fast Socket failed to start listening.
patterns.action: Review network configuration and interface availability.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN GCP FastSocket: topology mismatch
patterns.summary: FastSocket plugin topology differs from actual A3 layout.
patterns.action: Update NCCL GCP plugin to the latest version.

patterns.summary: NVIDIA peer memory module required for FastSocket GPUDirect not loaded.
patterns.action: Install and load nv_peer_mem kernel module.

patterns.summary: GCP FastSocket cannot route to peer internal IP.
patterns.action: Ensure proper VPC peering and subnet routing.

patterns.summary: GCP VPC firewall dropped FastSocket traffic.
patterns.action: Add ingress/egress rules allowing tcp:0-65535 between instances.

patterns.re: FastSocket: failed to attach XDP program
patterns.summary: FastSocket eBPF XDP attach failed.
patterns.action: Check kernel eBPF support and limits.

patterns.summary: Hardware NIC offload disabled.
patterns.action: Enable generic-receive-offload (gro) on interface.

patterns.summary: FastSocket connection attempt timed out.
patterns.action: Verify target node is up and FastSocket is listening.

patterns.summary: FastSocket receive buffer full.
patterns.action: Tune FastSocket sysctls or NCCL buffer sizes.

patterns.summary: FastSocket failed to map IPC memory between processes.
patterns.action: Check shm size and ipc limits.

patterns.summary: Application attempted unsupported socket operation.
patterns.action: Use standard TCP or update application to compatible socket calls.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN Call to ep_connect returned Connection timed out
patterns.summary: NCCL socket connection timed out.
patterns.action: Check network connectivity and security groups.

patterns.summary:
The sampler asked for more candidates than the vocabulary contains.

A top-k of K over a vocabulary of V is only defined while K is less than or equal to V. When it
is not, the selection kernel indexes past the end of the logits row and the GPU raises a
device-side assert. The assert is asynchronous, so the Python traceback usually points at an
unrelated later line; the kernel named in the assert is the one that matters.

This is a configuration fault, not a hardware or memory fault. The same weights and the same GPU
run correctly with a valid top-k.
patterns.action:
Bring top-k inside the vocabulary, then confirm the kernel is the one you think it is.

1. Read both numbers rather than assuming either:
     print(model.config.vocab_size, tokenizer.vocab_size, generation_config.top_k)
   These three disagree more often than people expect, especially after adding special tokens.

2. Clamp at the call site so it cannot recur:
     top_k = min(top_k, model.config.vocab_size)

3. If the assert persists, get an accurate stack before changing anything else. The async assert
   hides which kernel failed:
     CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 python your_script.py
   If the failing kernel is not the top-k selection, this is not a top-k problem: an embedding
   lookup with an out-of-range token id and an nll_loss target outside [0, n_classes) produce the
   same device-side assert and need different fixes.

patterns.summary: The rendezvous is waiting for more workers than actually registered, the job has not started, and every GPU that did show up is idle waiting for ones that never will.
patterns.action:
Do the arithmetic first, it localises the fault exactly:
  missing ranks = WORLD_SIZE - worker_count   (the c10d barrier log prints both)
  missing nodes = missing ranks / nproc-per-node
If the shortfall is an exact multiple of nproc-per-node, whole nodes are absent rather than individual processes failing, identify which by diffing the hosts that reached the rendezvous against the hosts the launcher was given.
On each absent host, check why the worker never started: the launch unit (`systemctl status <unit>`, `journalctl -u <unit>`), the container image pull, and whether the host can reach the rendezvous endpoint at all.
Then either repair the absent node and relaunch, or relaunch with --nnodes and WORLD_SIZE matching the hosts you actually have.
Raising the rendezvous timeout only postpones the same failure, and no GPU, NIC or fabric is implicated, no collective traffic has started yet.

patterns.summary: A corporate HTTP proxy is intercepting the rank-to-rank bootstrap connection. The internal address is not in no_proxy, so the CONNECT is sent to the proxy and refused. The bootstrap warning about a missing socket interface is the SYMPTOM; the network interfaces are fine.
patterns.action:
Exclude the cluster's own address space from the proxy, do not retune NCCL.

NOW: add the internal subnet and the node hostnames to no_proxy on every rank, for example `export no_proxy=localhost,127.0.0.1,10.0.0.0/8,.cluster.local` and the matching NO_PROXY. Both cases are needed: libraries disagree about which they read.
VERIFY: from one rank, `curl -v telnet://<peer-ip>:<port>` should connect directly. If it still reports the proxy, no_proxy is not being honoured by that client.
PREVENT: unset https_proxy/http_proxy entirely inside the training container if it never needs egress, which removes the failure mode rather than listing exceptions to it.

patterns.summary: The rendezvous port is already bound on the master host, so the TCPStore cannot listen and the job dies before `init_process_group`. Nothing has reached the GPUs, this is a host port-allocation collision, usually a second job (or an orphaned one) holding the same port.
patterns.action:
NOW: identify what holds the port before changing anything, `ss -ltnp | grep :<PORT>` or `lsof -i :<PORT>` on the master host names the listener and its PID. If it is a live job, give the NEW job a different MASTER_PORT; if it is an orphan from a crashed run, stop that specific PID. Do not blanket-kill python processes on a shared node, you will take down someone else's training.
INVESTIGATE: two jobs choosing the same port is a scheduling problem, not bad luck. Derive the port from something already unique per job (for example the SLURM job id mapped into an unprivileged range) instead of a hard-coded 29500, or let torchrun pick one with `--rdzv-endpoint=<host>:0`.
PREVENT: check the port is free on rank 0 as a launch precondition and fail with a clear message. EADDRINUSE at init is cheap to detect and expensive to debug from the NCCL side.

patterns.summary: The controller lost contact with a compute node and marked it DOWN. A node that stops answering has either lost slurmd, lost the management network, or lost power, and until that is established the node must not keep receiving work, because SLURM will requeue straight back onto it.
patterns.action:
NOW: take <node> out of the pool before anything else, `scontrol update NodeName=<node> State=DRAIN Reason="unresponsive, under investigation"`. Requeue the job with the node excluded (`--exclude=<node>`) so it resumes from its latest checkpoint on healthy hardware. A node that fails repeatedly while still schedulable will consume every retry the job has.
INVESTIGATE: decide which of the three it is. If the host is reachable, `systemctl status slurmd` and its journal answer it. If the host is unreachable, read the BMC out-of-band: the system event log (`ipmitool sel elist`) records power-supply failures, power-unit events and watchdog resets with timestamps, and a chassis that lost power stops writing kernel logs mid-line, so an absent Xid or kernel trace is NOT evidence the hardware is healthy. Confirm the management network separately from the data fabric; they fail independently.
PREVENT: return <node> with `State=RESUME` only after the cause is identified and fixed. If the BMC named a failed power supply, have it replaced, a chassis running on the survivor of a redundant pair has no redundancy left and will drop again. Alert on repeated NODE_FAIL for the same node so a flapping host is drained automatically rather than after the third job dies.

patterns.summary: The InfiniBand/RDMA transport failed while registering a memory region; the later NCCL watchdog is collateral. The submitted line proves the registration failure, but does not by itself distinguish a low memlock limit, exhausted MKey/MTT resources, or a missing GPUDirect peer-memory module.
patterns.action: First run `ulimit -l` in the exact job container and inspect `dmesg -T | grep -Ei 'ibv_reg_mr|mlx5|mkey|mtt|nvidia.peermem'`. If memlock is bounded, raise the scheduler/container memlock limit and relaunch. If the log names MKey/MTT exhaustion, reduce/coalesce registrations or correct the mlx5 resource limit. Load `nvidia-peermem` only when the module is absent and GPUDirect RDMA is actually configured. Verify with a small `ib_write_bw`/NCCL test before returning the node to service.
