patterns.summary: OOM in ZeRO-2 gradient partitioning.
patterns.action: Reduce allgather_bucket_size in DeepSpeed config.

patterns.summary: DeepSpeed failed to allocate pinned host memory for offload.
patterns.action: Reduce offload buffer sizes in config.

patterns.summary: OOM when DeepSpeed attempts to checkpoint activations.
patterns.action: Adjust deepspeed activation checkpointing configuration.

patterns.re: CUDA out of memory during Zero3Init
patterns.summary: OOM while instantiating model weights under ZeRO-3.
patterns.action: Ensure model is instantiated inside deepspeed.zero.Init() context.

patterns.re: DeepSpeed Zero Stage 3.*CUDA out of memory.*forward
patterns.summary: OOM in ZeRO-3 parameter un-partitioning during forward pass.
patterns.action: Enable CPU offload for ZeRO-3 parameters.

patterns.re: DeepSpeed Zero Stage 3.*CUDA out of memory.*backward
patterns.summary: OOM in ZeRO-3 parameter un-partitioning during backward pass.
patterns.action: Reduce stage3_max_live_parameters in DeepSpeed config.

patterns.re: CUDA out of memory.*Gathering parameters for Zero3
patterns.summary: OOM consolidating ZeRO-3 full state dict on a single GPU.
patterns.action: Save checkpoints in sharded format instead of full state dict.

patterns.summary: OOM during FSDP model sharding initialization.
patterns.action: Use smaller FSDP wrapping policies (e.g., wrap every layer).

patterns.summary: OOM during FSDP forward pass un-sharding.
patterns.action: Wrap smaller submodules with FSDP.

patterns.summary: OOM during FSDP backward pass memory reconstruction.
patterns.action: Use backward_prefetch=BackwardPrefetch.BACKWARD_PRE.

patterns.summary: OOM with FSDP and activation checkpointing combined.
patterns.action: Ensure activation checkpointing is applied BEFORE FSDP wrapping.

patterns.summary: OOM while saving or gathering FSDP optimizer states.
patterns.action: Use ShardedStateDictConfig when saving checkpoints.

patterns.summary: OOM consolidating FSDP full state dict on a single GPU.
patterns.action: Save checkpoints in sharded format instead of full state dict.

patterns.summary: DDP gradient bucket allocation OOMed.
patterns.action: Reduce DDP bucket_cap_mb (default 25MB) to save memory.

patterns.summary: DDP or custom all_reduce OOMed allocating the output tensor.
patterns.action: Use in-place operations like all_reduce_().

patterns.summary: Broadcast failed due to memory exhaustion.
patterns.action: Free unused tensors before synchronizing.

patterns.summary: OOM during text generation KV cache allocation.
patterns.action: Reduce max_new_tokens or use Flash Attention.

patterns.summary: OOM allocating LoRA adapters.
patterns.action: Reduce LoRA rank (r) or target fewer modules.

patterns.summary: OOM in bitsandbytes Int8 linear layer due to thresholding overhead.
patterns.action: Switch to load_in_4bit or reduce batch size.

patterns.summary: OOM during 4-bit forward pass dequantization.
patterns.action: Reduce batch size; 4-bit saves weights memory but activations still use fp16.

patterns.summary: OOM when Accelerate prepares the model or dataloader.
patterns.action: Reduce batch size before calling accelerator.prepare.

patterns.summary: OOM within Accelerate's gradient accumulation context.
patterns.action: Ensure zero_grad() is called correctly by Accelerate.

patterns.summary: UNet forward pass OOM in Diffusers.
patterns.action: Enable gradient checkpointing or xformers memory efficient attention.

patterns.summary: xformers attention still OOMed due to extreme sequence length.
patterns.action: Enable sliced attention or reduce image resolution.

patterns.summary: Accelerate FSDP plugin OOM.
patterns.action: Tune Accelerate FSDP wrap configuration.

patterns.summary: HuggingFace TGI server ran out of CUDA memory.
patterns.action: Adjust max_batch_prefill_tokens in TGI.

patterns.re: CUDA out of memory during TGI prefill
patterns.summary: TGI prefill phase exhausted VRAM.
patterns.action: Reduce max_input_tokens.

patterns.re: CUDA out of memory during TGI decode
patterns.summary: TGI decode phase exhausted VRAM.
patterns.action: Decrease max_total_tokens.

patterns.summary: Continuous batching scheduler accepted too many requests.
patterns.action: Lower the max_concurrent_requests parameter.

patterns.summary: vLLM failed to allocate KV cache blocks on startup.
patterns.action: Decrease gpu_memory_utilization (e.g., to 0.8).

patterns.summary: vLLM PagedAttention kernel OOM during generation.
patterns.action: Lower max_model_len or max_num_seqs.

patterns.summary: Ray worker managing vLLM tensor parallel rank OOMed.
patterns.action: Check memory balance across Ray GPUs.

patterns.summary: Automatic prefix caching consumed too much memory in vLLM.
patterns.action: Disable enable_prefix_caching or reduce cache size.

patterns.summary: Chunked prefill exhausted memory during large prompt processing.
patterns.action: Decrease max_num_batched_tokens.

patterns.summary: Megatron-LM tensor parallel block exhausted memory.
patterns.action: Increase tensor_model_parallel_size.

patterns.summary: Megatron pipeline parallel microbatch buffering OOM.
patterns.action: Reduce num_microbatches or micro_batch_size.

patterns.summary: Megatron sequence parallelism OOM during all-gather.
patterns.action: Ensure sequence length is divisible by TP size and reduce batch size.

patterns.summary: Megatron Context Parallelism ring attention OOM.
patterns.action: Increase context_parallel_size for longer sequences.

patterns.summary: Vocab parallel cross entropy OOMed on large vocabulary.
patterns.action: Increase TP size to distribute vocabulary further.

patterns.summary: Megatron Core attention OOM.
patterns.action: Enable flash attention in Megatron arguments.

patterns.summary: Megatron activation checkpointing failed to save memory.
patterns.action: Check checkpoint_num_layers to checkpoint more aggressively.

patterns.summary: Megatron distributed optimizer state OOM.
patterns.action: Use ZeRO-1 equivalent in Megatron or reduce optimizer states.

patterns.summary: TensorRT engine compilation ran out of memory.
patterns.action: Build engine on a machine with more VRAM or CPU RAM.

patterns.summary: SGLang radix attention cache exhausted VRAM.
patterns.action: Clear radix cache or reduce concurrency limit.

patterns.summary: PyTorch XLA exhausted memory (usually on TPU or GPU).
patterns.action: Reduce XLA batch size or clear XLA cache.

patterns.summary: ColossalAI ZeRO plugin OOMed.
patterns.action: Enable chunk-based memory management in ColossalAI.

patterns.summary: When PyTorch data loaders or other applications fork processes with the EFA libfabric provider enabled, memory allocation fails (OSError: Cannot allocate memory). This happens because huge pages are incompatible with memory registrations across forks in this context.
patterns.action: Set the environment variable FI_EFA_USE_HUGE_PAGE=0 to disable huge pages for libfabric, preventing the memory allocation failure during fork. Ensure RDMAV_FORK_SAFE=1 is NOT set.

requiredEvidence.re: Application is calling fork(), typically in PyTorch multiprocessing data loaders
EFA provider is in use with FI_EFA_FORK_SAFE=1 or implicit fork support
Logs show 'Cannot allocate memory' during fork

patterns.summary: nn.RMSNorm outputs become zero or wildly incorrect when operating in bfloat16. The small epsilon value added to the variance underflows the 7-bit mantissa of BF16, causing the denominator to evaluate incorrectly and flushing outputs to zero.
patterns.action: Force the internal accumulation and variance calculation of nn.RMSNorm to operate in FP32 by upcasting the inputs before normalization, then downcasting the result back to BF16.

patterns.re: operation not permitted when stream is capturing
patterns.summary: Attempting to perform CPU synchronization or stream switching (e.g..item() or dynamic tensor operations) while a CUDA graph is actively capturing operations.
patterns.action: Remove dynamic control flow or CPU-syncing operations from the captured code block, or use eager execution.
patterns.resumeFrom: restart script without CUDA graph capture

patterns.re: High latency during generation\/inference with ZeRO-Offload
patterns.summary: Using ZeRO-Offload for text generation (inference) results in severe PCIe bottlenecking because the entire model must be streamed across the PCIe bus for every token generated. The low batch size of inference cannot amortize the massive PCIe transfer overhead.
patterns.action: Disable CPU/NVMe offload for latency-sensitive inference. If the model exceeds VRAM, use tensor parallelism (e.g., DeepSpeed Inference) across multiple GPUs or apply weight quantization (INT8/INT4/AWQ) to fit the model entirely in GPU VRAM.

requiredEvidence.re: Inference script utilizing DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3 with offload_param
Generation metrics showing extremely high seconds-per-token latency

patterns.re: webhook rejected the request: NumOfHosts must be set for multi-host TPU topologies
patterns.summary: The kuberay-tpu-webhook rejects TPU multi-host worker groups if NumOfHosts is missing or set to 0, preventing multi-slice topology scheduling.
patterns.action: Update the RayCluster or JobSet manifest to explicitly set NumOfHosts to match the number of nodes in the requested TPU topology slice.

requiredEvidence.re: NumOfHosts=0 or missing in workerGroup spec

patterns.summary: NVIDIA Fabric Manager is missing, misconfigured, or has a driver version mismatch on H100 SXM nodes. This prevents the NVSwitch from establishing the NVLink topology, causing multi-GPU workloads to fail hardware discovery.
patterns.action: Install the matching nv-fabricmanager package for the exact NVIDIA driver version, start/enable the nv-fabricmanager systemd service, and ensure it is fully running before initializing NCCL workloads.

requiredEvidence.re: dmesg or syslog containing 'nvidia-nvswitch0: Failed to initialize device'

patterns.re: TimeoutError: The client socket has timed out after .* while trying to connect to \(127\.0\.0\.1, 0\)
patterns.summary: When using --main_process_port 0, Accelerate fails to resolve the next free port and attempts to bind to port 0, causing an initialization timeout.
patterns.action: Find a free port using a custom Python script (e.g., using socket.bind) and explicitly pass it via --main_process_port instead of using 0.

patterns.re: timeout error.*after the end of a step eval in the middle
patterns.summary: The evaluation loop takes longer than the default 30-minute PyTorch distributed/NCCL timeout, causing waiting processes to crash with a watchdog timeout.
patterns.action: Increase the timeout by passing InitProcessGroupKwargs(timeout=timedelta(seconds=86400)) in the kwargs_handlers list when initializing the Accelerator.

patterns.re: The current process just got forked, after parallelism has already been used|Hangs at 0% progress
patterns.summary: Calling `dataset.map(..., num_proc=N)` to tokenize a dataset in parallel using a FastTokenizer causes a silent hang. The `datasets` library uses Python multiprocessing to fork workers, which deadlocks because the Rust tokenizer's Rayon thread pool is already active in the main process.
patterns.action: Set os.environ['TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM'] = 'false' to disable Rust-level threading so that Python-level multiprocessing (via num_proc) handles the parallelism without conflicts.

patterns.summary: OpenSM LASH routing algorithm failed to resolve credit loops in a complex toroidal mesh due to insufficient Virtual Lanes (VLs) configured on the switches, causing a cyclic buffer dependency and eventual subnet deadlock.
patterns.action: Reconfigure OpenSM to use Up/Down routing algorithm or increase the number of VLs available for LASH in opensm.conf.
patterns.resumeFrom: Restart OpenSM and reboot affected switches to clear stuck buffers

requiredEvidence.re: OpenSM logs showing LASH routing failure or fallback

patterns.re: TPU Execute is taking a long time\. This might be due to a deadlock between multiple TPU cores
patterns.summary: When running JAX on a multi-host TPU Pod, if control flow diverges across hosts (e.g., using jax.process_index() in a conditional), some hosts will enter a collective communication op like psum while others do not, causing a deadlock.
patterns.action: Ensure all hosts execute the exact same collective operations. Remove process-specific conditionals around collective ops.

patterns.summary: PyTorch DataLoader uses shared memory (/dev/shm) to pass tensors to the main process. K8s defaults /dev/shm to 64MB. When data is large, this fills up rapidly, leading to Bus error or Pod OOMKilled.
patterns.action: Mount an emptyDir volume with medium: Memory to /dev/shm to increase the shared memory size, and increase pod memory requests/limits accordingly.
patterns.resumeFrom: restart pod with updated volume spec

patterns.summary: Using multiple DataLoader workers in PyTorch forks processes. If the dataset stores large amounts of metadata in Python lists/dicts, the Python GC modifies reference counts, causing the OS Copy-on-Write mechanism to duplicate memory across all workers until the K8s pod limit is hit.
patterns.action: Convert Python lists/dicts in the Dataset __init__ into PyTorch Tensors, NumPy arrays, or use Pandas/Arrow which do not trigger reference counting overhead on read.
patterns.resumeFrom: restart pod with optimized dataset structure

requiredEvidence.re: Steady memory growth metrics until cgroup limit

patterns.summary: Docker container ran with default 64MB /dev/shm. NCCL fails to allocate shared memory for IPC with 'No space left on device'.
patterns.action: Increase shm-size via '--shm-size=4g' (or larger) or '--ipc=host' in Docker run arguments.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: DataLoader worker .* is killed by signal: Bus error
patterns.summary: PyTorch DataLoader with num_workers > 0 exhausts the container's shared memory space by caching tensors, leaving no room for NCCL communication buffers and triggering a SIGBUS.
patterns.action: Increase container '--shm-size', reduce 'num_workers' in DataLoader, or set 'pin_memory=False'.

patterns.summary: In rootless Docker or restricted LXC environments on cgroup v2, the `nvidia-container-cli` fails to initialize GPUs because it lacks privileges to query or attach BPF_CGROUP_DEVICE programs for device filtering.
patterns.action: Set `no-cgroups = true` in `/etc/nvidia-container-runtime/config.toml` under the `[nvidia-container-cli]` section to bypass eBPF device rules.

patterns.summary: Newer versions of `runc` enforce strict checks for device injections and require symlinks to exist under `/dev/char/` on the host. If the NVIDIA drivers do not create these symlinks, the container hook fails during initialization.
patterns.action: Run `sudo nvidia-ctk system create-dev-char-symlinks --create-all` to manually generate the required symlinks, and persist them with a udev rule.

patterns.re: DataLoader hangs indefinitely when reading HDF5 files
patterns.summary: Opening an HDF5 file in __init__ of the Dataset causes the file handle to be shared across forked worker processes. Concurrent reads corrupt the HDF5 C library state, leading to deadlocks.
patterns.action: Open the HDF5 file handle lazily inside the __getitem__ method or a worker_init_fn so each process gets its own file handle.
patterns.resumeFrom: Restart training script from latest checkpoint

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expected sparse gradient to be defined.
patterns.summary: When using find_unused_parameters=True with a sparse embedding that is not used in the forward pass, DDP crashes during the backward pass. Reducer::mark_variable_ready_sparse checks for grad.defined() but lacks the unused parameter handling of dense parameters.
patterns.action: Set sparse=False for the nn.Embedding layer or ensure the sparse embedding is always used in the forward pass.

patterns.re: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout|unhandled system error
patterns.summary: NCCL fails to automatically identify the correct network interface for inter-node communication, attempting to use a Docker bridge or local loopback instead. This results in PyTorch DDP processes hanging and timing out during Ray Train collective operations (e.g. Issue #40850).
patterns.action: Explicitly define the network interface by setting `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0` (or appropriate interface) in the Ray `runtime_env` when initializing the cluster.

requiredEvidence.re: NCCL_DEBUG=INFO reveals wrong interface like docker0 or lo
Training hangs during dist.init_process_group or collective operations

patterns.summary: The system's OOM killer terminates the Ray worker process via SIGKILL due to memory exhaustion. This often happens in distributed training when large datasets are loaded entirely into memory, or when memory references prevent garbage collection.
patterns.action: Reduce the batch size, explicitly set the memory requests (`memory`) in the cluster config or `resources_per_trial`, and optionally configure `object_store_memory` in `ray.init()` to sandbox memory usage.

requiredEvidence.re: No explicit memory bounds set for actors\/tasks
System logs show OOM killer invoking SIGKILL on ray workers

patterns.summary: Slurm applies a strict CPU affinity mask to the job processes. NCCL also attempts to set CPU affinity based on PCIe/GPU topology. The intersection of these masks can result in NCCL communication threads being placed on suboptimal cores, leading to degraded all-reduce performance or timeouts.
patterns.action: Set `export NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1` in the Slurm submission script to allow NCCL to ignore the launcher's affinity mask and use its own topology-based logic.

requiredEvidence.re: NCCL attempts to set thread affinity but fails or performance drops significantly due to empty intersection mask

patterns.summary: When utilizing nvfp4 quantization with managed weights, tllmRuntime.cpp fails during engine build or inference because it strictly expects DataType::kFP4. Safetensors lacks native FP4, defaulting to INT8 or UINT8, which triggers an assertion.
patterns.action: Patch tllmRuntime.cpp to gracefully handle packed weights by manually wrapping memory via ITensor::wrap, or ensure metadata is correctly annotated.
patterns.resumeFrom: Clean rebuild of the engine after modifying the checkpoint's config.json dtype.

patterns.summary: When running on a system with multiple different GPU architectures (e.g., RTX 3090 and 4090), Triton may JIT compile the kernel using the primary GPU's architecture. Executing this binary on a different GPU results in a segmentation fault during LLVM codegen or execution.
patterns.action: Set TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST to the lowest common denominator (e.g., '8.6'), map devices correctly with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, and clear the ~/.cache/triton/ cache before recompiling.
patterns.resumeFrom: Restart script after setting environment variables and clearing cache

requiredEvidence.re: Multiple GPUs with different compute capabilities
JIT compiling on GPU 0 and executing on GPU 1

patterns.re: ValueError: No available memory for the cache blocks
patterns.summary: vLLM fails to initialize due to pre-allocating too much memory for cache blocks when CUDA graphs are enabled or `--max-num-seqs` is set too high.
patterns.action: Restart the engine with `--enforce-eager` to disable CUDA graph memory overhead, lower `--gpu-memory-utilization`, or set `--max-num-seqs 1`.

requiredEvidence.re: fails for cache blocks even though alot more memory is left

patterns.re: size mismatch for\s+[^:\n]+:\s*copying a param with shape
patterns.summary: The checkpoint is readable, but one or more tensor shapes belong to a different model architecture or configuration. This is a model/checkpoint compatibility error, not file corruption.
patterns.action: Instantiate the exact matching architecture/configuration used to create the checkpoint (compare `hidden_size` such as 4096 vs 8192, layer count, vocabulary size, attention heads, tensor-parallel layout, and adapter/base-model IDs), or select the correct checkpoint built for the current config. `strict=False` does not repair tensor shape mismatches and can silently leave required weights unloaded; use it only for an explicitly reviewed missing/unexpected-key migration, never as the fix for a size mismatch.
patterns.resumeFrom: a checkpoint whose model configuration matches the current process

patterns.summary: Illegal use of Python fork() after CUDA initialization corrupted the NVIDIA driver state.
patterns.action: You MUST change your multiprocessing start method to `multiprocessing.set_start_method("spawn")` or `forkserver`. Forking after CUDA init is fatal.

patterns.summary: Concurrent NCCL collectives from FSDP and Tensor Parallelism collided on the same GPU stream.
patterns.action: Ensure PyTorch `new_group()` uses dedicated backends and that `torch.cuda.Stream` barriers explicitly enforce execution order between TP and FSDP collectives.

requiredEvidence.re: unhandled system error|Call to network failed

patterns.summary: Asynchronous data-race caused by missing host-to-device sync before a CUDA Graph replay.
patterns.action: Do NOT run with CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 as it masks the bug. Add `torch.cuda.synchronize()` immediately after copying input tensors to the static CUDA Graph buffers, before calling `graph.replay()`.

patterns.re: FlashAttention forward pass failed|operation timed out
patterns.summary: ZeRO-3 CPU offloading saturated the PCIe bus, starving FlashAttention kernels and causing timeouts.
patterns.action: Disable `overlap_comm` in DeepSpeed or reduce the offload fraction to prevent PCIe DMA transfers from starving SRAM attention kernels.

patterns.summary: Lustre/NFS MDS revoked file locks due to massive metadata operations during validation.
patterns.action: Tar/pack your datasets (e.g. WebDataset/TFRecord) to eliminate millions of metadata operations, protecting filesystem locks required for checkpointing.

patterns.summary: TensorRT ahead-of-time compiler exhausted host RAM and hung completely in disk swap.
patterns.action: Drastically increase host RAM (e.g., 512GB+) or disable CPU swapping during massive engine builds.

patterns.summary: InfiniBand Adaptive Routing delivered out-of-order packets exceeding NIC tolerance.
patterns.action: Verify Adaptive Routing on the Subnet Manager. Enable OOO_RX via mlxconfig on the NICs, or disable AR if the topology does not require it.

patterns.summary: GPU Hardware Fault (ISOLATE Tier) - Xid 54 detected. This indicates a severe unrecoverable hardware fault.
patterns.action: Drain and isolate the node immediately. The GPU has suffered a critical hardware fault. Schedule an RMA with NVIDIA.

negativeEvidence.re: replay(?:ing|ed)? archived|archived dmesg|postmortem|historical log|end of archive

patterns.summary: GPU Hardware Fault (Xid 154 Derived Action) - The driver explicitly requested a node reboot or GPU reset for recovery.
patterns.action: Check the specific requested action in the log (Node Reboot or GPU Reset) and perform it to recover the GPU state.

negativeEvidence.re: replay(?:ing|ed)? archived|archived dmesg|postmortem|historical log|end of archive

patterns.summary: NVSwitch hardware error (SXid 144-150). Port state link down or degraded.
patterns.action: Check the specific port on the NVSwitch that failed. Run `nvsm show health` and RMA the baseboard if multiple SXid 144-150 errors occur on the same port.

patterns.re: NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus|RmInitAdapter failed
patterns.summary: GPU has fallen off the bus (Kernel Message) - Critical hardware/connectivity fault on the PCIe or OAM link.
patterns.action: Node reboot is immediately required. If the GPU does not reappear in `nvidia-smi` post-reboot, it has suffered a permanent hardware failure.

patterns.summary: GPU stopped responding to reset (Xid 43). TDR exhausted; GPU is wedged.
patterns.action: Node reboot is mandatory. The GPU hardware is unresponsive to soft-resets.

patterns.summary: Thermal Shutdown - GPU reached critical temperature and shut down to prevent destruction.
patterns.action: IMMEDIATELY inspect cooling systems on the node. The GPU has executed a hard shutdown. Do not reboot until cooling is verified.

patterns.summary: NCCL Hang (Compute Gap) - A GPU compute crash on a specific rank caused it to stop participating in collectives, hanging all other ranks.
patterns.action: The NCCL timeout is purely collateral. Find the rank that crashed first (with the CUDA error) and focus diagnosis there. Do NOT tune NCCL settings.

requiredEvidence.re: CUDA error|illegal memory access|device-side assert|unspecified launch failure

patterns.summary: PCIe Bandwidth Degradation - Link speed/width has degraded, severely throttling data transfer and causing synchronous step delays.
patterns.action: Run `nvidia-smi -q -d CLOCK` and check PCIe link status. Node hardware inspection required.

patterns.re: GPU is already claimed|cannot initialize NVML|driver shutting down
patterns.summary: Zombie Process / Driver State - A previous crashed job left a zombie process holding the GPU context.
patterns.action: Run `fuser -v /dev/nvidia*` to find the zombie process and `kill -9` it. If it cannot be killed (D-state), the node must be rebooted.

patterns.re: No IB devices found|ibv_get_device_list failed|libibverbs: Warning
patterns.summary: IB Device Not Found - PyTorch/NCCL cannot detect the InfiniBand hardware.
patterns.action: Verify MOFED drivers are loaded (`lsmod | grep mlx5`). Ensure the container has `--privileged` or `--device=/dev/infiniband` bindings.

patterns.summary: Disk Full (ENOSPC) - Training crashed because the local or shared disk is full.
patterns.action: Clear old checkpoints or dataset caches (`rm -rf ~/.cache/huggingface`). Check `/tmp` and `/dev/shm` as well.

patterns.summary: Flash attention received corrupted tensor metadata (q/k/v shape mismatch). The upstream data pipeline or preprocessing has fed invalid token sequence lengths to the attention kernel, resulting in downstream CUDA illegal memory accesses.
patterns.action: This is a data pipeline error, not a GPU fault. Dump the failing batch using PyTorch (`torch.save(batch...)`) before the forward pass and inspect `input_ids` and `attention_mask` shapes for off-by-one errors (e.g. 16384 vs 16383). Also verify checkpoint loading didn't drop quantization metadata.

patterns.re: (?:ibv_devinfo shows 'Fatal'|MLNX_OFED module load failures|NET\/IB : No device found)
patterns.summary: Mellanox OFED Driver Mismatch
patterns.action: Reinstall the specific MLNX_OFED version compatible with the active kernel, and disable automatic kernel updates on GPU/IB nodes.

patterns.re: (?:driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime version|nvrm_gpu: Unknown symbol|CUDA error: no kernel image is available for execution on the device)
patterns.summary: Container CUDA Runtime Mismatch with Host Driver
patterns.action: Ensure the host NVIDIA driver version satisfies the minimum requirement for the CUDA Toolkit version used inside the container.

patterns.re: EngineDeadError|EngineCore encountered an issue|Engine core proc(?:ess)?[^\n]{0,40}died unexpectedly|AsyncEngineDeadError|Background loop has errored already
patterns.summary: vLLM V1 EngineCore process died and the API server is now serving 500s for every request. The API server survives its engine, so /health may still answer while the replica is functionally dead, the real cause is in the EngineCore child's stderr, ABOVE this exception, not in the traceback the client sees.
patterns.action:
NOW: pull this replica out of the load balancer (readiness must probe a real completion, not /health) and restart the server process.
INVESTIGATE: the EngineCore child's own log, the API-server traceback is downstream and names no cause. Search the container's full stderr for the FIRST error above "EngineDeadError". Check dmesg/kubectl for an OOMKill of the child PID: a host-OOM-killed EngineCore surfaces to the parent as nothing but EngineDeadError.
PREVENT: set --disable-log-requests off during triage so the failing request is identifiable; capture EngineCore stderr separately (VLLM_LOGGING_CONFIG_PATH) so this class of failure is not diagnosed from the wrong process.
patterns.resumeFrom: no checkpoint, restart the engine process after draining the replica

negativeEvidence.re: GPU is lost|GPU has been reset

patterns.summary: JAX pjit sharding spec does not map onto the current device mesh. This happens when the tensor dimensions do not evenly divide the mesh layout or a dimension is explicitly partitioned on an axis that is missing from the mesh.
patterns.action: Check the `in_shardings` and `out_shardings` in your `pjit` call. Ensure they correctly map to the axes defined in your `mesh`. Validate that the tensor shape is divisible by the partition size.

negativeEvidence.re: GPU is lost|GPU has been reset

patterns.re: NVRM: Xid \(PCI:[0-9a-f:.]+\):? 79\b|GPU has fallen off the bus
patterns.summary: GPU fell off the PCIe bus (Xid 79), the device vanished from the bus: power delivery, riser/slot, overheating VRM, or dead GPU.
patterns.action:
NOW: verify this is CURRENT (timestamp within job window; nvidia-smi now, does the GPU enumerate?). If live: drain node; full power-cycle (not just reboot).
INVESTIGATE: BMC SEL for power events; temps before the event; reseat riser/power cables.
PREVENT: alert on PCIe correctable-error ramps preceding off-bus events.
ESCALATE: recurs after reseat + power-cycle → RMA (include SEL + dmesg).

negativeEvidence.re: replay(ing|ed)? archived|archived dmesg|postmortem|historical log|for training documentation

patterns.summary: A large pinned host-memory allocation exceeds the host pinning path; the generic CUDA debugging footer is not an observed device assertion.
patterns.action: Reduce or chunk the pinned allocation, check memlock and available host RAM, then repeat the exact allocation in a fresh process and verify pinned memory is released after exit.
patterns.resumeFrom: the failed data-loading operation after the bounded allocation passes its release check

negativeEvidence.re: (?:Assertion|assertion)[^\n]*failed|IndexKernel\.cu|ScatterGatherKernel\.cu|Class values must be smaller than num_classes

patterns.summary: The DeepSpeed FP8/ZeRO composition contract fails its own invariant test.
patterns.action: Use the DeepSpeed/TransformerEngine pair containing the FP8-across-ZeRO fix (or disable that composition), then rerun the exact composability test for fp16/bf16 and a one-step training control.
patterns.resumeFrom: job start after the composability control passes

patterns.re: torch\.cuda\.OutOfMemoryError|CUDA out of memory|RuntimeError.*CUDA.*out of memory
patterns.summary: GPU ran out of memory during training.
patterns.action: Reduce batch size, enable gradient checkpointing, or use PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

patterns.summary: GPU System Processor (GSP) stopped responding (Xid 119).
patterns.action: Reset the GPU (nvidia-smi --gpu-reset) or reboot. Update driver/GSP firmware to a qualified version.

patterns.summary: Fabric handle import failed (CUDA 101) - CUDA driver 570.00 bug on MNNVL/GH200.
patterns.action: Upgrade the CUDA driver beyond 570.00. Ensure consistent device enumeration across containers.

patterns.re: Cannot partition a param in flight|still have inflight params
patterns.summary: DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 parameter still in flight (save or backward) causing a synchronization hang.
patterns.action: Verify DeepSpeed initialization order (TrainingArguments before from_pretrained). Check for heterogeneous data shapes across ranks. Enable activation checkpointing if OOM co-occurs.

patterns.summary: PyTorch FSDP collective desynchronization hang.
patterns.action: Sequence Numbers across ranks mismatch. The computational graphs have diverged due to conditional branching (if/else) or uneven tensor shapes in the dataloader. Rerun with TORCH_NCCL_DUMP_ON_TIMEOUT=1 and verify dataset shapes.

patterns.re: RuntimeError:\s*one of the variables needed for gradient computation has been modified by an inplace operation
patterns.summary: PyTorch: in-place operation broke autograd graph. Common in residual connections or activation hooks.
patterns.action: grep -rn ".add_|.mul_|.copy_|.scatter_|.index_add_|.slice_scatter_" src/ --include="*.py" | head -20. Fix: replace in-place with out-of-place ops (a = a + b instead of a += b), or wrap in torch.no_grad() if grad not needed.

patterns.re: vLLM.*KV cache.*(?:block|allocat|OOM|memory|fail)|Unable to allocate KV cache|Not enough GPU memory for KV cache|torch\.cuda\.OutOfMemoryError.*KV cache|vllm.*workspace.*OOM
patterns.summary: vLLM KV cache allocation failed. GPU OOM during block reservation for the KV cache.
patterns.action: Reduce `max_num_seqs`, `max_model_len`, or set `gpu_memory_utilization` lower (e.g., 0.85). Enable `--enable-prefix-caching` to reduce per-request KV usage.

patterns.summary: Lustre LBUG or LASSERT kernel panic triggered.
patterns.action: Collect crash dump: cat /sys/kernel/debug/lustre/panic; lctl dk; dmesg -T > lustre_panic.log; check /var/log/messages for assert string; node likely needs reboot.

patterns.summary: Job preempted by SIGKILL, higher-priority job or admin preemption.
patterns.action: Check PreemptType/Priority in slurm.conf; use --priority or submit to low-priority partition.

patterns.re: fatal error: hip\/hip_bfloat16\.h: No such file
patterns.summary: Missing HIP bfloat16 header during FA compilation.
patterns.action: Install rocm-device-libs and export ROCM_PATH.

patterns.re: error: local memory \(LDS\) exceeds capacity \(65536 bytes\)
patterns.summary: LDS memory exhaustion on MI300X for large block size.
patterns.action: Reduce block size or tune FA configs for MI300X LDS limits.

patterns.summary: ROCm version too old to support MI300X (gfx942).
patterns.action: Upgrade to ROCm 6.0+.

patterns.re: clang: error: unable to execute command: Segmentation fault
patterns.summary: HIP compiler crashed compiling complex attention kernels.
patterns.action: Reduce optimization level to -O2 or update HIP LLVM.

patterns.re: error: __global__ function cannot be called from a __host__ function
patterns.summary: Host/device macro missing in ROCm port of FA.
patterns.action: Apply hipify_torch macros correctly to host-side launchers.

patterns.summary: HIP runtime library not linked correctly.
patterns.action: Add -lhip_hcc to linker flags.

patterns.re: fatal error: hipblas\/hipblas\.h: No such file
patterns.summary: hipBLAS headers missing for FA build.
patterns.action: Install hipblas-dev package.

patterns.re: warning: expected '#pragma unroll' to be followed by a loop
patterns.summary: Clang failed to parse unroll pragma in converted CUDA code.
patterns.action: Rewrite #pragma unroll for HIP Clang compatibility.

patterns.re: error: invalid operand in inline asm
patterns.summary: Inline PTX assembly failed to translate to AMDGCN.
patterns.action: Replace PTX with ROCm inline AMDGCN assembly or intrinsics.

patterns.summary: Runtime compilation of FA kernels failed on MI300X.
patterns.action: Check hipRTC log for specific syntax errors in JIT kernels.

patterns.summary: Triton failed to map dot product to MI300X MFMA instruction.
patterns.action: Update Triton to nightly build with gfx942 matrix core support.

patterns.re: LLVM ERROR: out of resource: shared memory
patterns.summary: Triton kernel requested more shared memory than MI300X provides.
patterns.action: Reduce BLOCK_M and BLOCK_N in Triton kernel launch grid.

patterns.re: LLVM ERROR: register allocation timed out
patterns.summary: Triton LLVM backend hung during register allocation for large kernel.
patterns.action: Reduce max_num_imprecise_acc or limit registers per thread.

patterns.summary: Triton failed to detect MI300X architecture for JIT.
patterns.action: Ensure ROCm SMI detects the GPU and ROCM_PATH is valid.

patterns.summary: Triton emitted NVIDIA-specific PTX async copy on AMD.
patterns.action: Ensure Triton compiler backend is set to ROCm/AMDGPU.

patterns.re: Triton requires LLVM version 17\+ for AMDGPU
patterns.summary: System LLVM version is too old for Triton AMD backend.
patterns.action: Install custom LLVM build or use ROCm-provided LLVM.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Triton AMD backend not found
patterns.summary: Triton installed without ROCm support compiled in.
patterns.action: Reinstall Triton with HIP/ROCm enabled.

patterns.re: LLVM ERROR: invalid alignment for LDS memory access
patterns.summary: Unaligned memory access in shared memory generated by Triton.
patterns.action: Align Triton tensor pointers to 16 bytes for matrix cores.

patterns.re: error: wmma\.m16n16k16 not supported on gfx942
patterns.summary: WMMA intrinsic used instead of MFMA on MI300X.
patterns.action: Switch dot operand encoding to support MFMA on MI300X.

patterns.summary: Hardware atomic add for float16 not supported or generated incorrectly.
patterns.action: Implement software atomic add fallback in Triton.

patterns.re: error: 'gfx942' is not a recognized processor for this target
patterns.summary: CK build failed due to unrecognized MI300X target.
patterns.action: Update CMake flags to use ROCm 6.x hipcc.

patterns.re: fatal error: template instantiation depth exceeds maximum of 1024
patterns.summary: CK metaprogramming exceeded template depth limit.
patterns.action: Add -ftemplate-depth=2048 to CXX_FLAGS.

patterns.re: c\+\+: fatal error: Killed signal terminated program cc1plus
patterns.summary: Host OOM while compiling heavy CK template instantiations.
patterns.action: Reduce ninja build parallelism.

patterns.re: error: integer overflow in tensor coordinate calculation
patterns.summary: 32-bit integer overflow in CK tensor descriptor.
patterns.action: Enable 64-bit offsets in CK configuration.

patterns.summary: Attempted to compile CK GEMM with unsupported data type mix.
patterns.action: Check CK supported datatype documentation for MI300X.

patterns.re: error: no member named 'variant' in namespace 'std'
patterns.summary: CK requires C++17 but was compiled with C++14.
patterns.action: Set CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD to 17.

patterns.re: error: no matching function for call to 'blockwise_gemm'
patterns.summary: CK blockwise GEMM variant not implemented for given block shape.
patterns.action: Use a valid block shape supported by MI300X MFMA.

patterns.re: error: reference to __device__ function in __host__ function
patterns.summary: CK host-side launcher calling device code improperly.
patterns.action: Ensure CK host functions are marked __host__.

patterns.summary: CK tuned kernel requested more than 64KB LDS per workgroup.
patterns.action: Adjust CK tuning parameters to lower LDS usage.

patterns.summary: Unaligned pointer passed to CK vectorized load.
patterns.action: Ensure input tensors are 16-byte aligned.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Error compiling objects for extension\. .*hipcc
patterns.summary: hipcc not found in PATH during PyTorch extension build.
patterns.action: Set ROCM_PATH and add it to PATH.

patterns.re: error: PyTorch was compiled with ROCm .* but found .*
patterns.summary: Extension ROCm version conflicts with PyTorch ROCm version.
patterns.action: Align host ROCm toolkit version with PyTorch build version.

patterns.summary: PyTorch hipify script failed to convert CUDA source to HIP.
patterns.action: Check for unsupported CUDA features or syntax in extension source.

patterns.summary: HIP fp16 math intrinsic not found.
patterns.action: Include hip_fp16.h and ensure ROCm device libs are present.

patterns.re: warning: no device architecture specified for hipcc
patterns.summary: TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST not set for MI300X.
patterns.action: Set TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=gfx942.

patterns.summary: C++11 ABI incompatibility between PyTorch and extension.
patterns.action: Set _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI to match PyTorch.

patterns.summary: NVIDIA bfloat16 type not hipified correctly.
patterns.action: Replace with hip_bfloat16 or standard C++ bfloat16 type.

patterns.re: error: no matching function for call to 'atomicAdd'
patterns.summary: atomicAdd not defined for the provided data type in HIP.
patterns.action: Implement custom atomicAdd overload for the specific type.

patterns.summary: warpSize hardcoded to 32, which fails on MI300X (wavefront size 64).
patterns.action: Use warpSize variable or hardcode wavefront size to 64 for AMD.

patterns.summary: CUDA lane ID logic not translating cleanly to HIP.
patterns.action: Use __lane_id() intrinsic provided by HIP.

patterns.summary: PagedAttention HIP port missing or failed to compile.
patterns.action: Ensure ROCm backend is enabled via VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=rocm.

patterns.re: warning: performance degradation, not using MFMA for PagedAttention
patterns.summary: vLLM compiled without MI300X MFMA matrix core support.
patterns.action: Compile vLLM with MI300X specific flags (gfx942).

patterns.re: error: custom allreduce requires ROCm IPC support
patterns.summary: vLLM custom allreduce kernel failed to build on ROCm.
patterns.action: Disable custom allreduce or update ROCm RDMA libraries.

patterns.re: error: AWQ kernel not implemented for ROCm
patterns.summary: AWQ quantization kernels missing HIP implementation.
patterns.action: Use Marlin or GPTQ which have ROCm support, or update vLLM.

patterns.re: error: FlashInfer is not supported on ROCm
patterns.summary: Attempted to build vLLM with FlashInfer backend on AMD.
patterns.action: Set VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=ROCM_FLASH.

patterns.re: error: RoPE kernel launch bounds exceeded
patterns.summary: Rotary embedding kernel requested too many threads per block.
patterns.action: Tune max_threads_per_block for MI300X in RoPE kernel.

patterns.re: error: hipEventElapsedTime requires events to be recorded
patterns.summary: HIP event synchronization failure in vLLM profiling code.
patterns.action: Ensure hipEventRecord is called on the correct stream.

patterns.summary: vLLM requires xformers for some kernels, but xformers ROCm build failed.
patterns.action: Build xformers from source with ROCm support.

patterns.summary: torch.compile failed on vLLM PagedAttention custom op.
patterns.action: Disable torch.compile for the attention layer in vLLM.

patterns.re: error: KV cache pointer not aligned to 128 bytes
patterns.summary: MI300X memory coalescing requires strict alignment for KV cache.
patterns.action: Ensure KV cache block allocator uses 128-byte alignment.

patterns.re: error: Fused CPU Adam requires AVX512 or AVX2
patterns.summary: CPU Adam compilation failed during DeepSpeed ROCm install.
patterns.action: Install required C++ compiler with AVX support on the host.

patterns.re: error: hipcc failed to compile fused_adam
patterns.summary: DeepSpeed fused Adam GPU kernel failed to compile on ROCm.
patterns.action: Set DS_BUILD_FUSED_ADAM=1 and ensure ROCm environment is active.

patterns.re: error: transformer_inference not supported on ROCm
patterns.summary: DeepSpeed inference kernels lack ROCm implementation in this version.
patterns.action: Use DeepSpeed version with complete ROCm support for inference.

patterns.summary: Torch hipify tool not found during DeepSpeed install.
patterns.action: Ensure PyTorch ROCm version is installed before installing DeepSpeed.

patterns.re: fatal error: csrc\/includes\/custom_cuda_layers\.h: No such file
patterns.summary: DeepSpeed source headers missing or path incorrect during build.
patterns.action: Check if git submodules are initialized or DeepSpeed repo is intact.

patterns.re: error: libaio-dev is required for asynchronous IO
patterns.summary: Asynchronous IO extension failed to compile.
patterns.action: Run apt-get install libaio-dev before building DeepSpeed.

patterns.summary: Type mismatch in DeepSpeed quantization kernel on ROCm.
patterns.action: Apply cast to correct type in the custom kernel source.

patterns.summary: Sparse attention op failed because Triton ROCm backend is missing.
patterns.action: Install triton-rocm package.

patterns.re: error: MoE gating kernel exceeded max registers
patterns.summary: Mixture of Experts routing kernel used too many registers on MI300X.
patterns.action: Add __launch_bounds__ to MoE kernel to limit register usage.

patterns.summary: DeepSpeed pinned memory extension failed to build or link.
patterns.action: Ensure hip runtime is linked and host has sufficient memory permissions.

patterns.re: clang: error: unable to execute command: Segmentation fault
patterns.summary: HIP clang crashed during instruction scheduling for MI300X.
patterns.action: Reduce optimization level to -O2 or split large kernels.

patterns.summary: LLVM backend ran out of memory compiling a massive kernel.
patterns.action: Increase swap size or reduce ninja build threads.

patterns.re: fatal error: error in backend: DAG combiner crashed
patterns.summary: Internal Compiler Error in LLVM DAG combiner on ROCm.
patterns.action: Disable specific LLVM optimizations or update ROCm toolkit.

patterns.summary: Unsupported image load intrinsic generated for compute-only MI300X.
patterns.action: Use buffer loads instead of image loads in the kernel.

patterns.re: LLVM ERROR: Error while trying to spill register
patterns.summary: LLVM register allocator failed to spill registers.
patterns.action: Refactor kernel to reduce register pressure.

patterns.re: clang: error: stack overflow during template instantiation
patterns.summary: Deep template instantiation blew the compiler stack.
patterns.action: Increase compiler thread stack size.

patterns.re: LLVM ERROR: LTO code generation failed
patterns.summary: Link Time Optimization crashed linking HIP device code.
patterns.action: Disable LTO by removing -flto from HIPCC flags.

patterns.re: fatal error: error in backend: Cannot select: t[0-9]+: i32 = AMDGPUISD::BFE
patterns.summary: AMDGPU backend failed to select BFE (Bit Field Extract) instruction.
patterns.action: Rewrite bitwise operations to avoid compiler bugs in this LLVM version.

patterns.re: LLVM ERROR: Inline asm not supported by this instruction set
patterns.summary: Invalid inline assembly string for gfx942 target.
patterns.action: Fix inline assembly syntax or use built-in intrinsics.

patterns.re: LLVM ERROR: debug info generation crashed
patterns.summary: Compiler crashed while emitting DWARF debug info for device code.
patterns.action: Compile without -g flag for device code.

patterns.re: error: rocBLAS library does not support gfx942
patterns.summary: rocBLAS installed does not include MI300X kernels.
patterns.action: Install the correct rocBLAS build containing gfx942 support.

patterns.re: warning: rocBLAS tuning file for gfx942 not found
patterns.summary: rocBLAS performance degraded due to missing tuning database.
patterns.action: Download and install the rocBLAS tuning database for MI300X.

patterns.summary: rocBLAS library not linked during application build.
patterns.action: Add -lrocblas to the linker command.

patterns.re: error: hipblasSgemm wrapper failed to map to rocblas
patterns.summary: hipBLAS failed to initialize rocBLAS backend.
patterns.action: Ensure both hipBLAS and rocBLAS versions are compatible.

patterns.re: error: rocsparse_spmv unsupported matrix format on gfx942
patterns.summary: Specific sparse matrix format not supported on MI300X.
patterns.action: Convert sparse matrix to CSR format before calling rocSPARSE.

patterns.summary: Attempted to use FP8 GEMM on a rocBLAS version without FP8 support.
patterns.action: Update rocBLAS to 6.1+ for FP8 support.

patterns.re: error: rocBLAS workspace size requested exceeds VRAM
patterns.summary: rocBLAS GEMM requested excessive temporary workspace.
patterns.action: Provide a smaller workspace and allow rocBLAS to use a slower algorithm.

patterns.summary: rocBLAS failed to initialize on the device.
patterns.action: Check if ROCm SMI shows the device and user is in the render group.

patterns.summary: Batched GEMM exceeded maximum allowed batches.
patterns.action: Split the batched GEMM into multiple smaller calls.

patterns.re: error: cusparseSpMM cannot be automatically translated
patterns.summary: Hipify failed to translate generic cuSPARSE API to rocSPARSE.
patterns.action: Manually rewrite the cuSPARSE call using rocSPARSE API.

patterns.re: error: bitsandbytes ROCm backend compilation failed
patterns.summary: BitsAndBytes failed to compile ROCm custom kernels.
patterns.action: Use bitsandbytes-rocm fork or set BNB_ROCM_ARCH=gfx942.

patterns.re: fatal error: cuda\.h: No such file or directory
patterns.summary: BitsAndBytes Makefile attempted to include CUDA header on ROCm.
patterns.action: Run the hipify script on BNB source before compiling.

patterns.re: error: 8-bit quantization kernel lacks MI300X DP4A equivalent
patterns.summary: DP4A integer dot product instruction missing on AMD.
patterns.action: Use AMD-specific v_dot4_i32_i8 intrinsic in BNB kernels.

patterns.re: error: hipMemPool_t is not supported in this ROCm version
patterns.summary: BNB attempted to use CUDA memory pools via HIP, which failed.
patterns.action: Disable memory pools in BNB or upgrade ROCm.

patterns.re: make: \*\*\* No rule to make target 'hip_version'
patterns.summary: BitsAndBytes Makefile does not have a ROCm/HIP target.
patterns.action: Use the specific ROCm build script provided in the BNB repository.

patterns.re: ImportError: libbitsandbytes_rocm\.so: cannot open shared object file
patterns.summary: Compiled BitsAndBytes ROCm library not found in Python path.
patterns.action: Copy the compiled .so file to the bitsandbytes Python module directory.

patterns.re: error: 4-bit block-wise quantization not implemented for ROCm
patterns.summary: 4-bit quantization kernels not fully ported to ROCm.
patterns.action: Update to the latest bitsandbytes-rocm multi-backend version.

patterns.re: error: block size must be a multiple of wavefront size
patterns.summary: BNB kernel block size is 32, but AMD requires 64.
patterns.action: Change kernel launch configuration to use block sizes multiple of 64.

patterns.summary: BNB build script invoked NVIDIA ptxas instead of AMD compiler.
patterns.action: Set the compiler to hipcc in the BNB build environment.

patterns.summary: CUDA warp shuffle sync not correctly hipified.
patterns.action: Replace with HIP warp shuffle functions.

patterns.re: error: HIP IPC not supported on this topology
patterns.summary: RCCL failed to build IPC support for the MI300X topology.
patterns.action: Ensure PCIe ACS is disabled and IOMMU is configured correctly.

patterns.summary: Residual NVIDIA NVLink code conflicting with RCCL XGMI macros.
patterns.action: Clean the build directory and use pure RCCL source.

patterns.summary: AWS OFI plugin for RCCL failed to compile.
patterns.action: Install libfabric-dev and ensure MPI headers are available.

patterns.summary: RCCL requires ROCm SMI headers to build topology detection.
patterns.action: Install rocm-smi-lib-dev package.

patterns.summary: Mellanox SHARP/HCOLL headers conflicting with RCCL.
patterns.action: Disable HCOLL support in RCCL CMake if not used.

patterns.re: error: RCCL kernels not compiled for gfx942
patterns.summary: RCCL built without MI300X specific reduction kernels.
patterns.action: Set AMDGPU_TARGETS=gfx942 during RCCL CMake configuration.

patterns.summary: Slurm/Cray PMI integration failed to build for RCCL.
patterns.action: Install libpmi2-dev or disable PMI in RCCL build.

patterns.summary: HIP IPC event handles missing in this ROCm version.
patterns.action: Upgrade ROCm to a version that supports full HIP IPC events.

patterns.summary: RCCL GPU Direct RDMA support failed to build.
patterns.action: Install gdrcopy headers or disable GDR in RCCL build.

patterns.re: error: MSCCL is not currently supported on ROCm
patterns.summary: Microsoft Custom Collective Library backend failed to compile in RCCL.
patterns.action: Use standard RCCL algorithms instead of MSCCL.

patterns.re: error: MLIR lowering to ROCDL failed
patterns.summary: XLA compiler failed to lower MLIR to ROCm Device Library.
patterns.action: Update JAX/XLA to a version with updated ROCDL dialects.

patterns.re: fatal error: cannot find ROCm device library bitcode
patterns.summary: XLA could not find ROCm LLVM bitcode files.
patterns.action: Set ROCM_PATH and ensure rocm-device-libs is installed.

patterns.re: error: OOM during HLO to LLVM IR conversion
patterns.summary: Host ran out of memory compiling a massive XLA HLO graph.
patterns.action: Increase host RAM or enable XLA compilation caching.

patterns.re: error: custom_call 'cuDNN' not supported on ROCm
patterns.summary: XLA graph contains NVIDIA-specific cuDNN custom call.
patterns.action: Ensure XLA targets MIOpen instead of cuDNN on ROCm.

patterns.re: error: XLA target architecture 'gfx942' is invalid
patterns.summary: XLA build lacks support for MI300X.
patterns.action: Compile JAX/XLA from source with explicitly enabled gfx942 support.

patterns.summary: ConnectX-7 NIC firmware failed during RCCL network init.
patterns.action: Update NIC firmware or reset the Mellanox interface.

patterns.summary: Failed to create Completion Queue for RDMA transfers.
patterns.action: Increase locked memory limits (ulimit -l).

patterns.summary: XGMI hive initialization failed due to topology error.
patterns.action: Verify all GPUs report same XGMI hive ID in ROCm SMI.

patterns.re: amdgpu: device not in xgmi hive
patterns.summary: GPU failed to join the global XGMI communication hive.
patterns.action: Verify motherboard BIOS settings for Infinity Fabric.

patterns.summary: ROCr memory pool allocation failed.
patterns.action: Check GPU memory usage and fragmentation.

patterns.summary: HIP runtime called before initialization.
patterns.action: Ensure torch.cuda.init() is implicitly or explicitly called.

patterns.summary: PyTorch watchdog terminated hung RCCL collective.
patterns.action: Increase TORCH_NCCL_BLOCKING_WAIT timeout.

patterns.summary: init_process_group failed to bootstrap.
patterns.action: Verify MASTER_ADDR and MASTER_PORT environment variables.

patterns.summary: PyTorch attempted to use a destroyed HIP stream or event.
patterns.action: Avoid sharing HIP events across multiple threads incorrectly.

patterns.summary: Parameter all-gather timed out in DeepSpeed.
patterns.action: Check network bandwidth or node health.

patterns.re: DeepSpeed: CPU offload failed to pin memory
patterns.summary: Host memory pinning failed for ZeRO CPU offload.
patterns.action: Increase memlock limits in the OS.

patterns.re: K8s: Device plugin failed to allocate MI300X
patterns.summary: AMD k8s device plugin failed to attach GPU to pod.
patterns.action: Restart amd-gpu-device-plugin DaemonSet.

patterns.summary: Process killed for exceeding requested GPU memory.
patterns.action: Ensure multi-tenant isolation constraints are respected.

patterns.re: dmesg: NMI watchdog: BUG: soft lockup
patterns.summary: Kernel soft lockup likely due to GPU driver spinlock.
patterns.action: Review stack trace for amdgpu involvement and patch.

patterns.re: RCCL WARN: Failed to map memory for P2P
patterns.summary: RCCL could not map memory for Peer-to-Peer access.
patterns.action: Ensure GPUs support P2P and iommu=pt is set.

patterns.re: RCCL WARN: socket connect failed: Connection refused
patterns.summary: RCCL bootstrap socket connection was refused.
patterns.action: Ensure no firewalls block intra-node socket ports.

patterns.re: RCCL WARN: Watchdog triggered on rank 0
patterns.summary: Rank 0 timed out waiting for collective completion.
patterns.action: Identify straggler node causing the collective stall.

patterns.re: rccl: Ring \d+ broken between GPU \d+ and \d+
patterns.summary: RCCL failed to form a complete ring due to a broken XGMI link.
patterns.action: Check XGMI link status with rocm-smi and reset the GPU or node.

patterns.re: RCCL Internal error: XGMI link missing for rank \d+
patterns.summary: RCCL cannot detect expected XGMI links for MI300X topology.
patterns.action: Ensure HSA_OVERRIDE_NUMA is not masking devices and run rocminfo.

patterns.re: RCCL Topology graph has unexpected cycle in XGMI routing
patterns.summary: Improper UBB topology configuration caused a routing cycle.
patterns.action: Update UBB firmware to latest version and re-init topology.

patterns.re: librccl-net: Failed to initialize XGMI paths
patterns.summary: RCCL network plugin failed to map XGMI paths correctly.
patterns.action: Set RCCL_ENABLE_XGMI=1 and verify paths in /sys/class/kfd.

patterns.re: Tree routing timeout between node \d+ and \d+ via IF
patterns.summary: RCCL tree collective timed out over Infinity Fabric.
patterns.action: Reduce RCCL tree threshold or check for IF packet drops.

patterns.re: rccl topo: distance mismatch for XGMI peers \d+ and \d+
patterns.summary: RCCL detected unexpected NUMA distance for direct XGMI peers.
patterns.action: Disable ACS in BIOS and update CRAT tables.

patterns.re: RCCL warning: XGMI bandwidth between \d+ and \d+ degraded
patterns.summary: Link speed degraded on XGMI due to signal integrity.
patterns.action: Check for UBB seating issues or run hardware diagnostics.

patterns.re: RCCL no direct path between MI300X OAM \d+ and \d+
patterns.summary: Expected fully-connected IF topology is missing links.
patterns.action: Check amdgpu dmesg for link training failures on boot.

patterns.re: Failed to parse RCCL topo XML for MI300X UBB
patterns.summary: Custom RCCL topology XML is invalid or missing MI300X traits.
patterns.action: Regenerate topology XML using rccl-topo-gen.

patterns.re: RCCL P2P XGMI is disabled, falling back to PCIe
patterns.summary: XGMI P2P is disabled forcing slow PCIe fallback.
patterns.action: Enable XGMI P2P via iommu=pt and pci=realloc in grub.

patterns.summary: RCCL cannot read KFD topology from sysfs.
patterns.action: Ensure amdgpu and amdkfd modules are loaded correctly.

patterns.re: RCCL: XGMI link \d+-\d+ operating at reduced lane width x\d+
patterns.summary: XGMI link trained at a lower lane width than x16.
patterns.action: Schedule node for hardware repair of IF cables/OAM.

patterns.re: Max XGMI hops \d+ exceeded for target \d+
patterns.summary: Routing path exceeds maximum allowed XGMI hops for MI300.
patterns.action: Ensure correct ROCm version for MI300X 8-way connectivity.

patterns.re: IF Peer sync failed during RCCL init on rank \d+
patterns.summary: Infinity Fabric peers failed to synchronize collectives.
patterns.action: Set HSA_ENABLE_SDMA=0 temporarily or reboot node.

patterns.re: RCCL expected 8 MI300X GPUs in XGMI hive, found \d+
patterns.summary: Not all 8 GPUs are enumerated in the XGMI hive.
patterns.action: Check rocm-smi --showtopo for missing GPUs.

patterns.re: amdgpu: XGMI link training failed on node \d+
patterns.summary: Kernel driver failed to train XGMI link during boot.
patterns.action: Cold reboot node; if persistent, replace UBB.

patterns.re: kfd: failed to init XGMI hive for MI300X
patterns.summary: KFD could not initialize the XGMI hive ID.
patterns.action: Check dmesg for AMD-Vi IOMMU errors.

patterns.summary: Infinity Fabric link unexpectedly went down.
patterns.action: Check for thermal throttling or hardware faults on OAM.

patterns.re: amdkfd: Failed to map XGMI memory for peer \d+
patterns.summary: KFD failed to map peer GPU memory over XGMI.
patterns.action: Check BAR size in BIOS; ensure Above 4G Decoding is enabled.

patterns.re: amdgpu: XGMI command timeout on ring \d+
patterns.summary: XGMI command timed out in the kernel driver.
patterns.action: Reset GPU via sysfs or reboot node.

patterns.re: kfd topology: SDMA routing over XGMI unavailable
patterns.summary: SDMA cannot route over XGMI, blocking P2P DMA.
patterns.action: Update AMDGPU firmware package.

patterns.re: amdgpu: Failed to program IF routing table for MI300
patterns.summary: Driver failed to program Infinity Fabric routing table.
patterns.action: Check if SBIOS is up to date for MI300 support.

patterns.re: kfd: peer GPU \d+ unreachable via XGMI
patterns.summary: A specific peer GPU is unreachable via XGMI.
patterns.action: Verify if the GPU is masked by PCIe ACS.

patterns.re: amdgpu: XGMI hive ID mismatch: \w+ vs \w+
patterns.summary: GPUs report different XGMI hive IDs, breaking topology.
patterns.action: Ensure all GPUs are on the same UBB and seated properly.

patterns.re: kfd topology: node \d+ missing from XGMI mesh
patterns.summary: A node is missing from the expected KFD XGMI mesh.
patterns.action: Check rocm-smi for dropped GPUs.

patterns.summary: Automatic recovery of an XGMI link failed.
patterns.action: Requires a hard power cycle of the system.

patterns.re: kfd: IF packet drop detected on port \d+
patterns.summary: Infinity Fabric dropped packets, indicating instability.
patterns.action: Check link error counters; may need hardware replacement.

patterns.re: amdgpu: XGMI link lane downgraded to \d+x
patterns.summary: Hardware automatically downgraded XGMI lanes due to errors.
patterns.action: Check for loose connections or faulty UBB traces.

patterns.re: kfd: Failed to parse CRAT table for MI300X
patterns.summary: KFD could not parse ACPI CRAT table for topology.
patterns.action: Update system BIOS with correct MI300X CRAT payload.

patterns.re: amdgpu: XGMI topology locked, cannot add node
patterns.summary: Topology is locked and a hot-added or reset node cannot join.
patterns.action: Reboot system to re-initialize the XGMI topology.

patterns.re: Hardware error: XGMI link \d+ failed to train
patterns.summary: Physical XGMI link failed to complete training.
patterns.action: Inspect UBB and OAM connectors for dust or damage.

patterns.re: XGMI link \d+: High CRC error rate detected
patterns.summary: Burst of CRC errors on XGMI link indicating signal issues.
patterns.action: Lower link speed via sysfs for stability or replace hardware.

patterns.summary: XGMI lane reversal negotiation failed.
patterns.action: Update UBB firmware or replace failing OAM.

patterns.re: XGMI SerDes init failed on port \d+
patterns.summary: Serializer/Deserializer failed to initialize for XGMI.
patterns.action: Power cycle chassis; check SMC logs.

patterns.summary: XGMI link is rapidly going up and down.
patterns.action: Check system thermals; thermal expansion can cause loose contacts.

patterns.re: XGMI correctable error storm on link \d+
patterns.summary: Massive number of correctable XGMI errors.
patterns.action: Monitor via EDAC; schedule maintenance if rate increases.

patterns.re: XGMI fatal uncorrectable error on link \d+
patterns.summary: Uncorrectable data error on XGMI link causing reset.
patterns.action: Replace the GPU module connected to this link.

patterns.re: XGMI PHY PLL lock failed for link \d+
patterns.summary: Physical layer PLL could not lock on XGMI link.
patterns.action: Hardware fault; replace UBB or OAM.

patterns.re: XGMI consumed poison data on link \d+
patterns.summary: Poisoned data (from memory error) was routed over XGMI.
patterns.action: Identify source memory fault and replace affected DIMM/HBM.

patterns.re: XGMI link \d+ width degraded from 16 to 8
patterns.summary: Hardware downgraded link width due to lane failures.
patterns.action: Clean OAM pins and reseat; if fails, replace.

patterns.summary: The peer GPU signaled a fault on the XGMI link.
patterns.action: Check logs on the remote peer GPU for local faults.

patterns.re: XGMI link \d+: ACK timeout during transaction
patterns.summary: Transaction over XGMI timed out waiting for ACK.
patterns.action: Check for system hangs or heavy congestion.

patterns.summary: Too many errors caused XGMI replay buffer to fill up.
patterns.action: Indicates severe signal integrity issues. Replace hardware.

patterns.summary: XGMI link ran out of credits, stalling traffic.
patterns.action: Reset GPU and check for routing deadlocks.

patterns.re: XGMI link \d+: Lane margin test failed
patterns.summary: XGMI lane margining failed during POST.
patterns.action: Firmware issue or hardware degradation. Update firmware first.

patterns.re: Infinity Fabric routing deadlock detected between \w+ and \w+
patterns.summary: Cyclic dependency in IF routing caused a deadlock.
patterns.action: Update ROCm and UBB firmware to fix routing tables.

patterns.re: IF packet CRC error at destination \d+
patterns.summary: Corrupted packet received over Infinity Fabric.
patterns.action: Monitor error rate; may require link retraining.

patterns.re: Access to unmapped IF node \d+ denied
patterns.summary: Attempted to route to an IF node that is not in the topology.
patterns.action: Check RCCL topology configuration for stale nodes.

patterns.re: IF routing table corruption detected on UBB
patterns.summary: Hardware detected corrupted IF routing tables.
patterns.action: Cold boot the node to reload IF routing tables.

patterns.re: IF link \d+ caught in recovery loop
patterns.summary: Infinity Fabric link is repeatedly trying and failing to recover.
patterns.action: Power cycle node and inspect hardware if persistent.

patterns.re: IF port \d+: NACK limit reached, resetting link
patterns.summary: Too many negative acknowledgements caused an IF link reset.
patterns.action: Check for heavy congestion or bad hardware traces.

patterns.re: IF protocol error: unexpected packet type \d+
patterns.summary: Invalid packet type received on Infinity Fabric.
patterns.action: Usually a hardware glitch; reboot and monitor.

patterns.re: IF switch port \d+ hung during routing
patterns.summary: An internal IF switch port stopped responding.
patterns.action: Requires a full system reset to clear switch state.

patterns.summary: Virtual Channel on IF ran out of credits for too long.
patterns.action: Adjust RCCL buffer sizes or update UBB firmware.

patterns.re: IF packet dropped due to severe congestion on port \d+
patterns.summary: IF dropped packets because queues were overflowing.
patterns.action: Throttle application communication frequency.

patterns.re: Unsupported IF routing mode requested by driver
patterns.summary: Driver requested an IF routing mode not supported by HW.
patterns.action: Downgrade driver or update UBB firmware to match.

patterns.summary: Packet header was corrupted in transit over IF.
patterns.action: Replace faulty OAM module generating bad packets.

patterns.re: IF destination peer \w+ not found in routing domain
patterns.summary: Target GPU is not in the current IF routing domain.
patterns.action: Verify rocm-smi topology matches expectations.

patterns.re: SMC: IF routing mismatch between OAMs
patterns.summary: System Management Controller detected inconsistent IF routing.
patterns.action: Reflash SMC and UBB firmware to same baseline.

patterns.summary: IF physical lanes could not synchronize skew.
patterns.action: Hardware fault in IF traces or connectors.

patterns.summary: Error translating between PCIe and XGMI domains.
patterns.action: Check for AER logs in dmesg and reset device.

patterns.re: PCIe ACS blocking XGMI P2P traffic for \w+
patterns.summary: Access Control Services (ACS) in PCIe is blocking P2P.
patterns.action: Disable ACS in BIOS or use pcie_acs_override=downstream.

patterns.re: AER: Fatal error occurred at PCIe-XGMI bridge
patterns.summary: Fatal Advanced Error Reporting (AER) event on the bridge.
patterns.action: Hard reboot node. If frequent, replace motherboard/UBB.

patterns.summary: IOMMU blocked an XGMI memory access.
patterns.action: Set iommu=pt in kernel command line.

patterns.re: XGMI unavailable, falling back to PCIe Gen\d+ x\d+
patterns.summary: XGMI failed, topology degraded to slow PCIe links.
patterns.action: Investigate XGMI failure causes via amdgpu dmesg.

patterns.summary: Bridge received a malformed Transaction Layer Packet.
patterns.action: Update host BIOS and PCIe switch firmware.

patterns.summary: Invalid address accessed across the XGMI-PCIe boundary.
patterns.action: Check for memory leaks or invalid pointers in application.

patterns.re: AER: Correctable error at PCIe-XGMI bridge
patterns.summary: Correctable errors occurring at the bridge interface.
patterns.action: Monitor rates; usually safe to ignore if infrequent.

patterns.summary: Poisoned data crossed from PCIe into XGMI domain.
patterns.action: Identify bad host memory or PCIe device.

patterns.re: Credit deadlock between PCIe and XGMI domains
patterns.summary: Flow control credits deadlocked between interfaces.
patterns.action: Reset GPU; update UBB and PCIe switch firmware.

patterns.re: PCIe-XGMI bridge link unexpectedly went down
patterns.summary: The bridge link dropped without warning.
patterns.action: Check system power delivery and thermals.

patterns.re: DMAR: DRHD: handling fault status reg .* XGMI
patterns.summary: IOMMU DMAR fault related to XGMI traffic.
patterns.action: Disable IOMMU for GPU passthrough via iommu=pt.

patterns.summary: ACS rules violated by XGMI P2P transaction.
patterns.action: Ensure peer-to-peer is fully enabled in BIOS.

patterns.summary: Bridge received an unsupported request.
patterns.action: Ensure ROCm versions match kernel driver versions.

patterns.re: Failed to enumerate PCIe-XGMI bridge devices
patterns.summary: OS failed to find the bridge during PCIe scan.
patterns.action: Check if UBB power is connected and stable.

patterns.re: rocminfo: Node \d+ missing from HSA topology
patterns.summary: rocminfo does not see all expected GPU nodes.
patterns.action: Check dmesg for KFD init errors.

patterns.re: HSA topology: incorrect XGMI weight \d+ for MI300
patterns.summary: HSA reports wrong topological distance/weight for MI300X.
patterns.action: Update rocm-core and hsakmt libraries.

patterns.re: rocm-smi: ERROR: Failed to get topology from sysfs
patterns.summary: rocm-smi cannot read topology files in sysfs.
patterns.action: Reload amdgpu module or run as root.

patterns.summary: HSA API reports P2P is not supported between GPUs.
patterns.action: Check if XGMI links are actually down via rocm-smi.

patterns.re: rocminfo: missing XGMI lane info for node \d+
patterns.summary: XGMI lane count is missing in rocminfo output.
patterns.action: Ensure amdkfd is exporting sysfs properties correctly.

patterns.re: HSA topology: memory access denied between agent \d+ and \d+
patterns.summary: HSA permissions prevent memory sharing between GPUs.
patterns.action: Check for conflicting HSA_OVERRIDE_NUMA settings.

patterns.re: rocm-smi: GPU \d+ is orphaned, no XGMI links active
patterns.summary: GPU has no active XGMI links and is isolated.
patterns.action: Hardware failure likely; replace OAM.

patterns.summary: HSA topology shows a split graph (split brain).
patterns.action: Check for failed links splitting the 8-GPU ring.

patterns.re: rocminfo: Invalid device type in HSA topology for node \d+
patterns.summary: rocminfo parsed an unknown device type.
patterns.action: Update ROCm to a version supporting MI300X.

patterns.summary: Failed to iterate IO links via HSA API.
patterns.action: Restart the application or reset the KFD state.

patterns.re: rocm-smi: XGMI error count \d+ exceeds threshold
patterns.summary: High XGMI error count detected by rocm-smi.
patterns.action: Check link stability and replace UBB if needed.

patterns.summary: Kernel driver did not export xgmi_hops attribute.
patterns.action: Upgrade linux kernel to version with full MI300 support.

patterns.re: rocminfo: NUMA node overlap detected in topology
patterns.summary: Multiple GPUs report the same invalid NUMA node.
patterns.action: Fix ACPI SRAT/CRAT tables in system BIOS.

patterns.re: HSA topology initialization timed out after \d+ ms
patterns.summary: HSA topology took too long to build.
patterns.action: Check for hanging I2C or sysfs reads in the kernel.

patterns.re: rocm-smi: XGMI link status UNKNOWN for GPU \d+
patterns.summary: rocm-smi cannot determine if XGMI link is up.
patterns.action: Update rocm_smi_lib to latest version.

patterns.re: MI300X UBB firmware version mismatch: \w+ vs \w+
patterns.summary: OAMs or SMC have mismatched firmware versions.
patterns.action: Flash all OAMs and UBB to a consistent firmware baseline.

patterns.re: MI300X OAM \d+ power throttled, IF link downgraded
patterns.summary: Severe power throttling caused IF links to downgrade.
patterns.action: Check liquid cooling or fan speeds on the UBB.

patterns.re: UBB XGMI mesh incomplete: missing links \d+-\d+
patterns.summary: The expected MI300X 8-way mesh is missing links.
patterns.action: Hardware failure; reseat the OAMs on the UBB.

patterns.re: MI300X ring routing error on internal IF switch
patterns.summary: Internal routing error on the MI300X UBB switch.
patterns.action: Reset the UBB via baseboard management controller (BMC).

patterns.re: Failed to communicate with UBB SMC over I2C
patterns.summary: Host lost I2C communication with UBB SMC.
patterns.action: Power cycle the chassis; check I2C bus for hangs.

patterns.re: MI300X XGMI lane mapping error on port \w+
patterns.summary: Physical XGMI lanes mapped incorrectly to logical ports.
patterns.action: Update UBB firmware configuration payload.

patterns.re: UBB thermal shutdown triggered by IF switch
patterns.summary: IF switch overheated causing UBB thermal shutdown.
patterns.action: Check cooling loop and thermal paste on IF switches.

patterns.re: MI300X OAM ID conflict: multiple OAMs report ID \d+
patterns.summary: Multiple OAMs claim the same physical ID on the UBB.
patterns.action: Check OAM hardware straps or replace faulty OAM.

patterns.re: UBB IF PLL unstable, high jitter detected
patterns.summary: High clock jitter detected on Infinity Fabric PLL.
patterns.action: Hardware fault; replace the Universal Base Board.

patterns.re: MI300X topology ROM corrupt or unreadable
patterns.summary: Topology ROM on UBB is corrupted.
patterns.action: Reflash topology ROM via BMC.

patterns.re: UBB POWER_GOOD dropped during IF link training
patterns.summary: Power drop caused IF link training to abort.
patterns.action: Check PSU sizing and power cables to UBB.

patterns.re: MI300X XGMI bifurcation failed on host port \d+
patterns.summary: XGMI port bifurcation failed to configure correctly.
patterns.action: Check BIOS PCIe/XGMI bifurcation settings.

patterns.summary: Not all 8 MI300X OAMs are detected by the UBB.
patterns.action: Reseat the missing OAM or replace it.

patterns.re: MI300X IF redriver initialization failed on UBB
patterns.summary: Signal redriver on UBB failed to initialize.
patterns.action: Hardware fault; requires UBB replacement.

patterns.summary: Peer discovery over XGMI timed out at the UBB level.
patterns.action: Cold boot node; check UBB firmware logs.
