patterns.re: SerDes CDR loss of lock on lane \d+ .* ICI link down
patterns.summary: Clock Data Recovery failed on the serial interface.
patterns.action: Reset SerDes and perform link training.

patterns.re: ICI link training failed to negotiate .* Gbps
patterns.summary: Auto-negotiation for maximum link speed failed.
patterns.action: Hard reset the network interface and retry training.

patterns.re: MAC layer local fault detected on ICI port
patterns.summary: Media Access Control block reported a hardware fault.
patterns.action: Perform ASIC soft reset.

patterns.re: TX credit starvation .* no credits received from downstream
patterns.summary: Downstream node stopped returning buffer credits.
patterns.action: Check downstream node for hangs or kernel panics.

patterns.re: Egress queue \d+ stuck for \d+ ms .* clearing queue
patterns.summary: A hardware queue locked up and was forcefully purged.
patterns.action: Resend dropped traffic; monitor for hardware faults.

patterns.re: gasket: host-to-device FIFO full .* dropping ICI config
patterns.summary: Kernel driver failed to write network configuration to device.
patterns.action: Slow down configuration requests from user space.

patterns.re: accel\/tpu: mailbox command to ICI firmware timed out
patterns.summary: The embedded firmware managing ICI stopped responding.
patterns.action: Reset device to reload firmware.

patterns.re: Firmware rejected ICI routing config .* error code \d+
patterns.summary: User-space requested an invalid network topology.
patterns.action: Verify the LibTPU topology configuration matches physical layout.

patterns.re: CollectivePermute stalled .* missing data from source replica \d+
patterns.summary: Point-to-point communication dropped a message.
patterns.action: Verify the health of the specific source replica link.

patterns.re: libtpu: ICI heartbeat monitor failed for neighbor \d+
patterns.summary: A directly connected neighbor stopped responding.
patterns.action: Check the adjacent TPU VM for kernel panic or hardware failure.

patterns.re: Megascale: controller lost heartbeat from worker \d+ over ICI
patterns.summary: Cluster controller lost contact with a worker via the data plane.
patterns.action: Check if worker crashed or if the network partitioned.

patterns.re: Data parallel gradients sync deadlock detected on ICI
patterns.summary: Mismatched gradient shapes caused a network deadlock.
patterns.action: Verify model architecture and dynamic shapes across replicas.

patterns.re: Ray\/Kubernetes orchestrator detects network partition in TPU slice
patterns.summary: Multiple link failures isolated a subset of the TPU pods.
patterns.action: Restart the job on a completely healthy cluster slice.

patterns.re: Accelerate: Cross-node synchronization failed via TPU backend
patterns.summary: HuggingFace Accelerate failed to sync gradients.
patterns.action: Ensure Accelerate is configured for XLA/TPU and not standard NCCL.

patterns.re: Resource exhausted:.*HLO memory allocation failed for module.*
patterns.summary: Peak memory exceeded during HLO buffer allocation.
patterns.action: Increase gradient accumulation steps or enable rematerialization.

patterns.re: Resource exhausted:.*failed to allocate.*due to fragmentation
patterns.summary: Memory fragmentation prevents allocating a contiguous block.
patterns.action: Adjust batch size or use a more aggressive memory defragmentation pass.

patterns.summary: Invalid buffer aliasing annotations in HLO module.
patterns.action: Fix custom call aliasing metadata or disable the pass.

patterns.summary: Rematerialization pass failed to reduce memory below threshold.
patterns.action: Use activation checkpointing at the framework level.

patterns.summary: Buffer assignment took too long on a highly complex graph.
patterns.action: Simplify the model graph or increase the XLA compilation timeout.

patterns.re: Heap simulator failed to find allocation.*
patterns.summary: Heap simulator could not satisfy the allocation constraints.
patterns.action: Check for exceptionally large tensor allocations.

patterns.summary: Liveness analysis failed due to unsupported control flow.
patterns.action: Remove unsupported dynamic while loops or conditionals.

patterns.summary: Excessive memory used for deep tuple structures.
patterns.action: Flatten tuple structures before passing to XLA.

patterns.summary: Overlapping buffers in async collective communication.
patterns.action: Ensure distinct buffers for async communication ops.

patterns.summary: Buffer alignment requirement exceeds hardware capability.
patterns.action: Check custom op padding and alignment constraints.

patterns.summary: Graph cycle would be created by fusing operations.
patterns.action: Disable specific fusion passes or refactor graph structure.

patterns.summary: Fusing multiple outputs resulted in massive intermediate tensor.
patterns.action: Disable multi-output fusion with XLA flags.

patterns.summary: Unsupported fusion of a dot operation with non-elementwise op.
patterns.action: Ensure elementwise ops are separable from dot operations.

patterns.summary: Too many operations fused into a single kernel.
patterns.action: Lower the maximum fusion node limit.

patterns.summary: Custom calls cannot be fused with standard HLO ops.
patterns.action: Keep custom calls isolated in the compute graph.

patterns.summary: Mismatched shapes when fusing multiple reductions.
patterns.action: Check reduction axes for consistency.

patterns.summary: Scatter operations cannot be safely fused in this context.
patterns.action: Avoid fusing scatter with dynamic update slice.

patterns.summary: Loop fusion aborted due to excessive computational complexity.
patterns.action: Simplify loop bodies.

patterns.summary: Fusing broadcast caused materialization of massive tensor.
patterns.action: Disable broadcast fusion for large expansions.

patterns.summary: Backend code generator failed to emit code for fused kernel.
patterns.action: Report bug to XLA team or disable specific fusion.

patterns.summary: Incompatible layouts between LHS and RHS of dot operation.
patterns.action: Insert explicit transposes or let XLA auto-assign layouts.

patterns.summary: Operation requires a specific layout not provided.
patterns.action: Check hardware layout constraints for the operation.

patterns.summary: Layout assignment entered an infinite loop injecting transposes.
patterns.action: Constrain layouts manually or simplify tensor ranks.

patterns.summary: Tensor layout is incompatible with TPU Megacore requirements.
patterns.action: Ensure tensor dimensions are divisible by Megacore tile sizes.

patterns.summary: Custom call expects a specific layout that was not met.
patterns.action: Update custom call metadata with correct layout constraints.

patterns.summary: Layout assignment took too long on complex graph.
patterns.action: Reduce graph complexity or rank of tensors.

patterns.summary: Conflicting layout constraints for VMT and VMF operations.
patterns.action: Adjust tensor shapes to align with hardware tiles.

patterns.summary: Spatial dimensions are not in the expected layout order.
patterns.action: Ensure NHWC or NCHW layouts match hardware defaults.

patterns.summary: Bitcast source and destination have incompatible layouts.
patterns.action: Remove invalid bitcast or insert reshape.

patterns.re: Tuple layout mismatch in while loop.*
patterns.summary: While loop input and output tuples have different layouts.
patterns.action: Ensure loop carries consistent layouts.

patterns.summary: Could not propagate sharding annotations through the graph.
patterns.action: Add explicit sharding annotations to intermediate tensors.

patterns.summary: Halo exchange is not supported for this convolution padding.
patterns.action: Use supported padding types for spatial partitioning.

patterns.summary: Could not fuse collective operations due to dependency cycles.
patterns.action: Ensure collectives can be legally reordered.

patterns.summary: AllReduce operations have mismatched reduction axes.
patterns.action: Check sharding specifications for consistency.

patterns.summary: Replica groups do not map to valid hardware subcommunicators.
patterns.action: Ensure replica groups match TPU topology.

patterns.summary: AllGather operation materialized a buffer larger than HBM.
patterns.action: Use ReduceScatter or smaller batch sizes.

patterns.summary: Conflicting sharding annotations on a single tensor.
patterns.action: Resolve contradictory sharding rules.

patterns.summary: Implicit cross-partition copies are not supported here.
patterns.action: Insert explicit collective operations.

patterns.summary: SPMD partitioner took too long to resolve constraints.
patterns.action: Simplify sharding annotations.

patterns.summary: ReduceScatter output shape does not match partitioned shape.
patterns.action: Check dimension sizes for divisibility by partition count.

patterns.summary: AllToAll scatter/gather pattern doesn't fit the torus.
patterns.action: Use supported AllToAll patterns for this TPU topology.

patterns.summary: Async collectives scheduled in an order that causes deadlock.
patterns.action: Force correct sequencing using control dependencies.

patterns.summary: Collective broadcast operation is not supported.
patterns.action: Use AllGather or explicit host-to-device communication.

patterns.re: Invalid source target pair in Permute.*
patterns.summary: Permute operation has an invalid source/target pair.
patterns.action: Ensure permute targets match active replica IDs.

patterns.summary: Mismatch in the number of participants for a collective op.
patterns.action: Check replica groups for uniformity.

patterns.summary: Attempted to use NCCL on TPU which is unsupported.
patterns.action: Use XLA native collectives instead of NCCL.

patterns.summary: Timeout while lowering collectives to hardware instructions.
patterns.action: Simplify collective communication patterns.

patterns.summary: ReduceScatter does not support the given data type.
patterns.action: Cast to a supported type before ReduceScatter.

patterns.summary: AllGather axis size must be a multiple of shard count.
patterns.action: Pad tensor to be divisible by shard count.

patterns.summary: Mismatch in shapes for CrossReplicaSum.
patterns.action: Ensure all replicas provide identical shapes.

patterns.summary: Dynamic spatial dimensions are not supported for convolution.

patterns.action: Enable ReBAR and disable PCIe ACS.

patterns.summary: Motherboard chipset does not support PCIe P2P between these slots.
patterns.action: Move GPUs to slots connected to the same root complex or PLX.

patterns.summary: NCCL routing local GPU traffic through NIC (loopback) due to broken PCIe P2P.
patterns.action: Fix local PCIe P2P configuration to avoid NIC loopback bottleneck.

patterns.summary: GPUDirect Storage saturating PCIe bus, starving NCCL/GPU-to-GPU traffic.
patterns.action: Limit GDS read bandwidth or isolate storage/NIC PCIe lanes.

patterns.re: cufile: WARN: falling back to bounce buffer
patterns.summary: GDS falling back to CPU bounce buffers due to BAR1 limits, halving PCIe throughput.
patterns.action: Enable ReBAR to allow full GDS direct memory access.

patterns.re: cufile: WARN: NVMe and GPU on different NUMA
patterns.summary: NVMe drives and H100 are on different NUMA nodes, causing cross-socket PCIe congestion.
patterns.action: Align NVMe storage and GPUs to the same NUMA node.

patterns.re: cufile: ERROR: IOMMU fault during DMA
patterns.summary: IOMMU blocking direct NVMe-to-GPU DMA transfers.
patterns.action: Disable IOMMU or set iommu=pt for GDS compatibility.

patterns.re: cufile: WARN: P2P blocked by ACS
patterns.summary: ACS preventing P2P from NVMe to GPU over the PCIe switch.
patterns.action: Disable ACS on the PCIe switch connecting NVMe and GPU.

patterns.summary: Multiple Gen4 NVMe drives overwhelming the Gen5 PCIe uplink to the CPU.
patterns.action: Balance NVMe drives across multiple PCIe root complexes.

patterns.re: cufile: WARN: UVM migrations conflicting with GDS
patterns.summary: Concurrent UVM page faults and GDS transfers thrashing the PCIe bus.
patterns.action: Avoid using UVM and GDS simultaneously on the same GPU.

patterns.summary: Using unpinned (pageable) memory forces CPU to bounce-buffer, halving PCIe bandwidth.
patterns.action: Use cudaMallocHost (pinned memory) for all Host-to-Device transfers.

patterns.summary: Synchronous memory copies blocking the GPU pipeline and underutilizing PCIe bandwidth.
patterns.action: Use cudaMemcpyAsync with CUDA streams.

patterns.summary: Thousands of small PCIe transfers causing massive protocol overhead.
patterns.action: Batch data into larger contiguous memory blocks before cudaMemcpy.

patterns.re: perf: high CPU usage in page_fault
patterns.summary: High page fault overhead during PCIe transfers from unmapped host memory.
patterns.action: Pre-fault or mlock host memory before initiating PCIe transfers.

patterns.summary: CPU memory bandwidth is the bottleneck for Host-to-Device PCIe transfers.
patterns.action: Upgrade CPU memory to faster DDR5 or use multi-channel memory.

patterns.summary: Simultaneous massive H2D and D2H transfers causing PCIe congestion.
patterns.action: Stagger Host-to-Device and Device-to-Host transfers if full duplex is bottlenecked.

patterns.summary: CPU PCIe Root Complex bandwidth maxed out by simultaneous GPU and NIC traffic.
patterns.action: Distribute GPUs and NICs across multiple CPU sockets/root complexes.

patterns.summary: InfiniBand NIC and H100 sharing the same PCIe root port, splitting bandwidth.
patterns.action: Move NIC to a dedicated PCIe root port.

patterns.summary: Data routed through the narrow DMI chipset link instead of direct CPU PCIe lanes.
patterns.action: Ensure H100 and high-speed NICs are in CPU-attached PCIe slots, not chipset slots.

patterns.summary: PCIe switch upstream port to CPU bottlenecked by multiple GPUs.
patterns.action: Optimize workloads to use local P2P within the switch instead of CPU memory.

patterns.summary: PCIe root port throwing errors under heavy congestion.
patterns.action: Update motherboard BIOS and check PCIe lane bifurcation settings.

patterns.summary: Interleaved NUMA memory causing chaotic cross-root-port PCIe traffic.
patterns.action: Disable NUMA node interleaving and pin memory strictly.

patterns.summary: IOMMU on the root port thrashing TLB during massive PCIe transfers.
patterns.action: Use hugepages to reduce IOTLB thrashing on the root port.

patterns.re: NVRM: vGPU VF bandwidth limit exceeded
patterns.summary: SR-IOV Virtual Function hitting hypervisor-imposed PCIe bandwidth limit.
patterns.action: Increase or remove PCIe bandwidth QoS limits in the hypervisor.

patterns.summary: vGPU mediated device translation overhead bottlenecking PCIe transfers.
patterns.action: Switch to SR-IOV direct passthrough instead of mediated vGPU.

patterns.summary: Extended Page Table (EPT) violations during PCIe DMA into VM memory.
patterns.action: Enable IOMMU passthrough and hugepages in the hypervisor.

patterns.summary: Guest OS causing MMIO faults on PCIe BARs, dropping bandwidth.
patterns.action: Ensure guest OS supports ReBAR and Above 4G Decoding.

patterns.re: ESXi: ACS strict mode preventing P2P
patterns.summary: Hypervisor strict ACS settings blocking P2P between VFs.
patterns.action: Relax ACS settings in hypervisor to allow VF-to-VF P2P.

patterns.summary: vGPU timeslice scheduler interrupting long PCIe DMA transfers.
patterns.action: Configure vGPU profile for compute.

patterns.summary: NIC VF dropping RDMA packets, causing PCIe retries and bandwidth drop.
patterns.action: Disable MAC anti-spoofing for trusted VFs in the hypervisor.

patterns.re: kernel: pci .* LTR: Latency Tolerance Reporting
patterns.summary: LTR mechanism artificially throttling PCIe bandwidth to save power.
patterns.action: Disable LTR in BIOS or kernel (pcie_port_pm=off).

patterns.summary: Excessive LTR messages clogging the PCIe bus.
patterns.action: Disable LTR via setpci or BIOS.

patterns.re: nvidia-smi -q: Clocks Throttle Reasons : HW Slowdown
patterns.summary: GPU clock throttling triggered by PCIe LTR limits.
patterns.action: Disable LTR and ASPM to prevent hardware slowdowns.

patterns.re: kernel: ASPM L1.2 and LTR conflict
patterns.summary: Conflict between ASPM and LTR causing massive latency spikes.
patterns.action: Disable both ASPM and LTR for H100 compute nodes.

patterns.re: pcieport: LTR rejected by Root Complex
patterns.summary: Root complex rejecting LTR messages, causing PCIe link resets.
patterns.action: Disable LTR natively in the operating system.

patterns.summary: Max snoop latency exceeded, forcing PCIe link into lower power state.
patterns.action: Adjust max snoop latency in sysfs or disable LTR.

patterns.summary: Guest OS setting aggressive LTR limits causing vGPU PCIe stalls.
patterns.action: Mask LTR capability from guest VM in hypervisor.

patterns.summary: MSI-X interrupt storm over PCIe bus saturating CPU and halting transfers.
patterns.action: Update NIC/GPU drivers or adjust irqbalance.

patterns.summary: Device fell back to legacy INTx interrupts, massive PCIe overhead.
patterns.action: Ensure MSI-X is enabled and supported by the hypervisor/OS.

patterns.re: perf: high CPU usage in irq
patterns.summary: All PCIe MSI-X interrupts pinned to a single CPU core, bottlenecking DMA.
patterns.action: Distribute interrupts across CPU cores using irqbalance or set_irq_affinity.

patterns.summary: GPU IRQ handler taking too long due to PCIe congestion.
patterns.action: Profile PCIe bandwidth and reduce concurrent small transfers.

patterns.summary: InfiniBand Completion Queue Entry storm overwhelming PCIe bandwidth.
patterns.action: Enable interrupt coalescing on the NIC (ethtool -C).

patterns.summary: GPUDirect RDMA causing interrupt storm on the PCIe bus.
patterns.action: Tune RDMA polling vs interrupt settings in NCCL/MPI.

patterns.summary: Continuous AER interrupts consuming all PCIe bandwidth.
patterns.action: Mask AER correctable errors in kernel (pci=noaer) or fix hardware.

patterns.re: Rank of CuTensorMap mismatch with cute::Tensor
patterns.summary: CuTensorMap rank differs from cute::Tensor rank.
patterns.action: Match CuTensorMap rank with tensor shape.

patterns.re: Invalid swizzle mode for TMA descriptor
patterns.summary: Unsupported swizzle format used in TMA.
patterns.action: Use valid 32B, 64B, or 128B swizzle modes.

patterns.summary: Invalid data type provided to TMA encode.
patterns.action: Use supported TMA data types.

patterns.re: Mbarrier arrival count mismatch in multicast cluster
patterns.summary: Mbarrier arrival count does not match thread count.
patterns.action: Fix mbarrier initialization thread count.

patterns.re: TMA mcast transactions incomplete at synchronization
patterns.summary: TMA transactions unfinished at barrier wait.
patterns.action: Ensure tx bytes match expected fetch size.

patterns.summary: mbarrier.init called with invalid thread count.
patterns.action: Pass valid thread count to mbarrier.init.

patterns.summary: Unsupported reduction op in PTX bulk tensor.
patterns.action: Avoid using TMA for this specific reduction.

patterns.re: Cutlass Sm90 epilogue unsupported TMA swizzle
patterns.summary: Unsupported swizzle in Cutlass Sm90 epilogue.
patterns.action: Use supported swizzle in epilogue.

patterns.re: Prologue prefetch bytes mismatch TMA expected
patterns.summary: Prefetch byte count differs from TMA expected bytes.
patterns.action: Match prefetch size with expected TMA bytes.

patterns.re: TMA store incompatible with accumulator type
patterns.summary: Accumulator type incompatible with TMA store.
patterns.action: Cast accumulator to supported type before TMA store.

patterns.re: Inductor codegen failed to initialize cuTensorMap
patterns.summary: PyTorch Inductor failed to init cuTensorMap.
patterns.action: Check tensor shape and layout for Inductor codegen.

patterns.summary: Pointer arithmetic overflowed 32-bit limits.
patterns.action: Enable 64-bit pointer arithmetic in Triton.

patterns.re: NCCL TMA P2P access invalid across NVLink
patterns.summary: Invalid P2P access via TMA over NVLink.
patterns.action: Disable TMA P2P or fix NVLink topology.

patterns.re: CollNet does not support TMA offload
patterns.summary: TMA offload attempted with unsupported CollNet.
patterns.action: Disable CollNet when using TMA offload.

patterns.re: Allreduce via TMA is currently unsupported
patterns.summary: TMA-based Allreduce is not yet supported.
patterns.action: Fall back to standard NCCL Allreduce.

patterns.re: XID 119.*GSP RPC timeout during TMA map
patterns.summary: GSP RPC timeout occurred during TMA mapping.
patterns.action: Restart GPU or update display drivers.

patterns.summary: NVLink error occurred during remote TMA access.
patterns.action: Check fabric manager and NVLink topology.

patterns.re: cuTensorMapEncodeTiled failed due to bad pitch
patterns.summary: Tiled TMA encode failed due to bad pitch.
patterns.action: Ensure pitch meets hardware limits and alignment.

patterns.summary: SHARP Aggregation Manager daemon is unreachable on the switch.
patterns.action: Restart the SHARP AM daemon on the IB switch infrastructure.

patterns.summary: SHARP hardware SRAM exhausted for aggregation buffers.
patterns.action: Decrease chunk sizes or reduce SHARP concurrent jobs.

patterns.summary: All pre-configured SHARP trees on the subnet are in use.
patterns.action: Increase max_sharp_trees in UFM or OpenSM.

patterns.summary: Tenant exceeded their allocated SHARP tree quota.
patterns.action: Adjust tenant SHARP limits in UFM policy.

patterns.summary: Duplicate SHARP Job ID detected in the subnet.
patterns.action: Ensure unique MPI/NCCL job IDs across the cluster.

patterns.re: topology mismatch during SHARP tree build
patterns.summary: Switch hierarchy does not match requested SHARP topology.
patterns.action: Rerun subnet discovery in OpenSM/UFM.

patterns.re: OpenSM.*routing engine does not support SHARP
patterns.summary: Selected OpenSM routing engine cannot build SHARP trees.
patterns.action: Switch to up/down or ftree routing in OpenSM.

patterns.summary: IB link flapping caused SHARP tree to tear down.
patterns.action: Replace faulty optical cable causing flaps.

patterns.summary: Switch Aggregator Node is offline or unresponsive.
patterns.action: Reboot the unresponsive leaf/spine IB switch.

patterns.summary: Switch ASIC failed to respond to SHARP commands.
patterns.action: Reset the switch MLNX-OS or NVUE SHARP module.

patterns.summary: Hardware multicast groups required for SHARP are full.
patterns.action: Clear orphaned mcast groups from the subnet.

patterns.summary: OpenSM LID change broke active SHARP trees.
patterns.action: Use static LIDs or avoid SM sweeps during jobs.

patterns.summary: InfiniBand retries exceeded during SHARP aggregation.
patterns.action: Investigate fabric congestion or link degradation.

patterns.summary: HCA firmware locked up during SHARP operation.
patterns.action: Update ConnectX-6/7 firmware to latest MLNX OFED version.

patterns.re: RNR NAK received on SHARP QP
patterns.summary: Receiver Not Ready NAKs caused SHARP timeouts.
patterns.action: Tune NCCL/SHARP RNR retry counts and timeouts.

patterns.summary: InfiniBand port went down during a SHARP collective.
patterns.action: Check physical IB link and optics.

patterns.summary: IOMMU/GTT mapping fault for SHARP RDMA buffer.
patterns.action: Disable IOMMU strict mode or update MOFED.

patterns.re: NCCL SHARP request exceeds max message size
patterns.summary: Message size is too large for SHARP buffers.
patterns.action: Decrease NCCL_SHARP_MAX_COMMS or message chunk size.

patterns.summary: CollNet (SHARP) failed to initialize inside NCCL.
patterns.action: Ensure NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE=1 and SHARP trees exist.

patterns.re: Falling back to P2P\/Ring from SHARP
patterns.summary: SHARP failed, NCCL falling back to standard ring.
patterns.action: Investigate SHARP tree exhaustion or hardware errors.

patterns.summary: NCCL failed to map SHARP channels to local GPUs.
patterns.action: Check NVLink and IB topology mapping.

patterns.summary: NCCL library version conflicts with SHARP daemon version.
patterns.action: Align MOFED, HPC-X, and NCCL library versions.

patterns.re: SHARP max peers exceeded in NCCL init
patterns.summary: Job scale exceeds maximum supported SHARP tree size.
patterns.action: Use hierarchical algorithms or upgrade switch firmware.

patterns.re: GDR pinning failed for SHARP buffer
patterns.summary: Failed to pin A100 GPU memory for SHARP RDMA.
patterns.action: Ensure nvidia-peermem is loaded and BAR1 is sufficient.

patterns.summary: GPU thermal throttling caused SHARP synchronization delays.
patterns.action: Check datacenter cooling and A100 heatsinks.

patterns.re: BAR1 memory exhausted mapping SHARP regions
patterns.summary: GPU PCIe BAR1 space ran out during SHARP registration.
patterns.action: Increase BAR1 size in BIOS or reduce mapped regions.

patterns.summary: GPU triggered a page fault on a SHARP RDMA buffer.
patterns.action: Check PyTorch tensor lifecycle during collective ops.

patterns.re: PMIx sync failed during SHARP init
patterns.summary: MPI PMIx layer failed to synchronize SHARP keys.
patterns.action: Check MPI environment and SLURM PMIx integration.

patterns.summary: Kubernetes SR-IOV plugin did not expose SHARP to the pod.
patterns.action: Update SR-IOV device plugin config to enable SHARP.

patterns.re: Docker IPC SHMEM exhausted during SHARP
patterns.summary: Container shm-size too small for SHARP daemon IPC.
patterns.action: Run container with --shm-size=1g or larger.

patterns.re: SLURM SPANK plugin failed to init SHARP
patterns.summary: SLURM plugin failed to setup SHARP credentials.
patterns.action: Check SLURM SHARP plugin configuration on compute nodes.

patterns.re: OpenMPI BTL openib conflicts with SHARP
patterns.summary: Legacy OpenMPI openib BTL interferes with SHARP.
patterns.action: Use UCX or OFI instead of openib BTL in OpenMPI.

patterns.summary: Slurm preemption left dangling SHARP trees on switches.
patterns.action: Run sharp_clean_trees utility or let UFM garbage collect.

patterns.summary: PyTorch distributed caught a fatal SHARP backend error.
patterns.action: Check NCCL logs for underlying SHARP hardware faults.

patterns.summary: ZeRO-3 parameter fetching exhausted SHARP collective buffers.
patterns.action: Increase SHARP buffer sizes or reduce allgather chunk size.

patterns.summary: PyTorch watchdog terminated hung SHARP collective.
patterns.action: Debug rank desync or IB fabric congestion.

patterns.re: CUDA Graph capture failed for SHARP node
patterns.summary: Cannot capture SHARP collective in CUDA graph.
patterns.action: Disable CUDA graphs or update PyTorch to 2.1+.

patterns.summary: SHARP Aggregation Tree failed because a leaf node died.
patterns.action: Remove dead node from job and restart.

patterns.re: Link Layer credit starvation on SHARP VL
patterns.summary: IB switch ran out of credits for SHARP Virtual Lane.
patterns.action: Tune IB QoS and VL credit limits in OpenSM.

patterns.re: QoS policy dropped SHARP traffic class
patterns.summary: Switch QoS policy wrongly dropped SHARP packets.
patterns.action: Map SHARP traffic to a lossless high-priority VL.

patterns.re: Link Layer ACK timeout on SHARP tree
patterns.summary: Hardware ACK timeout on the InfiniBand link for SHARP.
patterns.action: Check cable health and switch port error counters.

patterns.summary: SHARP payload fragment is larger than Path MTU.
patterns.action: Ensure unified MTU across the IB subnet.

patterns.re: Symbol error rate exceeds threshold.*SHARP degraded
patterns.summary: High physical symbol errors causing SHARP retransmits.
patterns.action: Clean optic fiber tips and re-seat transceiver.

patterns.re: Link degraded from NDR to HDR.*SHARP throttle
patterns.summary: Link speed degradation caused SHARP bandwidth mismatch.
patterns.action: Replace failing active optical cable.

patterns.summary: Receive errors forced switch to abort SHARP collective.
patterns.action: Diagnose physical layer issues on the affected port.

patterns.summary: Forward Error Correction failed to recover a SHARP packet.
patterns.action: Check transceiver temps and replace if overheated.

patterns.summary: Spine failure partitioned the subnet, breaking SHARP trees.
patterns.action: Restore spine connectivity and allow SM to heal subnet.

patterns.re: MTU mismatch detected during SHARP tree init
patterns.summary: Inconsistent MTU sizes across switches broke SHARP.
patterns.action: Standardize IB MTU across all subnet ports.

patterns.summary: MOFED driver panicked processing a SHARP event.
patterns.action: Upgrade MLNX_OFED to the latest stable release.

patterns.summary: Mellanox core driver hung waiting on HCA SHARP firmware.
patterns.action: Cold boot the node to reset the ConnectX HCA.

patterns.re: NUMA misalignment for SHARP buffers.*latency warning
patterns.summary: SHARP buffers allocated on wrong NUMA node.
patterns.action: Ensure MPI/NCCL correctly binds ranks to NUMA nodes.

patterns.re: UFM API rate limit exceeded by SHARP requests
patterns.summary: Too many nodes querying UFM for SHARP trees concurrently.
patterns.action: Add jitter to SHARP tree requests or raise UFM limits.

patterns.re: SHARP tree migration failed during active allreduce
patterns.summary: Dynamic tree migration failed while collective was in-flight.
patterns.action: Disable dynamic SHARP tree migration during runs.

patterns.summary: NCCL Fastrak plugin version incompatible with installed NCCL version.
patterns.action: Upgrade or downgrade the Fastrak plugin to match the NCCL release.

patterns.re: FastSocket symbol not found.*falling back to standard sockets
patterns.summary: FastSocket library missing from LD_PRELOAD chain.
patterns.action: Add libfastsocket.so to LD_PRELOAD environment variable.

patterns.summary: gVNIC TX ring buffer full, stalling outbound TCP traffic.
patterns.action: Increase gVNIC TX ring size via ethtool -G.

patterns.summary: NCCL TCP sockets stuck in CLOSE_WAIT exhausting file descriptors.
patterns.action: Increase ulimit -n and investigate framework teardown sequence.

patterns.re: Cloud NAT dropping idle TCP connection.*NCCL timeout
patterns.summary: Cloud NAT terminating idle TCP connections during GPU compute phase.
patterns.action: Increase Cloud NAT TCP idle timeout to 2 hours.

patterns.re: VPC Firewall dropping IP fragments.*MTU mismatch
patterns.summary: GCP VPC Firewall dropping fragmented TCP packets.
patterns.action: Fix MTU end-to-end to avoid fragmentation entirely.

patterns.summary: Cilium WireGuard node-to-node encryption bottlenecking TCP.
patterns.action: Disable WireGuard encryption for GPU subnets if secure.

patterns.re: Could not open XML topology file.*falling back to generic TCP
patterns.summary: Missing GCP topology XML file forces suboptimal generic TCP paths.
patterns.action: Supply the correct GCP topology file via NCCL_TOPO_FILE.

patterns.summary: VM hardware thermal throttled, silently downgrading NIC speed.
patterns.action: Redeploy VM to healthy physical hardware or contact GCP support.

patterns.summary: Service Level misconfigured on mlx5_1 causing congestion control drops.
patterns.action: Export NCCL_IB_SL=1 to match Azure NDv4 QoS traffic class requirements.

patterns.summary: PCIe Access Control Services blocking P2P traffic for mlx5_7.
patterns.action: Apply custom NDv4 topology XML and ensure NCCL_TOPO_FILE is pointing to it.

patterns.re: ^DeepSpeed MoE: capacity factor \d+\.\d+ exceeded, \d+ tokens dropped in layer 0$

patterns.action: Recalculate cumulative sequence lengths per pipeline stage.

patterns.re: Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration
patterns.summary: Parameter unused in forward pass caused DDP reduction to fail.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=True.

patterns.summary: Gradient checkpointing hid parameters from DDP.
patterns.action: Pass use_reentrant=False to checkpoint.

patterns.summary: Vocabulary unused tokens caused embedding row to lack gradients.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=True.

patterns.summary: Attention head masking disconnected graph.
patterns.action: Ensure masking preserves gradient paths.

patterns.summary: Custom loss function detached tensor from graph.
patterns.action: Use torch.autograd.Function correctly.

patterns.summary: Conditional logic in forward pass skipped modules.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=True for dynamic graphs.

patterns.summary: Mixture of Experts routed tokens away from some experts.
patterns.action: Use DDP with find_unused_parameters=True or expert-specific parallelism.

patterns.summary: LoRA adapter not utilized in specific forward pass.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=True for targeted adapters.

patterns.summary: Value head unused during policy-only optimization phase.
patterns.action: Separate value and policy DDP wrappers.

patterns.summary: Discriminator updated without generator forward pass.
patterns.action: Ensure generator graph is retained or split optimizers.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once
patterns.summary: Graph traversed twice during backward pass.
patterns.action: Check for multiple backward() calls without retain_graph=False.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*weight_tied
patterns.summary: Tied weights caused variable to be ready multiple times.
patterns.action: Use DDP's broadcast_buffers=False or manage tied weights properly.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*gradient_accumulate
patterns.summary: Gradient accumulation called backward on overlapping graphs.
patterns.action: Use no_sync() context manager during accumulation.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*RNN
patterns.summary: Unrolled RNN graph caused duplicate backward paths.
patterns.action: Ensure hidden state is detached between iterations.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*skip_connection
patterns.summary: Complex residual connections led to duplicated gradient hooks.
patterns.action: Refactor forward pass to avoid cyclical graph definitions.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*multi_loss
patterns.summary: Summing losses from disconnected graphs triggered duplicate ready.
patterns.action: Combine losses before calling backward().

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*autograd.grad
patterns.summary: Manual autograd.grad mixed with loss.backward().
patterns.action: Avoid mixing explicit autograd with DDP backward.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*checkpoint
patterns.summary: Nested gradient checkpoints caused double ready.
patterns.action: Flatten gradient checkpoints.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*requires_grad
patterns.summary: Dynamically unfreezing layers during backward.
patterns.action: Freeze/unfreeze layers only between steps.

patterns.re: Expected to mark a variable ready only once.*register_hook
patterns.summary: Custom backward hook marked variable ready prematurely.
patterns.action: Remove interfering backward hooks.

patterns.re: find_unused_parameters=True was specified.*did not find any
patterns.summary: Unnecessary find_unused_parameters overhead.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False.

patterns.summary: ViT uses all parameters but find_unused_parameters is True.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False for standard ViT.

patterns.summary: BERT classification uses all layers.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False.

patterns.summary: ResNet graph is fully connected.
patterns.action: Disable find_unused_parameters.

patterns.summary: T5 encoder-decoder uses all weights.
patterns.action: Disable find_unused_parameters.

patterns.summary: GPT-2 forward pass is static.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False.

patterns.summary: Llama forward pass does not skip layers.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False.

patterns.summary: UNet uses all parameters.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False.

patterns.summary: Wav2Vec2 processes all inputs.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False.

patterns.summary: CLIP dual encoders use all weights.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False.

patterns.summary: Inplace operation disrupted backward graph.
patterns.action: Replace inplace operation (e.g. +=) with out-of-place (e.g. +).

patterns.summary: Inplace ReLU modified tensor needed for backward.
patterns.action: Set inplace=False in nn.ReLU().

patterns.summary: Inplace addition modified tensor required for gradient computation.
patterns.action: Use out-of-place addition.

patterns.summary: Inplace modification of BatchNorm running stats during forward.
patterns.action: Ensure BatchNorm stats are updated correctly.

patterns.summary: Inplace tensor indexing assignment.
patterns.action: Clone tensor before assignment.

patterns.summary: Inplace scatter operation.
patterns.action: Use torch.scatter instead of scatter_.

patterns.summary: Inplace masked_fill modified tensor.
patterns.action: Use masked_fill instead of masked_fill_.

patterns.summary: Optimizer step modified tensor before backward completed.
patterns.action: Call backward() before optimizer.step().

patterns.summary: Inplace modification of a tensor view.
patterns.action: Clone the view before modifying.

patterns.summary: Inplace dropout modified tensor.
patterns.action: Set inplace=False in nn.Dropout().

patterns.re: Expected static graph to have the same forward\/backward behavior
patterns.summary: Static graph assumption violated by dynamic forward pass.
patterns.action: Set static_graph=False.

patterns.summary: Varying sequence lengths altered graph topology.
patterns.action: Pad sequences to consistent length or disable static_graph.

patterns.summary: Varying batch size in static graph mode.
patterns.action: Ensure constant batch size.

patterns.summary: MoE routing changed graph structure.
patterns.action: Disable static_graph for MoE models.

patterns.summary: Stochastic sampling altered forward path.
patterns.action: Disable static_graph for stochastic paths.

patterns.summary: Dynamic channel pruning changed graph.
patterns.action: Disable static_graph for dynamic pruning.

patterns.summary: Early exit from model altered graph.
patterns.action: Disable static_graph with early exits.

patterns.summary: Variable sequence length unrolled RNN differently.
patterns.action: Disable static_graph for variable-length RNNs.

patterns.summary: Variable attention masks changed graph structure.
patterns.action: Disable static_graph.

patterns.summary: Conditional branch execution varied.
patterns.action: Disable static_graph for branching logic.

patterns.re: DDP bucket rebuild failed due to NCCL timeout
patterns.summary: Node crashed or stalled during bucket rebuild.
patterns.action: Check for node failures and increase NCCL_TIMEOUT.

patterns.re: DDP bucket rebuild failed.*CUDA out of memory
patterns.summary: OOM during bucket memory allocation.
patterns.action: Reduce batch size to free memory for bucket rebuild.

patterns.summary: Process hung during DDP synchronization.
patterns.action: Debug distributed barrier deadlocks.

patterns.summary: Mismatched tensor shapes across ranks during rebuild.
patterns.action: Ensure identical tensor shapes across all ranks.

patterns.summary: Mixed precision caused dtype mismatch in buckets.
patterns.action: Cast parameters to consistent dtype.

patterns.summary: Parameters spread across multiple devices.
patterns.action: Move all parameters to the correct device before wrapping in DDP.

patterns.summary: InfiniBand or network failure during rebuild.
patterns.action: Check fabric logs and NCCL IB configurations.

patterns.summary: Ranks reached bucket rebuild at different times.
patterns.action: Add torch.distributed.barrier() before critical sections.

patterns.summary: CPU tensor included in GPU DDP bucket.
patterns.action: Move CPU tensors to GPU.

patterns.summary: Different ranks have different number of parameters.
patterns.action: Ensure model architecture is identical on all ranks.

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time
patterns.summary: backward() called twice without retain_graph=True.
patterns.action: Pass retain_graph=True or avoid double backward.

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*accumulate
patterns.summary: Accumulating gradients over multiple forward passes without retain.
patterns.action: Use retain_graph=True or detach between passes.

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*hidden_state
patterns.summary: RNN hidden state not detached between backward passes.
patterns.action: Call hidden.detach_().

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*generator
patterns.summary: Generator backward called after discriminator backward freed graph.
patterns.action: Retain graph during discriminator backward.

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*policy
patterns.summary: Policy gradient backward freed graph needed by value network.
patterns.action: Retain graph during policy backward.

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*maml
patterns.summary: Meta-learning inner loop backward freed graph.
patterns.action: Retain graph during inner loop updates.

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*hook
patterns.summary: Hook triggered backward prematurely.
patterns.action: Fix custom hook logic.

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*multiple losses
patterns.summary: Calling backward sequentially on multiple losses.
patterns.action: Sum losses before calling backward().

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*optimizer
patterns.summary: Optimizer step called before all backwards finished.
patterns.action: Complete all backwards before step().

patterns.re: Trying to backward through the graph a second time.*detach
patterns.summary: Failed to detach tensor bridging two graphs.
patterns.action: Detach tensor connecting successive graphs.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad and does not have a grad_fn
patterns.summary: Tensor detached from graph by torch.no_grad().
patterns.action: Ensure torch.no_grad() does not wrap trainable forward passes.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*eval mode
patterns.summary: Model in eval mode detached gradients.
patterns.action: Call model.train().

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*inference_mode
patterns.summary: inference_mode disabled autograd.
patterns.action: Remove inference_mode for training.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*requires_grad=False
patterns.summary: All inputs and parameters frozen.
patterns.action: Ensure at least one parameter requires_grad.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*detach
patterns.summary: Manual detach disconnected the entire graph.
patterns.action: Remove manual detach() call on main output.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*numpy
patterns.summary: Conversion to numpy array broke autograd.
patterns.action: Stay in PyTorch tensors for differentiable ops.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*item
patterns.summary: .item() call broke the computational graph.
patterns.action: Avoid .item() when passing tensors to loss.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*int
patterns.summary: Casting to integer detached gradients.
patterns.action: Avoid casting to non-differentiable dtypes.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*argmax
patterns.summary: Argmax operation is non-differentiable.
patterns.action: Use differentiable alternatives like softmax.

patterns.re: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.*round
patterns.summary: Rounding operation broke autograd.
patterns.action: Use straight-through estimator for rounding.

patterns.re: The parameters in the model are different from the parameters expected by DistributedDataParallel
patterns.summary: Model architecture differs across DDP ranks.
patterns.action: Ensure identical model initialization on all ranks.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*Embedding
patterns.summary: Vocabulary size differs across ranks.
patterns.action: Pad or fix vocabulary size to be identical.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*lora
patterns.summary: LoRA adapters injected differently across ranks.
patterns.action: Inject LoRA adapters consistently.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*expert
patterns.summary: Different number of experts initialized on ranks.
patterns.action: Initialize same number of experts per rank.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*classifier
patterns.summary: Classification head dimensions differ due to dynamic classes.
patterns.action: Fix number of classes globally.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*FlatParameter
patterns.summary: FSDP flat parameter reconstruction failed.
patterns.action: Ensure consistent FSDP wrapping policies.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*pruned
patterns.summary: Model pruned asymmetrically across ranks.
patterns.action: Broadcast prune masks to all ranks.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*ModuleList
patterns.summary: Different number of layers in ModuleList.
patterns.action: Construct identical ModuleLists.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*dtype
patterns.summary: Parameter precision differs across ranks.
patterns.action: Cast model to consistent dtype before DDP.

patterns.re: parameters in the model are different.*ZeroParam
patterns.summary: DeepSpeed ZeRO partition mismatch.
patterns.action: Ensure identical ZeRO stage configs.

patterns.re: Mismatch in buffer shapes during broadcast

patterns.re: ValueError: The model's max seq len .*\[ctx_id=0\].* is larger than the maximum number of blocks that can be stored in KV cache
patterns.summary: Model maximum sequence length exceeds allocated KV cache block capacity.
patterns.action: Reduce max_model_len or increase gpu_memory_utilization.

patterns.re: torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate .*\[ctx_id=1\].* during paged attention
patterns.summary: GPU ran out of memory while executing PagedAttention kernels.
patterns.action: Lower max_num_batched_tokens or reduce gpu_memory_utilization to free up PyTorch memory.

patterns.summary: Block allocator ran out of free blocks for sequence generation.
patterns.action: Enable swapping or reduce concurrent requests.

patterns.summary: vLLM exhausted the CPU swap space when preempting sequences.
patterns.action: Increase swap_space parameter in vLLM engine configuration.

patterns.re: TimeoutError: Acquiring defragmentation lock for KV cache block manager failed.*ctx_4.*
patterns.summary: KV cache defragmentation thread locked out the allocation thread for too long.
patterns.action: Disable aggressive defragmentation or tune defrag_interval.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA error: invalid configuration argument.*\[ctx_id=5\].*CUDAGraph
patterns.summary: CUDA Graph capture failed due to incompatible KV cache memory pool size.
patterns.action: Set enforce_eager=True or adjust CUDA graph batch sizes.

patterns.summary: PagedAttention kernel received misaligned tensor shapes for KV blocks.

patterns.summary: The tokenizer is emitting token ids beyond the model's embedding table, so the embedding gather indexes out of range and the GPU raises a device-side assert. The assert is the SYMPTOM; the tokenizer and the checkpoint disagree about vocabulary size.
patterns.action:
Make the tokenizer and the embedding table agree before resuming. Do not chase the CUDA assert.

NOW: compare them directly. `len(tokenizer)` against `model.get_input_embeddings().weight.shape[0]`. If the tokenizer is larger, that difference is the bug.
THEN pick one, they are not equivalent: either call `model.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer))` and accept that the new rows are randomly initialised and need training, or load the tokenizer that the checkpoint was trained with and drop the added tokens.
VERIFY: re-run with `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` so any remaining assert names the real launch site instead of a later unrelated one.
PREVENT: assert the two sizes match at startup. It is one line and it turns a mid-run GPU crash into a clear message before the first step.

patterns.re: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
patterns.summary: NFD worker cannot reach NFD master over gRPC due to network timeout.
patterns.action: Check network policies and NFD master service port accessibility.

patterns.re: listen tcp :8080: bind: address already in use
patterns.summary: NFD master gRPC port is already bound by another process.
patterns.action: Change the NFD master port or stop the conflicting service.

patterns.re: tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate has expired
patterns.summary: TLS certificate for NFD gRPC communication has expired.
patterns.action: Rotate NFD master and worker TLS certificates.

patterns.re: x509: certificate is valid for .*, not nfd-master
patterns.summary: TLS certificate SAN does not match NFD master service name.
patterns.action: Regenerate TLS certificate with correct SANs for nfd-master.

patterns.re: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing dial tcp: connect: connection refused\"
patterns.summary: NFD worker connection refused by NFD master.
patterns.action: Ensure NFD master pod is running and listening on the expected port.

patterns.re: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = name resolution error
patterns.summary: NFD worker cannot resolve NFD master service hostname.
patterns.action: Verify CoreDNS functionality and nfd-master service existence.

patterns.re: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = grpc: received message larger than max
patterns.summary: Node features payload exceeds gRPC max message size limit.
patterns.action: Increase MaxCallRecvMsgSize in NFD master configuration.

patterns.re: nodes \"[^"]+\" is forbidden: User \"[^"]+\" cannot patch resource \"nodes\"

patterns.action: Bind appropriate ClusterRole allowing patch on nodes to NFD master.

patterns.re: Rate limited waiting for node patch
patterns.summary: Node label updates are being rate-limited by the Kubernetes API server.
patterns.action: Adjust NFD worker sleep interval or API server QPS limits.

patterns.re: the server could not find the requested resource .*nodefeaturerules.nfd.k8s-sigs.io
patterns.summary: NodeFeatureRule CRD is not installed in the cluster.
patterns.action: Install the required NFD CRDs before starting NFD master.

patterns.re: failed to acquire lease: .*leases.coordination.k8s.io is forbidden
patterns.summary: NFD master cannot acquire leader election lease due to RBAC.
patterns.action: Grant NFD master permissions to create/update leases in coordination.k8s.io.

patterns.re: Timeout: request did not complete within requested timeout
patterns.summary: Timeout while communicating with Kubernetes API server.
patterns.action: Check kube-apiserver health and network latency from NFD master.

patterns.re: forbidden: node updates may only change labels in the .* prefix
patterns.summary: Node restriction admission plugin blocks updating arbitrary label prefixes.
patterns.action: Use allowed prefixes or adjust NodeRestriction plugin configuration.

patterns.re: failed to update annotations on node: .*Conflict
patterns.summary: Optimistic locking failure when updating node annotations.
patterns.action: NFD master will retry; ensure no conflicting controllers update the same annotations frequently.

patterns.re: error parsing NodeFeatureRule: error unmarshaling JSON
patterns.summary: NodeFeatureRule custom resource contains invalid YAML/JSON.
patterns.action: Validate NodeFeatureRule manifest syntax.

patterns.summary: NodeFeatureRule is missing a valid feature domain (e.g., pci, cpu).
patterns.action: Specify a valid feature domain in the NodeFeatureRule match expression.

patterns.summary: Invalid match operator used in NodeFeatureRule expression.
patterns.action: Use supported operators like In, NotIn, Exists, DoesNotExist, Gt, Lt.

patterns.summary: Multiple rules in NodeFeatureRule have the same name.
patterns.action: Ensure all rule names within a NodeFeatureRule are unique.

patterns.re: no matches for kind \"NodeFeatureRule\" in version \"[^"]+\"
patterns.summary: Unsupported NodeFeatureRule API version deployed.
patterns.action: Update NFR manifest to use the supported API version.

patterns.re: rule must specify either labels or labelsTemplate
patterns.summary: Rule definition lacks both labels and labelsTemplate.
patterns.action: Provide a labels map or labelsTemplate in the NodeFeatureRule.

patterns.summary: MatchFeatures block is empty in a NodeFeatureRule.
patterns.action: Add valid match expressions to the matchFeatures block.

patterns.summary: Invalid regex pattern provided in NodeFeatureRule match expression.
patterns.action: Fix the regex syntax in the NodeFeatureRule.

patterns.summary: NodeFeatureRule evaluation took too long, likely due to complex regex.
patterns.action: Simplify regex patterns or reduce rule complexity.

patterns.summary: NodeFeatureRule references a feature source that does not exist.
patterns.action: Use valid feature sources (e.g., cpu, pci, usb, custom).

patterns.re: dynamic value not found for attribute: \"[^"]+\"
patterns.summary: Requested dynamic attribute value is missing during rule evaluation.
patterns.action: Check if the underlying feature provides the requested attribute.

patterns.re: type mismatch for attribute: expected \w+, got \w+
patterns.summary: Attribute type mismatch during NodeFeatureRule evaluation.
patterns.action: Ensure the match operator matches the data type of the attribute.

patterns.summary: Failed to evaluate Go template in labelsTemplate.
patterns.action: Correct the Go template syntax in labelsTemplate.

patterns.summary: Recursive or deeply nested NodeFeatureRule evaluation exceeded limits.
patterns.action: Flatten NodeFeatureRule structures and avoid circular references.

patterns.re: cpuid leaf .* not supported by processor
patterns.summary: NFD attempted to read an unsupported CPUID leaf.
patterns.action: Ignore if harmless, or update NFD to support the specific CPU generation.

patterns.summary: A CPU feature is hidden by the hypervisor and cannot be discovered.
patterns.action: Expose the required CPU flags in the VM hypervisor configuration.

patterns.summary: CPU vendor string is not recognized by NFD.
patterns.action: Ensure NFD version supports the deployed CPU architecture.

patterns.re: failed to read CPU microcode version: .*
patterns.summary: NFD cannot determine the CPU microcode version.
patterns.action: Ensure sysfs is mounted and NFD worker runs as privileged if required.

patterns.re: AVX512 features not detected on node
patterns.summary: Expected AVX512 CPU flags are missing.
patterns.action: Verify CPU model supports AVX512 or enable in BIOS/Hypervisor.

patterns.summary: Intel SGX is detected but Enclave Page Cache (EPC) size is 0.
patterns.action: Allocate SGX EPC memory in the system BIOS.

patterns.summary: AMD memory encryption features are disabled in BIOS.
patterns.action: Enable SME/SEV in BIOS to allow NFD to label them.

patterns.re: NUMA node directory not found in \/sys\/devices\/system\/node
patterns.summary: NUMA topology information is missing from sysfs.
patterns.action: Ensure NUMA is enabled in BIOS and kernel.

patterns.re: failed to read CPU topology from \/sys\/devices\/system\/cpu
patterns.summary: NFD cannot read CPU topology from sysfs.
patterns.action: Check volume mounts for /sys in the NFD worker daemonset.

patterns.re: cache topology information missing for CPU \d+
patterns.summary: L1/L2/L3 cache topology data is unavailable in sysfs.
patterns.action: Verify kernel version and CPU support for cache topology reporting.

patterns.re: failed to parse NUMA distance map: .*
patterns.summary: NUMA distance matrix format is unreadable.
patterns.action: Check ACPI SRAT table generation in BIOS/Hypervisor.

patterns.re: conflicting socket IDs detected for NUMA node
patterns.summary: Inconsistent socket to NUMA node mapping detected.
patterns.action: Update BIOS or fix hypervisor CPU pinning configuration.

patterns.summary: Hyperthreading siblings list in sysfs cannot be parsed.
patterns.action: Upgrade kernel to fix sysfs topology reporting bugs.

patterns.re: failed to parse isolated CPUs mask
patterns.summary: Kernel isolcpus boot parameter is malformed.
patterns.action: Fix isolcpus format in GRUB boot parameters.

patterns.re: failed to read PCI devices: \/sys\/bus\/pci\/devices not found
patterns.summary: PCI bus directory is missing from sysfs mount.
patterns.action: Ensure /sys is mounted into the NFD worker pod.

patterns.re: missing vendor id for PCI device .*
patterns.summary: PCI device in sysfs lacks a vendor ID file.
patterns.action: Investigate underlying hardware or kernel driver issues.

patterns.re: unknown class id .* for PCI device
patterns.summary: NFD encountered an unmapped PCI class ID.
patterns.action: Add a custom NodeFeatureRule or update NFD PCI class mappings.

patterns.re: failed to read sriov_totalvfs for device .*
patterns.summary: SR-IOV capabilities cannot be read for a PCI device.
patterns.action: Ensure SR-IOV is enabled in BIOS and supported by the driver.

patterns.summary: Configured SR-IOV VFs exceed hardware limits.
patterns.action: Reconfigure SR-IOV VF allocation to stay within limits.

patterns.summary: A PCI device was hot-unplugged during NFD discovery.
patterns.action: NFD will retry discovery on the next sync interval.

patterns.re: failed to read PCIe link speed for device .*
patterns.summary: Cannot determine PCIe link speed for a device.
patterns.action: Check if ASPM or kernel power management is blocking sysfs reads.

patterns.re: failed to read USB devices: \/sys\/bus\/usb\/devices not found
patterns.summary: USB bus directory is missing from sysfs mount.
patterns.action: Ensure /sys is correctly mounted in the NFD worker pod.

patterns.re: error reading descriptor for USB device .*
patterns.summary: USB device descriptor is corrupted or unreadable.
patterns.action: Check USB hardware or kernel USB core logs.

patterns.re: unknown class code .* for USB device
patterns.summary: NFD encountered an unknown USB class code.
patterns.action: Update NFD or ignore if the device is not needed for scheduling.

patterns.re: failed to read USB interfaces for device .*
patterns.summary: Cannot enumerate USB interfaces for a device.
patterns.action: Verify kernel USB drivers are loaded.

patterns.summary: USB topology is too deep to parse.
patterns.action: Simplify USB topology physically connected to the node.

patterns.re: USB device .* is in suspended power state
patterns.summary: USB device is autosuspended and cannot be queried.
patterns.action: Disable USB autosuspend in kernel boot parameters.

patterns.re: missing serial number for USB device .*
patterns.summary: USB device does not expose a serial number.
patterns.action: Use vendor/product IDs for matching instead of serial numbers.

patterns.summary: Required kernel module is not loaded on the node.
patterns.action: Load the kernel module via modprobe or node configuration.

patterns.summary: A kernel module is missing required dependencies.
patterns.action: Run depmod and ensure all module dependencies exist.

patterns.re: kernel config file not found at \/boot\/config-.*
patterns.summary: Kernel config file is missing for Kconfig feature discovery.
patterns.action: Mount /boot into the NFD worker pod or enable /proc/config.gz.

patterns.re: kernel config option .* is not set
patterns.summary: A required kernel feature is not compiled into the kernel.
patterns.action: Recompile the kernel with the required Kconfig option.

patterns.re: kernel module .* version mismatch: expected .*, got .*
patterns.summary: Loaded kernel module version does not match the required version.
patterns.action: Upgrade or downgrade the kernel module/driver.

patterns.re: failed to execute modinfo for module .*
patterns.summary: modinfo command failed or is missing in the NFD worker container.
patterns.action: Ensure kmod tools are available in the NFD worker image.

patterns.summary: NFD worker lacks permissions to read sysctl values.
patterns.action: Run NFD worker with appropriate security context.

patterns.re: failed to read \/etc\/os-release: no such file or directory
patterns.summary: OS release information file is missing on the node.
patterns.action: Ensure /etc/os-release is mounted into the NFD worker pod.

patterns.summary: Kernel release string format is unrecognized.
patterns.action: Ensure kernel version follows standard SemVer or handle custom strings.

patterns.summary: DMI/SMBIOS information is missing from sysfs.
patterns.action: Ensure dmi-sysfs kernel module is loaded.

patterns.summary: System UUID is not programmed in the BIOS.
patterns.action: Update BIOS/firmware to populate valid DMI information.

patterns.summary: BIOS version string is missing from DMI data.
patterns.action: Check firmware implementation on the specific hardware.

patterns.summary: Cannot determine if SELinux is enabled on the node.
patterns.action: Mount /sys/fs/selinux to allow NFD to detect SELinux state.

patterns.re: AppArmor is enabled but no profiles loaded
patterns.summary: AppArmor is active but missing enforced profiles.
patterns.action: Load required AppArmor profiles on the node.

patterns.re: speed for network interface .* is unknown
patterns.summary: Network interface speed cannot be determined.
patterns.action: Ensure interface is UP and cable is connected to negotiate speed.

patterns.re: network interface .* does not support SR-IOV
patterns.summary: An expected interface does not expose SR-IOV capabilities.
patterns.action: Verify NIC firmware and driver support for SR-IOV.

patterns.re: RDMA\/RoCE capabilities not found for device .*
patterns.summary: RDMA/RoCE is not supported or drivers are missing.
patterns.action: Install RDMA core libraries and rdma kernel modules.

patterns.summary: Network interface is down, blocking feature discovery.
patterns.action: Bring the interface UP to allow capability queries.

patterns.summary: DPDK bindings for Open vSwitch are missing.
patterns.action: Bind NIC to vfio-pci or igb_uio for DPDK support.

patterns.re: failed to read MAC address for interface .*
patterns.summary: Cannot read the MAC address of a network interface.
patterns.action: Check sysfs permissions for network interface directories.

patterns.re: link state for interface .* is UNKNOWN
patterns.summary: Operational state of the network link is unknown.
patterns.action: Verify physical connection and driver stability.

patterns.summary: nvidia-smi tool is missing, blocking GPU detail discovery.
patterns.action: Ensure NVIDIA drivers are installed and nvidia-smi is in PATH.

patterns.re: NVIDIA GPU PCI ID .* does not match known list
patterns.summary: NFD detected a new or unsupported NVIDIA GPU.
patterns.action: Update NFD or node feature rules with the new PCI ID.

patterns.re: GPU driver version .* is below required minimum
patterns.summary: Installed GPU driver is too old for required capabilities.
patterns.action: Upgrade the GPU driver to a supported version.

patterns.re: MIG profile .* is unsupported or invalid
patterns.summary: Invalid NVIDIA MIG profile configured on the GPU.
patterns.action: Configure a valid MIG profile using nvidia-smi mig -c.

patterns.summary: AMD ROCm System Management Interface failed.
patterns.action: Ensure AMD GPU drivers and ROCm are correctly installed.

patterns.summary: Cannot connect to Intel XPU manager for GPU discovery.
patterns.action: Verify Intel XPU manager service is running on the node.

patterns.re: Habana Gaudi sysfs entries not found
patterns.summary: Habana Labs Gaudi accelerators are not detected in sysfs.
patterns.action: Install habanalabs kernel driver.

patterns.re: NVMe namespace not found for controller .*
patterns.summary: NVMe controller is present but has no configured namespaces.
patterns.action: Create and attach an NVMe namespace to the controller.

patterns.summary: Persistent memory region exists but is not configured for use.
patterns.action: Use ndctl to configure the PMEM region into namespaces.

patterns.re: DAX mode is disabled for PMEM device .*
patterns.summary: PMEM device is not configured for direct access (DAX).
patterns.action: Reconfigure PMEM namespace to use fsdax or devdax mode.

patterns.re: failed to read rotational flag for block device .*
patterns.summary: Cannot determine if a block device is HDD or SSD.
patterns.action: Check sysfs block device attributes and permissions.

patterns.re: logical block size unknown for device .*
patterns.summary: Cannot read the logical block size of a storage device.
patterns.action: Ensure the device is initialized and partitioned.

patterns.re: SMART status indicates failure for device .*
patterns.summary: Disk SMART status reports an imminent failure.
patterns.action: Replace the failing storage drive.

patterns.summary: Expected Host Bus Adapter for storage is missing.
patterns.action: Check PCIe connections and HBA firmware.

patterns.summary: Pod rejected due to restricted kubelet topology manager policy.
patterns.action: Ensure pod requests can be satisfied within a single NUMA node.

patterns.re: UnexpectedAdmissionError: Allocate failed due to NUMA node alignment
patterns.summary: Kubelet cannot align CPU and device allocations on the same NUMA node.
patterns.action: Check available resources per NUMA node or relax topology policy.

patterns.re: failed to generate topology hints for resource .*
patterns.summary: Device plugin failed to generate valid NUMA topology hints.
patterns.action: Verify device plugin supports TopologyManager interface.

patterns.re: pod affinity conflicts with NUMA topology policy
patterns.summary: Pod affinity rules conflict with kubelet NUMA alignment requirements.
patterns.action: Adjust pod affinity or kubelet topology manager policy.

patterns.re: device plugin reported NUMA node .* but sysfs reports .*
patterns.summary: Mismatch between device plugin NUMA reporting and NFD/sysfs.
patterns.action: Investigate device plugin logic or sysfs topology inaccuracies.

patterns.summary: CPU Manager cannot allocate exclusive CPUs required by Topology Manager.
patterns.action: Ensure pod has guaranteed QoS and integer CPU requests.

patterns.summary: Requested NUMA node lacks sufficient memory for the pod.
patterns.action: Request less memory or schedule on a node with larger NUMA nodes.

patterns.summary: An NFD custom hook script took too long to execute.
patterns.action: Optimize the hook script or increase the timeout limit.

patterns.summary: An NFD custom hook script failed during execution.
patterns.action: Check the hook script logs for internal errors.

patterns.summary: Configured custom source script does not exist.
patterns.action: Mount the custom script into the correct directory in the NFD worker pod.

patterns.re: too many labels on node, skipping update
patterns.summary: NFD attempted to apply more labels than Kubernetes supports.
patterns.action: Filter out unnecessary features to reduce label count.

patterns.re: annotation size exceeds maximum allowed limit
patterns.summary: NFD node features JSON in annotations is too large.
patterns.action: Use NodeFeature custom resources instead of annotations to store features.

patterns.re: failed to garbage collect orphaned NFD labels
patterns.summary: NFD master failed to remove old labels from a node.
patterns.action: Check API server connectivity and RBAC permissions.

patterns.summary: Multiple NFD rules or sources are updating the same label domain.
patterns.action: Ensure distinct domains for custom rules to avoid conflicts.

patterns.re: rdma_bind_addr: Cannot assign requested address .* rocep16s0
patterns.summary: The specified IP address or interface is not available on the IBV device.
patterns.action: Verify GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME matches the actual IP assigned to the RDMA interface.

patterns.re: rdma_bind_addr: Cannot assign requested address .* mlx5_0
patterns.summary: The specified IP address or interface is not available on the IBV device.
patterns.action: Verify GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME matches the actual IP assigned to the RDMA interface.

patterns.re: .* pyxis: cni plugin error: failed to release IP from host-local IPAM for evicted job 800095 \(eviction\).*
patterns.summary: Pyxis network namespace teardown failed during Slurm job eviction.
patterns.action: Force delete network namespace slurm-800095 and clean CNI locks.

patterns.summary: Deadlock in ggml_backend_sched_graph_compute_async during chunked prefill caused by OOM stream desync.
