patterns.action: Verify that all ranks run the same step execution loops. Check for MPI network interface drops. (Check operation ReduceScatter).

patterns.summary:
A NCCL bandwidth test returned incorrect data, not just slow data.

The #wrong column in nccl-tests counts elements whose value did not match the expected
result of the collective. On a healthy fabric it is always zero. A non-zero value means
bits are being altered in transit or in the reduction, which is a correctness problem,
not a performance one.

This matters more than any slowdown on this page. Training will not crash. It will
produce a model quietly trained on corrupted gradients, and the damage is not visible
until an evaluation looks wrong days or weeks later, by which point the checkpoints
between here and there are all suspect.

Treat this as a hardware or fabric configuration fault until proven otherwise. Do not
run production training on this fabric while the count is non-zero.
patterns.action:
Stop scheduling training on the affected nodes now, then bisect.

1. Record the exact failing configuration: message size, GPU count, node list, and which
   collective. Corruption is often size-dependent or path-dependent.

2. Narrow to a node or a link. Re-run the same test on progressively smaller sets:
   single node, then pairs, then the full set. The smallest failing set names the
   suspect hardware.

3. On the suspect set, collect fabric error counters:
   nvidia-smi nvlink -e                       # NVLink CRC and replay errors
   for p in /sys/class/infiniband/*/ports/*; do echo "$p"; cat "$p"/counters/symbol_error \
     "$p"/counters/link_error_recovery "$p"/counters/port_rcv_errors 2>/dev/null; done
   dmesg -T | grep -iE "nvlink|sxid|aer|pcie"

4. Check the boring causes before the expensive ones. Loose or dirty transceivers, a
   marginal cable, and a recent NIC or switch firmware change account for most of these.

5. Escalate with the failing test output, the node list, and the counters above. A
   non-zero #wrong is concrete enough to open a vendor case on.

Do not proceed by lowering the message size until the test passes. That hides the fault
rather than fixing it.
patterns.resumeFrom: do not resume training on this fabric until the test passes clean

negativeEvidence.re: GPU is lost|GPU has been reset

patterns.summary: Multiple InfiniBand Subnet Managers are acting as primary or publishing conflicting routes.
patterns.action: Preserve sminfo and OpenSM logs, restore one authoritative primary with a lower-priority standby, then verify stable LIDs and a clean fabric sweep before restarting collectives.
patterns.resumeFrom: the last verified checkpoint before the fabric route change

patterns.summary: A torch.compile Inductor-generated Triton kernel violated an alignment or ABI assumption during JIT execution.
patterns.action: Contain with torch.compile mode="default" or eager execution. Capture TORCH_LOGS="+dynamo,+inductor" and the generated kernel, then verify the same input on a matched driver and CUDA tuple.
patterns.resumeFrom: the latest checkpoint completed before the compiler failure

patterns.summary: HBM row remapping failed: the GPU has exhausted its reserve of spare memory rows and can no longer retire failing ones. This is a terminal hardware state, the GPU will keep producing uncorrectable ECC errors and must be replaced.
patterns.action:
NOW: drain the GPU and stop scheduling work on it. Resume the job from a checkpoint written BEFORE the first remap failure, results computed after it are suspect.
INVESTIGATE: nvidia-smi -q -d ROW_REMAPPER (check "Remapping Failure Occurred" and the pending/available counts); nvidia-smi -q -d ECC for the volatile/aggregate DBE trend; dcgmi diag -r 3.
PREVENT: alert on remap pool availability, not just on failure, a pool below ~10% free predicts this state days ahead. Drain proactively at that threshold.
ESCALATE: RMA immediately. Row-remap exhaustion is unambiguous and is accepted without dispute; attach the ROW_REMAPPER query output and the GPU serial.
patterns.resumeFrom: checkpoint predating the first remap failure

patterns.summary: The EFA provider reported a disconnected endpoint while polling the completion queue. A peer process exit, security-group mismatch, EFA attachment problem, or libfabric transport fault interrupted the fabric path.
patterns.action:
NOW: inspect every peer rank for an earlier exit and confirm the EFA device is present on each instance. The rank that reports the CQ error may only be observing a remote failure.
INVESTIGATE: run fi_info -p efa and an EFA-enabled nccl-tests or OSU control across the same instances. Verify the security group permits all traffic between participating nodes.
PREVENT: use one tested AMI, EFA installer, and instance family across the cluster, and gate jobs on a fabric preflight.
ESCALATE: if the EFA control fails without a peer exit, collect fi_info, provider debug logs, instance IDs, placement, and timestamps for AWS support.
patterns.resumeFrom: latest checkpoint after the EFA fabric control passes

patterns.summary: FlashAttention produced non-finite values under FP16 autocast. Overflow can originate in the inputs, attention logits, scaling, or an unsupported kernel path, so the first non-finite tensor determines the owner.
patterns.action:
NOW: rerun the failing batch with anomaly checks and BF16 or FP32 attention. Reject the update and preserve the last finite checkpoint.
INVESTIGATE: test inputs, Q/K/V, logits, and output for finiteness around flash_attn_varlen_func. Compare the same tensors with the framework attention backend.
PREVENT: use BF16 where supported, keep gradient scaling and clipping telemetry, and add finite checks before checkpoint publication.
ESCALATE: if finite inputs fail only in the FlashAttention path, preserve shapes, strides, dtype, GPU capability, and library versions for the kernel owner.
patterns.resumeFrom: last checkpoint before the first non-finite update

patterns.summary: The coherent NVLink-C2C path between the Grace CPU and Hopper GPU reported a fatal link or coherency failure. Continuing on the node risks invalid data movement, so this is a platform health event rather than an application timeout.
patterns.action:
NOW: stop the workload, drain the node, and preserve firmware, kernel, and management-controller logs before any power cycle.
INVESTIGATE: correlate the timestamp with thermal, power, PCIe, NVLink, and Xid telemetry. Run the vendor platform diagnostic only after logs are captured.
PREVENT: keep Grace Hopper firmware as a qualified bundle, monitor corrected link events, and remove nodes from service on the first fatal coherency report.
ESCALATE: open a platform vendor case with the exact module serials, firmware bundle, health dump, and reproducibility because userspace cannot repair a fatal coherent-link fault.
patterns.resumeFrom: latest verified checkpoint on a healthy node

patterns.re: gdrcopy[^\n]{0,100}gdr_pin_buffer failed[^\n]{0,100}(BAR1|not mapped)|GPU virtual address is not mapped to BAR1 aperture
patterns.summary: GDRCopy could not pin the GPU virtual address into the CPU-visible BAR1 aperture. The allocation is not eligible for peer-direct mapping, BAR1 space is exhausted, or the kernel module and driver disagree.
patterns.action:
NOW: confirm the gdrdrv module is loaded and run the GDRCopy copybw test on the same GPU before retrying the application.
INVESTIGATE: inspect nvidia-smi -q BAR1 usage and confirm the pointer came from a supported CUDA device allocation on the same GPU. Free stale mappings and retry from a clean process.
PREVENT: qualify the NVIDIA driver, CUDA toolkit, and GDRCopy module as one versioned stack, and run copybw during node admission.
ESCALATE: a clean copybw failure with free BAR1 space is a driver or platform mapping defect. Collect dmesg, module versions, and GPU topology for the vendor case.
patterns.resumeFrom: job start after BAR1 mapping passes the control test

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Tensors must have the same dtype.* during ReduceScatter.*Broadcast
patterns.summary: Broadcast operation failed due to mismatched tensor data types during Backward pass.
patterns.action: Cast tensors to a common data type before broadcasting. (Observed in ReduceScatter).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: NCCL error in: .* during Gather.* unhandled cuda error
patterns.summary: DeepSpeed failed to initialize NCCL due to CUDA context errors during Forward pass.
patterns.action: Check GPU health, driver status, and ensure no other processes are holding the GPU. (Observed in Gather).

patterns.summary: Gloo backend timed out during initialization or communication during Backward pass.
patterns.action: Switch to NCCL for GPU communication or check network for CPU clusters. (Observed in Scatter).

patterns.re: ValueError: Mixed precision is required but not configured correctly in FSDP.* during AllGather.*
patterns.summary: FSDP mixed precision configuration is inconsistent across nodes during Forward pass.
patterns.action: Synchronize mixed precision policies across all FSDP instances. (Observed in AllGather).

patterns.re: AssertionError: ZeRO stage .* during AllReduce.* requires .* during AllReduce.*
patterns.summary: Invalid DeepSpeed ZeRO configuration during Checkpoint save.
patterns.action: Correct the DeepSpeed configuration file for the selected ZeRO stage. (Observed in AllReduce).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Gradient sync failed.* during Barrier.*Accelerate
patterns.summary: HuggingFace Accelerate failed to synchronize gradients during Optimizer step.
patterns.action: Check if gradient_accumulation_steps is consistent across instances. (Observed in Barrier).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Error loading FSDP checkpoint.* during Gather.*
patterns.summary: Failed to load sharded FSDP checkpoint during Optimizer step.
patterns.action: Ensure world size matches or use a state dict consolidation utility before loading. (Observed in Gather).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Module topology mismatch across ranks.* during AllReduce.*
patterns.summary: Different ranks have instantiated models with different architectures during Optimizer step.
patterns.action: Ensure random seeds and conditional model initializations are deterministic across ranks. (Observed in AllReduce).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: GPTQ quantized weights cannot be sharded evenly across TP
patterns.summary: Tensor Parallelism degree does not cleanly divide GPTQ quantized weights.
patterns.action: Use a Tensor Parallelism degree that divides the weight dimensions.

patterns.summary: Calculated maximum tokens per batch exceeds INT32 limits.
patterns.action: Reduce max_batch_size or max_seq_len to keep tokens within INT32 limits.

patterns.re: ValueError: context_fmha_fp32_acc is not valid when building FP16 engine
patterns.summary: FP32 accumulation for FMHA requires a different precision configuration.
patterns.action: Ensure FMHA precision settings align with the engine data type.

patterns.re: ValueError: auto_parallel requires pipeline_parallel_degree to be set
patterns.summary: Auto parallelism requires the pipeline parallelism degree to be explicitly defined.
patterns.action: Provide pipeline_parallel_degree when enabling auto_parallel.

patterns.summary: Model configuration is missing the num_hidden_layers field.
patterns.action: Add the num_hidden_layers property to the model's config.json.

patterns.re: NotImplementedError: GLM block attention is not yet fully supported
patterns.summary: GLM specific block attention mechanism is unsupported in this version.
patterns.action: Upgrade TensorRT-LLM or use a standard attention format.

patterns.re: NotImplementedError: AWQ is not supported for encoder-decoder architectures
patterns.summary: AWQ quantization cannot be applied to encoder-decoder models.
patterns.action: Use standard INT8 weight-only or FP16 for encoder-decoder models.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: use_fused_mlp is only supported with swiglu or gelu
patterns.summary: Fused MLP plugin is incompatible with the model's activation function.
patterns.action: Disable use_fused_mlp during engine compilation.

patterns.summary: TPU worker was preempted by the scheduler.
patterns.action: Resume from the latest checkpoint on a new slice.

patterns.re: XLA::HBM out of memory in AllGather.*Allocated: [0-9]+ GiB, Requested: [0-9]+ GiB.*instance_29
patterns.summary: TPU High Bandwidth Memory exhausted during AllGather.
patterns.action: Decrease batch size or enable activation checkpointing.

patterns.re: INTERNAL in AllGather.*TPU v3-128.*collective communication failed.*instance_40
patterns.summary: Collective AllGather failed with INTERNAL on v3-128.
patterns.action: Restart the TPU pod or check network health.

patterns.re: XLA::HBM out of memory in CollectivePermute.*Allocated: [0-9]+ GiB, Requested: [0-9]+ GiB.*instance_54
patterns.summary: TPU High Bandwidth Memory exhausted during CollectivePermute.
patterns.action: Decrease batch size or enable activation checkpointing.

patterns.re: UNAVAILABLE in AllGather.*TPU v3-32.*collective communication failed.*instance_71
patterns.summary: Collective AllGather failed with UNAVAILABLE on v3-32.
patterns.action: Restart the TPU pod or check network health.

patterns.summary: Trial exceeded Ray memory limit.
patterns.action: Increase memory in resources_per_trial.

patterns.summary: Replica exceeded memory limit.
patterns.action: Increase memory in ray_actor_options.

patterns.summary: SHM map failed.
patterns.action: Check system SHM limits.

patterns.summary: Tensor alloc OOM.
patterns.action: Use gradient checkpointing.

patterns.summary: Tensor alloc OOM in serve.
patterns.action: Enable dynamic batching limits.

patterns.re: Actor .* died because the node died
patterns.summary: Node died causing actor death.
patterns.action: Investigate node health.

patterns.summary: Dataset limit exceeded.
patterns.action: Set max_object_store_memory.

patterns.summary: Monitor killed worker.
patterns.action: Disable monitor if safe.

patterns.summary: Pinned object eviction failed.
patterns.action: Release object references.

patterns.summary: Cannot connect to replica.
patterns.action: Check network rules.

patterns.summary: sync_checkpoint OOM.
patterns.action: Disable sync to memory.

patterns.summary: Masking with negative infinity caused NaNs when multiplied by zero gradients.
patterns.action: Use a large negative finite number for masking instead of -inf.

patterns.summary: Rotary embeddings interaction with attention bwd produced NaNs.
patterns.action: Ensure RoPE frequencies are correctly scaled.

patterns.summary: High memory fragmentation failed backward workspace allocation.
patterns.action: Set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True.

patterns.summary: GSP RPC timeout during heavy memory allocation for workspace.
patterns.action: Disable GSP firmware if issue persists.

patterns.summary: Unaligned memory pointers passed to the kernel.
patterns.action: Ensure tensors are allocated with proper alignment.

patterns.summary: Causal mask indexing exceeded sequence bounds in backward.
patterns.action: Ensure causal mask dimensions align with sequence lengths.

patterns.re: Corrupted dropout state in backward pass
patterns.summary: Dropout state tensor was overwritten before backward pass.
patterns.action: Clone dropout state tensor if modified in place.

patterns.summary: BF16 backward pass gradients underflowed to zero.
patterns.action: Remove GradScaler, it is unnecessary for BF16.

patterns.re: Causal mask incorrect with right padding in flash_attn_varlen_bwd
patterns.summary: Right-padded sequences corrupted causal mask in varlen backward.
patterns.action: Use proper cu_seqlens to skip padding.

patterns.re: Dropout is not completely supported with varlen in this version
patterns.summary: Dropout combined with varlen attention fails in older versions.
patterns.action: Upgrade FlashAttention or disable dropout.

patterns.summary: NCCL hung during backward pass synchronization after FlashAttention.
patterns.action: Set NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and check network interfaces.

patterns.re: NotImplementedError: Cannot copy out of meta tensor.*LlamaDecoderLayer
patterns.summary: FSDP failed to materialize meta-device parameters because sync_module_states=False.
patterns.action: Set sync_module_states=True when initializing FSDP with meta device parameters.

patterns.summary: Intra-node FSDP sharding combined with inter-node DDP ran out of VRAM.
patterns.action: Decrease batch size or switch to FULL_SHARD strategy across all nodes.

patterns.summary: System RAM exhausted during optimizer step due to CPU offloading of large shards.
patterns.action: Increase host RAM or disable CPU offload for parameters.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN Call to broadcast failed.*MixtralSparseMoeBlock
patterns.summary: sync_module_states=True hangs because ranks have uninitialized parameters.
patterns.action: Ensure all modules are initialized on meta device or CPU uniformly before wrapping.

patterns.summary: NCCL hang due to uneven sequence lengths across distributed ranks.
patterns.action: Enable join() context manager or pad inputs to equal sequence lengths.

patterns.summary: CPU thread and GPU CUDA stream deadlock when limit_all_gathers=True blocks computation.
patterns.action: Set limit_all_gathers=False to allow unconstrained forward pass all-gathers.

patterns.re: ValueError: FSDP cannot wrap tied parameters.*GemmaDecoderLayer
patterns.summary: Parameter tying conflicts with FSDP wrapping policy resulting in duplicated parameters.
patterns.action: Ensure tied parameters are within the same FSDP wrapped module.

patterns.summary: Module passed to ignored_modules is not a child of the wrapped FSDP module.
patterns.action: Ensure ignored modules are instantiated and belong to the model tree before wrapping.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expected to have finished reduction.*CLIPEncoderLayer
patterns.summary: Gradient synchronization occurred prematurely during accumulation.
patterns.action: Wrap the forward and backward passes with fsdp_module.no_sync() during accumulation steps.

patterns.summary: CPU thread and GPU CUDA stream deadlock when limit_all_gathers=True blocks computation.
patterns.action: Set limit_all_gathers=False to allow unconstrained forward pass all-gathers.

patterns.summary: OOM during backward pass due to aggressive parameter prefetching.
patterns.action: Change backward_prefetch to BACKWARD_POST or disable it.

patterns.summary: CPU thread and GPU CUDA stream deadlock when limit_all_gathers=True blocks computation.
patterns.action: Set limit_all_gathers=False to allow unconstrained forward pass all-gathers.

patterns.summary: Tensor sizes across ranks do not align for scatter. Occurred specifically in MLP module during backward.
patterns.action: Check MLP implementation and ensure inputs have identical batch sizes across ranks.

patterns.summary: OOM reconstructing weights for saving. Occurred specifically in Embedding module during step.
patterns.action: Check Embedding implementation and save partitioned weights instead of gathering 16bit weights.

patterns.re: AssertionError: Tied weights are on different ranks
patterns.summary: Tied embeddings partitioned incorrectly. Occurred specifically in RotaryEmbedding module during zero_grad.
patterns.action: Check RotaryEmbedding implementation and keep tied modules on the same rank.

patterns.summary: FP16 scaling overflowed during ZeRO-1 step. Occurred specifically in Projection module during clip_grad_norm.
patterns.action: Check Projection implementation and switch to bf16 or reduce dynamic loss scale.

patterns.summary: Gather deadlocked due to rank imbalance. Occurred specifically in MLP module during scatter.
patterns.action: Check MLP implementation and ensure all ranks participate in gatheredparameters.

patterns.summary: Pinned memory not released between epochs. Occurred specifically in Embedding module during all_gather.
patterns.action: Check Embedding implementation and force garbage collection and clear cuda cache.

patterns.re: UserWarning: Weight decay with FP16 limits precision
patterns.summary: Weight decay on FP16 states causes underflow. Occurred specifically in RotaryEmbedding module during reduce_scatter.
patterns.action: Check RotaryEmbedding implementation and apply weight decay to fp32 master weights only.

patterns.summary: GPU Direct RDMA not available due to missing peermem module.
patterns.action: Load nvidia-peermem or nv_peer_mem module.

patterns.summary: IB Subnet Manager is unreachable, ports remain in INIT state.
patterns.action: Start opensm or check hardware Subnet Manager on switch.

patterns.summary: PCIe Advanced Error Reporting triggered for IB HCA.
patterns.action: Check dmesg for PCIe errors and reseat HCA or GPU.

patterns.summary: Memory registration with HCA failed, likely out of lockable memory.
patterns.action: Increase ulimit -l (memlock) to unlimited.

patterns.summary: Queue Pair creation failed due to hardware limits.
patterns.action: Increase max QPs in HCA firmware or reduce NCCL_MAX_NRINGS.

patterns.summary: Completion Queue overflowed due to high messaging rate.
patterns.action: Increase NCCL_IB_CQ_SIZE or check for stuck polling threads.

patterns.summary: Asynchronous port error event received from HCA.
patterns.action: Investigate physical link flapping or switch port errors.

patterns.summary: HCA device reported fatal asynchronous event.
patterns.action: Reboot node and check HCA firmware integrity.

patterns.summary: Failed to discover IB topology via sysfs.
patterns.action: Ensure sysfs is mounted and IB drivers are initialized.

patterns.summary: Mellanox SHARP in-network computing is requested but unavailable.
patterns.action: Disable NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE or configure SHARP AMs.

patterns.summary: PCIe cross-NIC (PXN) routing encountered a loop.
patterns.action: Check NCCL_TOPO_FILE or disable NCCL_P2P_PXN_LEVEL.

patterns.summary: Failed to transition QP to Ready To Send (RTS) state.
patterns.action: Check IB route resolution and Subnet Manager health.

patterns.summary: RDMA post send exceeded registered memory region bounds.
patterns.action: Check for corrupted pointers or NCCL buffer overruns.

patterns.summary: Scatter-gather elements requested exceed HCA capability.
patterns.action: Update HCA firmware or reduce NCCL buffer fragmentation.

patterns.summary: Active MTU is lower than requested payload MTU.
patterns.action: Ensure switch and host ports have matching MTU configurations.

patterns.summary: RDMA Connection Manager failed to resolve route.
patterns.action: Check IPoIB configuration and ARP table resolution.

patterns.summary: Base LID is zero, meaning Subnet Manager hasn't configured the port.
patterns.action: Verify IB port is connected to a managed subnet.

patterns.re: exceptions related to loss scaling and underflow
patterns.summary: When running mixed precision training in DeepSpeed with BF16 and manually scaling losses without properly configuring the DeepSpeed engine, gradients underflow and throw exceptions. Misconfigured manual scaling attempts to artificially shift gradients out of range.
patterns.action: Always use model_engine.backward(loss) instead of manual loss.backward(), and ensure bf16 configurations in the deepspeed config JSON accurately reflect the dtype so DeepSpeed can conditionally bypass unnecessary loss scaling.

patterns.re: multi-GPU offload slower than single GPU, high remote node access
patterns.summary: In multi-socket servers, DeepSpeed offload data transfers traverse QPI/UPI links between NUMA nodes instead of using the local PCIe root complex. This cross-socket PCIe traffic severely degrades throughput compared to NUMA-local transfers.
patterns.action: Pin the DeepSpeed training processes to the specific NUMA node local to each GPU using `numactl --cpunodebind` and `--membind`. Ensure PCIe affinity is aligned with the CPU socket handling the host memory offload.

requiredEvidence.re: nvidia-smi topo -m showing SYS\/NODE connections between GPUs and host RAM
numastat showing high remote NUMA node memory access during training

patterns.summary: Heavy collective operations utilizing NVLink SHARP (NVLS) on Hopper architectures can trigger PyTorch/DeepSpeed watchdog timeouts (default 10-30 mins) if the underlying fabric experiences temporary stalls or misconfiguration, exacerbated by SHARP routing complexities.
patterns.action: Set TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 for better traceback. Temporarily disable NVLS via NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0 to isolate if the issue is SHARP-related. Synchronize PyTorch and DeepSpeed timeout settings.

requiredEvidence.re: ProcessGroupNCCL watchdog timeout in PyTorch or DeepSpeed logs
H100 NVLink SHARP (NVLS) enabled in the environment

patterns.re: RuntimeError: .* not accounted for as an output of cudagraph trees
patterns.summary: Using find_unused_parameters=True in DDP alongside torch.compile and CUDA graphs causes an internal runtime error because the unused parameter graph traversals conflict with cudagraph_trees, leading to parameters not being accounted for as outputs.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=False, use static_graph=True in DDP, or disable max-autotune/cudagraphs when compiling the model.

patterns.summary: A high-rate correctable PCIe AER stream coincides with a link trained below its maximum width or speed. The link recovered individual TLP errors, but the negotiated downgrade is a physical-path fault and explains the bandwidth loss; clean ECC does not exonerate the riser/cable/slot path.
patterns.action: Drain the affected node under operator approval. Reseat the GPU and its riser/cable, inspect the slot and contacts, then boot and confirm `nvidia-smi -q` plus `lspci -vv -s <BDF>` show the expected link width and speed (for this evidence, recover from x4 / 2.5 GT/s toward the platform maximum). Re-run the host-to-device bandwidth control and require the corrected-error rate to stop increasing before re-admission.
patterns.resumeFrom: the last verified checkpoint on a healthy node

patterns.summary: The serialized TensorRT engine was built by a different TensorRT-LLM / TensorRT version than the runtime loading it. Engine plans are not portable across versions, not even patch versions in some ranges. The failure is at load, so it appears immediately on deploy and never in staging if staging shares the build image.
patterns.action:
NOW: rebuild the engine inside the exact image that will run it, or roll the runtime back to the version that produced the plan. There is no compatibility shim.
INVESTIGATE: print both versions explicitly (the runtime logs its own; the engine's is in config.json). A base-image bump in CI is the usual trigger, the build succeeded on the old image and the runtime moved.
PREVENT: build and serve from ONE pinned image digest, and treat the engine plan as an artifact of that digest. Store the digest next to the plan and refuse to load a mismatch instead of discovering it at startup.
patterns.resumeFrom: rebuild the engine in the serving image; the source checkpoint directory is unchanged

patterns.re: XLA_OOM|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Out of memory while trying to allocate.*XLA
patterns.summary: XLA compiler ran out of host or device memory during auto-sharding or HLO compilation. This is distinct from a runtime OOM and happens before execution starts.
patterns.action: If host OOM: Increase host RAM, or set `XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false`. If device OOM: The compiled graph is too large. Enable gradient checkpointing or lower the batch size before recompiling.

negativeEvidence.re: GPU is lost|GPU has been reset

patterns.summary: Xid 95, uncontained ECC error. Unlike contained Xid 94, the corruption reached the wider GPU context: all work on this GPU is suspect and the process context is lost.
patterns.action:
NOW: kill the job on this node; do NOT trust its most recent optimizer/step state, resume from the last checkpoint written BEFORE the Xid timestamp.
INVESTIGATE: nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,ROW_REMAPPER, check remap pool ("remapping pending/failed"); dcgmi diag -r 3.
PREVENT: alert on volatile DBE count > 0; schedule proactive drain when remap pool <10% free.
ESCALATE: remapping failure or repeat within a week → RMA.

patterns.summary: GPU dropped off the PCIe bus during DMA (Xid 64), bus mastering died mid-transfer.
patterns.action: Reseat the GPU and check PCIe slot/supply power cables. Reboot. Inspect dmesg `pciehp` and AER errors at the root port. Set `nvidia-smi -pm 1` to keep persistence loaded.

patterns.summary: PyTorch: shape mismatch in linear/conv forward. Matrix multiplication dimensions incompatible.
patterns.action: python -c "import torch; torch.mm(torch.randn(4,3), torch.randn(4,5))" 2>&1 | grep -oP "size mismatch.*". Fix: check model expected input shape; add print(x.shape) debug to forward(); verify dataset transform output matches model input.

patterns.summary: Mellanox driver rejected NIC command for Queue Pair.
patterns.action: Update mlx5_core driver to ROCm recommended version.

patterns.re: Topology mismatch: unable to build XGMI path
patterns.summary: RCCL could not resolve XGMI routing between GPUs.
patterns.action: Run rocminfo to confirm full mesh XGMI connectivity.

patterns.re: ROCm SMI: node is not responding
patterns.summary: SMI daemon lost communication with GPU node.
patterns.action: Restart rocm-smi daemon or reset the GPU.

patterns.summary: PyTorch ProcessGroup wrapper caught fatal RCCL error.
patterns.action: Check RCCL logs for underlying network or hardware faults.

patterns.summary: HSA runtime signaled a fatal abort to PyTorch.
patterns.action: Review dmesg for underlying GPU hardware failures.

patterns.summary: DeepSpeed failed to gather parameters in ZeRO stage 3.
patterns.action: Increase allgather bucket size or reduce model chunking.

patterns.summary: Ray actor hung during RCCL process group setup.
patterns.action: Check for orphaned Ray actors holding GPU resources.

patterns.summary: Pipeline parallelism point-to-point step timed out.
patterns.action: Balance pipeline stages across nodes.

patterns.summary: Kubernetes node went NotReady after driver panic.
patterns.action: Cordon node and re-provision OS.

patterns.summary: HIP graph instantiation failed during collective.
patterns.action: Disable RCCL graph usage via environment variable.

patterns.summary: Excessive gradient accumulation bloated workspace.
patterns.action: Adjust XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION.

patterns.action: Decrease max sequence length.

patterns.summary: JAX Device-to-Device transfer encountered an unaligned destination buffer.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN.*local timeout in.*sequence_parallel_region.*stuck in ReduceScatter.*
patterns.summary: Sequence Parallelism (SP) size mismatch or uneven padding causes a deadlock inside the sequence parallel region's ReduceScatter collective.
patterns.action: Ensure all inputs are fully padded to the target sequence length so that the sequence dimension is divisible by the TP size.

patterns.summary: Desynchronization of ColumnParallelLinear communication where some ranks skip backward gradients because of dynamic token/sequence masking.
patterns.action: Ensure all sequence masks are identical across TP ranks and that no rank dynamically skips module forward/backward blocks.

patterns.summary: Desynchronization of RowParallelLinear communication during activation all-gather due to dynamic sequence truncation on a single rank.
patterns.action: Check the sequence cropping / data loader logic. Ensure any slice operation is broadcasted and executed identically on all TP ranks.

patterns.summary: Mismatched sequence block transfer in Ring Attention within the TP group, causing a deadlock during token routing.
patterns.action: Ensure sequence length is a clean multiple of 2 * TP * CP, and verify custom ring attention communication scheduling.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*during activation recomputation backward.*
patterns.summary: Activation recomputation memory overhead exceeded GPU limit. Occurs when saving model states for recomputed backward passes.
patterns.action: Switch from full activation recomputation to selective recomputation (--recompute-activations --recompute-granularity selective).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*allocating KV cache.*TP rank.*
patterns.summary: Key-value cache memory allocation failure under high context length or high batch size in tensor parallel inference/generation.
patterns.action: Reduce the max generation length, reduce the prompt batch size, or enable flash attention paging mechanisms.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*pre-allocated communication buffer.*
patterns.summary: OOM at startup or checkpoint resume when Megatron attempts to allocate static communication buffers for TP collectives.
patterns.action: Reduce the hidden size, sequence length, or set --no-persist-layer-norm to free up memory for communication buffers.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*apply_rotary_pos_emb.*TP ranks.*
patterns.summary: OOM during rotary position embedding (RoPE) application across TP ranks. High sequence length causes temporary tensors to exceed GPU limits.
patterns.action: Enable rotary embedding checkpointing or use a fused RoPE kernel to avoid intermediate allocations.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*backup_params.*optimizer step.*
patterns.summary: OOM when backing up parameter weights for optimizer step. The temporary storage of weights causes a memory limit violation.
patterns.action: Avoid redundant weight cloning in custom training loops. Configure the optimizer to perform updates in-place.

patterns.re: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout:.*recv.*from rank.*PP stage.*
patterns.summary: Hang in pipeline send/recv due to severe compute imbalance (stragglers) or deadlock between pipeline stages.
patterns.action: Verify compute loads are balanced across stages (e.g. check number of layers per stage) and ensure no node is throttling CPU/GPU clocks.

patterns.summary: Pipeline parallel rank placement misaligned with physical node topology. Communication is routed over slow TCP instead of fast local PCIe/NVLink.
patterns.action: Verify node sorting in hostfile or SLURM task distribution. Ensure pipeline stages are placed sequentially across physical nodes.

patterns.re: RuntimeError:.*Async pipeline handle.*never waited on.*garbage collected.*
patterns.summary: Async send/recv handle was not properly waited on or lost, leading to memory leaks and out-of-order communication execution.
patterns.action: Ensure all async communication handles returned by p2p calls are appended to the wait list and synchronized at the stage boundaries.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN.*Deadlock detected in pipeline communication ring.*
patterns.summary: Deadlock in NCCL send/recv pipeline ring. Suggests recursive send/recv calls executed without proper buffering.
patterns.action: Verify that pipeline communication scheduling uses non-blocking send and recv pairs (e.g. using send_recv_tensors).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Dynamic shape transfer failed.*PP boundary.*
patterns.summary: Dynamic sequence length pipeline transfer failed to communicate shapes first, causing recipient to allocate wrong size buffer.
patterns.action: Enable --variable-seq-lengths flag so that Megatron communicates metadata shape tensors before transferring activation tensors.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*sender buffer allocation.*PP stage.*
patterns.summary: Overflow in CUDA memory when queuing send buffers in deep pipelines. Occurs when async transfers pile up on a single GPU device.
patterns.action: Enable synchronous pipeline transfers as a fallback, or increase gradient accumulation steps to reduce concurrency.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*virtual stage.*interleaved PP.*
patterns.summary: OOM when managing virtual stage models in interleaved PP. The multi-model layout exceeds GPU memory due to redundant activation storage.
patterns.action: Decrease --num-layers-per-virtual-stage, enable activation checkpointing, or use a larger PP size.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Out of memory.*shadow gradients.*PP accumulation.*
patterns.summary: Failed to allocate shadow gradients for inter-stage accumulation. Buffer limits exceeded in the backward step.
patterns.action: Reduce the gradient accumulation steps or enable gradient checkpointing for all transformer layers.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*ZeRO state updates.*PP stage.*
patterns.summary: OOM during ZeRO state updates at the boundary pipeline stages. Memory spikes when synchronizing gradients across data-parallel ranks within PP.
patterns.action: Reduce batch size, use CPU offload for optimizer state, or increase TP/PP sharding.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*input tensor buffer.*PP steps.*
patterns.summary: OOM when caching input tensors for multi-step gradient accumulation in the pipeline. Caused by high sequence lengths.
patterns.action: Reduce micro-batch size or sequence length, or offload input tensors to CPU host memory during compute wait.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*reserving forward outputs.*micro-batches.*
patterns.summary: OOM when reserving memory for forward outputs of prior micro-batches. Early stages must retain output tensors for backward pass activation matching.
patterns.action: Increase pipeline parallel size (PP size) or reduce micro-batch size to limit active micro-batches in flight.

patterns.summary: OOM when allocating double-buffers for compute-communication overlap. The pre-allocated overlap buffers exceed remaining free GPU memory.
patterns.action: Disable overlap communication flags (e.g. --no-overlap-grad-reduce or --no-overlap-param-gather).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Cannot allocate pinned host memory.*send\/recv buffers.*
patterns.summary: CUDA pinned host memory exhausted due to excessive async send/recv buffers allocated for deep pipeline stages.
patterns.action: Reduce active micro-batches or increase host virtual memory limit. Decrease page-locked memory allocations.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*incoming backprop tensor.*PP.*
patterns.summary: OOM when allocating gradients for the incoming backprop tensor at the PP boundary stage. Caused by high hidden layer count.
patterns.action: Use gradient accumulation steps to reduce active memory footprint, or reduce batch size.

patterns.re: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout:.*RingAttention.*Context Parallelism.*
patterns.summary: Context Parallelism (CP) ring attention timeout. Suggests high latency or packet loss in the CP communication ring.
patterns.action: Ensure high-speed connections are active between consecutive CP ranks, and check for GPU thermal throttling on ring nodes.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Sequence dimension mismatch during CP Ring-Attention.*
patterns.summary: Sequence dimension mismatch during CP Ring-Attention execution. Happens if sequence length is not divisible by the context parallel size.
patterns.action: Pad the input sequence length to be a clean multiple of the context_parallel_size argument.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN.*AWS EFA libfabric timed out.*3D parallel collectives.*
patterns.summary: AWS EFA libfabric timed out under heavy inter-node 3D parallel collectives. Indicates network congestion or OFI configuration issues.
patterns.action: Ensure the latest aws-ofi-nccl plugin version is installed and set FI_PROVIDER=efa for inter-node communication.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*expert gradient reduction\/scattering.*
patterns.summary: OOM during local expert gradient reduction/scattering. Memory limits hit when gathering expert parameters across MoE group.
patterns.action: Reduce the number of experts per GPU, or use sequence parallelism for routing blocks.

patterns.re: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout:.*AllToAll.*MoE expert routing.*
patterns.summary: AllToAll collective timeout in MoE expert routing across nodes. Suggests inter-node switch ports are congested.
patterns.action: Check inter-node switch links, optimize placement of experts (EP grouping) to minimize cross-node token routing.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*broadcasting sharded parameters.*DP\/PP groups.*
patterns.summary: OOM when broadcasting sharded parameters from rank 0 to other ranks in DP/PP groups during model checkpoint load.
patterns.action: Load model checkpoint onto CPU memory first, then load weights incrementally into each GPU stage to avoid broadcast memory peaks.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*coalescing multiple small TP\/DP allreduces.*
patterns.summary: OOM when coalescing multiple small TP/DP allreduces into a single buffer. The coalesced buffer exceeds remaining free GPU memory.
patterns.action: Reduce --coalesce-bucket-size parameter or disable parameter/gradient coalescing options.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expert capacity factor set too high.*memory crash.*
patterns.summary: Expert capacity factor set too high, leading to memory crash during expert buffer allocation in MoE layers.
patterns.action: Decrease the capacity factor (e.g. set --moe-capacity-factor to 1.0 or 1.2) to limit expert routing sizes.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Incorrect gradient aggregation sequence in Context Parallel backward pass.*
patterns.summary: Incorrect gradient aggregation sequence in Context Parallel backward pass. Ranks assembled ring tokens in incorrect order.
patterns.action: Verify sequence length split indexing in custom attention modules when CP is enabled.

patterns.summary: Failed to modify InfiniBand Queue Pair state.
patterns.action: Check OFED drivers and IB device limits.

patterns.summary: Mellanox driver reported a Completion Queue Entry error.
patterns.action: Update MLNX_OFED driver to a stable version.

patterns.summary: PCIe Access Control Services blocking P2P.
patterns.action: Disable ACS in BIOS or set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1.

patterns.summary: Host IOMMU blocked GPU P2P transfers.
patterns.action: Add iommu=pt to kernel boot parameters.

patterns.summary: GPU clock crash (Xid 13) stalling NCCL ring.
patterns.action: Lock GPU clocks to a stable lower frequency.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN.*Call to connect returned Connection timed out.*
patterns.summary: Socket connect timed out setting up SP ring.
patterns.action: Check firewall rules and routing between nodes.

patterns.summary: BGP route flap caused temporary network unreachability.
patterns.action: Check datacenter router logs.

patterns.summary: Kubernetes cgroup memory limit exceeded.
patterns.action: Increase container memory limits in pod spec.

patterns.summary: Shmget failed due to invalid arguments (size limit).
patterns.action: Check kernel shmmax settings (sysctl kernel.shmmax).

patterns.summary: Tree formation failed, and ring fallback timed out.
patterns.action: Set NCCL_TREE_DISABLE=1 to save time.

patterns.summary: Colossal-AI microbatch mismatch dropping sync.
patterns.action: Ensure batch size is evenly divisible by SP degree.

patterns.summary: NCCL API usage violation.
patterns.action: Update PyTorch and Colossal-AI to compatible versions.

patterns.re: ldlm_request\.c:\d+:(?:ldlm_expired_completion_wait|ldlm_cli_cancel_req|ldlm_cli_enqueue_fini)|lock timed out \(enqueued at|(?:server|client)[^\n]{0,40}timed out on lock cancel|ldlm_cancel_pack[^\n]*timeout
patterns.summary: A Lustre distributed lock request timed out. Multiple ranks are contending for locks on the same directory or file range, usually a shared dataset path opened by every DataLoader worker at once, and the metadata server could not service the cancellation inside the lock timeout.
patterns.action: Identify the contended path from the lock resource in the message, then remove the contention rather than raising the timeout. If the file locks are only meaningful inside one process, mount with `-o localflock` so they are never sent to the server. If several ranks genuinely share the path, give each rank its own subdirectory or stripe the dataset. Raising `lctl set_param ldlm.timeouts.timeout=100` buys time and does not remove the contention, so treat it as containment.
patterns.resumeFrom: the last checkpoint written before the lock timeout, once the contended path is confirmed readable

patterns.summary: A physical InfiniBand link is accumulating symbol errors or transmit discards and repeatedly retraining under load.
patterns.action: Map the counter to its switch and HCA port, clean and reseat the optical connector, swap one cable or transceiver at a time, then require stable counters during an all-reduce control.
patterns.resumeFrom: the last verified checkpoint before the first link error burst

patterns.summary: ZeRO-3 keeps parameters sharded until they are gathered for use. Code touched a parameter outside a gather context, so it was still partitioned, typically custom forward logic, weight tying, or an initialization step that reads .data directly.
patterns.action:
NOW: wrap the access in a gather, with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters([param], modifier_rank=0): ..., around the code that touches the weight.
INVESTIGATE: the exception names the parameter id; map it back with [ (n,p.ds_id) for n,p in model.named_parameters() ]. Look for direct .data / .weight reads outside forward(), custom weight init after deepspeed.initialize(), tied embeddings, or a checkpoint-load path that assigns weights directly.
PREVENT: do all weight initialization and tying BEFORE deepspeed.initialize(). For any custom module that reads its own weights, add the GatheredParameters context as part of the module rather than at the call site.
ESCALATE: if it fires inside library code you do not control, pin the offending module with zero.Init(enabled=False) as a targeted workaround.

patterns.summary: The rotary embedding dimension does not divide evenly into the attention head dimension. This is a configuration arithmetic error, caught at construction: hidden_size / num_attention_heads must be compatible with the rotary percentage.
patterns.action:
NOW: check the arithmetic. head_dim = hidden_size / num_attention_heads, and rotary_dim = head_dim * rotary_percent must be an even integer.
INVESTIGATE: the usual cause is changing num_attention_heads or hidden_size without re-deriving the rest, or importing a config from a model with a different head layout. Print all four values together, the mismatch is obvious once they are side by side.
PREVENT: derive head_dim in the config rather than hardcoding it, and assert divisibility at config load rather than discovering it at model build.
ESCALATE: if you are matching a published checkpoint's layout, take hidden_size, num_attention_heads and rotary_percent from that checkpoint's config verbatim rather than adjusting one of them.
patterns.resumeFrom: job start after correcting the config

patterns.summary: Liquid cooling flow dropped below the safe threshold. This is a facilities fault with a very short fuse, direct-liquid-cooled GPUs have little thermal mass, so an emergency power-off follows quickly and every job on the affected loop dies at once.
patterns.action:
NOW: treat as a facility incident, not a GPU one. Confirm whether the power-off already fired, and stop scheduling onto the affected loop.
INVESTIGATE: check pump status, filter differential pressure, and for trapped air in the secondary loop. A gradual flow decline usually means a clogging filter; a sudden one means a pump or valve.
PREVENT: alert on the flow TREND, not only on the threshold, a filter clogs over days and is visible long before it trips the alarm. Verify redundant pump failover actually works rather than assuming it.
ESCALATE: facilities/DC operations immediately. Do not restart workloads on that loop until flow is verified stable, or the next power-off will hit mid-checkpoint.
patterns.resumeFrom: latest checkpoint, on a different cooling loop

patterns.summary: Ray could not prepare the job runtime environment before its setup deadline. Package download, dependency installation, or working-directory upload is stalled or too large on at least one node.
patterns.action:
NOW: read runtime_env_setup logs on the named node and identify whether download, extraction, or pip installation consumed the timeout.
INVESTIGATE: test object-store and package-index access from that node, then measure the working_dir archive size. A blocked egress path and a multi-gigabyte upload produce the same outer exception.
PREVENT: bake stable dependencies into the image, exclude checkpoints and datasets from working_dir, and pin packages so setup is deterministic.
ESCALATE: if a small cached environment still times out, clear the failed runtime environment cache on the node and capture the dashboard agent logs for Ray support.
patterns.resumeFrom: job submission after runtime environment setup succeeds

patterns.re: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout: WorkNCCL.* during Barrier.*
patterns.summary: NCCL watchdog timed out waiting for a collective to complete during Initialization.
patterns.action: Check network connectivity or workload imbalance between ranks. (Observed in Barrier).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: NCCL error in: .* during Barrier.* invalid usage
patterns.summary: Invalid argument passed to NCCL collective during Evaluation loop.
patterns.action: Ensure tensor sizes and types are supported by NCCL. (Observed in Barrier).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Gradient sync failed.* during ReduceScatter.*Accelerate
patterns.summary: HuggingFace Accelerate failed to synchronize gradients during Checkpoint load.
patterns.action: Check if gradient_accumulation_steps is consistent across instances. (Observed in ReduceScatter).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Module topology mismatch across ranks.* during Broadcast.*
patterns.summary: Different ranks have instantiated models with different architectures during Evaluation loop.
patterns.action: Ensure random seeds and conditional model initializations are deterministic across ranks. (Observed in Broadcast).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration before starting a new one.* during Reduce.*
patterns.summary: A parameter was not used in the forward pass, breaking DDP reduction during Optimizer step.
patterns.action: Set find_unused_parameters=True or ensure all parameters are used in forward. (Observed in Reduce).

patterns.summary: Kubernetes lost connection to a worker node during Initialization.
patterns.action: Check cluster node health and network connectivity. (Observed in Gather).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Gradient sync failed.* during ReduceScatter.*Accelerate
patterns.summary: HuggingFace Accelerate failed to synchronize gradients during Initialization.
patterns.action: Check if gradient_accumulation_steps is consistent across instances. (Observed in ReduceScatter).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Module topology mismatch across ranks.* during AllReduce.*
patterns.summary: Different ranks have instantiated models with different architectures during Backward pass.
patterns.action: Ensure random seeds and conditional model initializations are deterministic across ranks. (Observed in AllReduce).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Rank \d+ is calling collective \w+, but Rank \d+ is calling collective \w+.* during ReduceScatter.*
patterns.summary: Different ranks called different collectives, causing a deadlock during Backward pass.
patterns.action: Ensure all ranks execute the same communication operations in the same order. (Observed in ReduceScatter).

patterns.re: ValueError: max_batch_size .* exceeds maximum allowed limit
patterns.summary: The specified max_batch_size exceeds TensorRT limits.
patterns.action: Reduce max_batch_size or split engine build into smaller profiles.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: gather_all_token_logits requires .* memory, exceeding limits
patterns.summary: Gathering all token logits requires too much memory.
patterns.action: Disable gather_all_token_logits unless explicitly needed for distillation/scoring.

patterns.re: AssertionError: is_gated_act=True but weights only have 2 layers instead of 3
patterns.summary: Model specified gated activation but weights do not contain the gate layer.
patterns.action: Disable gated MLP or provide correct weights.

patterns.re: ValueError: strongly_typed cannot be enabled with FP8 mixed precision
patterns.summary: Strongly typed TensorRT graph is incompatible with the FP8 configuration.
patterns.action: Disable --strongly_typed when building the FP8 engine.

patterns.summary: Cross-replica ReduceScatter timed out waiting for peers in TPU pod.
patterns.action: Check for straggler nodes or uneven shard workloads.

patterns.summary: Device infeed queue blocked waiting for host.
patterns.action: Optimize host-side tf.data or dataloader pipelines.

patterns.summary: Incompatible sharding specifications during AllToAll.
patterns.action: Ensure jax.Array sharding specs align across all dimensions.

patterns.summary: Cross-replica AllReduce timed out waiting for peers in TPU pod.
patterns.action: Check for straggler nodes or uneven shard workloads.

patterns.re: XLA::HBM out of memory in CollectivePermute.*Allocated: [0-9]+ GiB, Requested: [0-9]+ GiB.*instance_60
patterns.summary: TPU High Bandwidth Memory exhausted during CollectivePermute.
patterns.action: Decrease batch size or enable activation checkpointing.

patterns.summary: TPU worker was preempted by the scheduler.
patterns.action: Resume from the latest checkpoint on a new slice.

patterns.summary: C++ bad_alloc from OOM.
patterns.action: Reduce dataloader workers.

patterns.summary: C++ bad_alloc from OOM.
patterns.action: Reduce concurrent requests.

patterns.summary: Raylet killed actor.
patterns.action: Check raylet logs for OOM.

patterns.summary: Parquet read OOM.

patterns.re: zmq\.error\.ZMQError|ZMQError:[^\n]{0,60}(?:Address already in use|Connection refused|Resource temporarily unavailable)|Failed to bind to ipc:\/\/|ipc:\/\/[^\s]{0,80}(?:No such file|Permission denied)
patterns.summary: The ZMQ IPC channel between the vLLM API server and its EngineCore could not be established. The transport is a unix socket under the process temp dir, so this is an environment fault (stale socket from an unclean shutdown, a read-only or noexec /tmp, or a second server already bound), not a model or memory problem.
patterns.action:
NOW: check for an orphaned server holding the socket (ss -xl | grep vllm) and kill it; clear stale sockets from VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH (default the system temp dir); restart.
INVESTIGATE: is /tmp (or TMPDIR) writable and not noexec inside the container? Read-only root filesystems and tmpfs mounted noexec both break IPC while leaving the model load looking fine. Confirm the temp dir is NOT shared between replicas, two pods on one hostPath collide on the socket name.
PREVENT: set VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH to a per-replica emptyDir; add a preStop hook so shutdown removes the socket.
patterns.resumeFrom: no checkpoint, clear the stale IPC socket and restart

patterns.summary: A TensorRT-LLM executor worker aborted inside forwardAsync. Under MPI orchestration one dead worker takes the whole ensemble down, so a fault on a single rank presents as a total outage, and the surviving ranks' logs are usually empty of the actual cause.
patterns.action:
NOW: restart the server. Collect stderr from EVERY rank, not just rank 0: the failing rank holds the assertion text and rank 0 typically shows only the MPI abort.
INVESTIGATE: the [TensorRT-LLM][ERROR] assertion names the tensor and the constraint it violated, that is the diagnosis, and it usually points at a request exceeding a build-time limit (max_input_len, max_num_tokens, max_beam_width). Those are baked into the engine, so a request that violates one cannot be served without a rebuild.
PREVENT: enforce the engine's build-time limits at the gateway so an oversized request is rejected with a 400 instead of killing every rank.
patterns.resumeFrom: no checkpoint, the built engine is reusable; restart the runtime

negativeEvidence.re: GPU is lost|GPU has been reset

patterns.summary: The job ran out of memory on a MIG SLICE, not on the whole GPU. CUDA is seeing a partition of the card, so the model is not oversized, it is on the wrong device.
patterns.action:
Confirm what the job was actually given: `nvidia-smi -L` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=mig.mode.current --format=csv`, and compare `torch.cuda.device_count()` with the number of GPUs requested.
Fix the allocation, not the model: disable MIG on the node (`nvidia-smi -mig 0`, which needs a drain and a GPU reset) or make the scheduler request whole GPUs. Slurm `--gres=gpu:N`, or a Kubernetes `nvidia.com/gpu` request rather than an `nvidia.com/mig-*` profile. If the node is intentionally partitioned, route the job to an unpartitioned one.
Do NOT reduce batch size or enable gradient checkpointing to fit the slice: that squeezes a model sized for the full card into a fraction of it and destroys throughput while leaving the misallocation in place.

patterns.re: Error binding to V[46] interface|Bind_sockets[^\n]{0,40}(?:FATAL|Cannot bind)|Cannot bind [A-Z]+ (?:udp|tcp)[46]? socket
patterns.summary: The NFS-Ganesha daemon aborted during startup: binding its listening socket on the V6 interface failed, so it logged FATAL and could not continue. The earlier "Permission denied" lines (recovery directory, RQUOTA socket) are precursors of the same missing privilege, not an export or client-auth problem, nothing is exported yet, because the server never finished starting.
patterns.action:
1. Confirm the failure is privilege, not a port already in use:
   ss -lntup | grep -E ":(2049|875|111)\b"       # RQUOTA 875, nfsd 2049, rpcbind 111
2. If nothing holds the port, the daemon lacks permission to bind. In a container, grant the one capability rather than running privileged:
   docker/podman: --cap-add=NET_BIND_SERVICE
   Kubernetes:    securityContext.capabilities.add: ["NET_BIND_SERVICE"]
   systemd:       AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
3. If the host disables IPv6, Ganesha still tries a V6 bind by default, either re-enable IPv6 on the interface, or set NFS_Core_Param { Enable_witness = false; Bind_addr = 0.0.0.0; } to bind V4 only.
4. Check the recovery directory the first error named: it must exist and be writable by the daemon user (`/var/lib/nfs/ganesha`).
5. If SELinux/AppArmor is enforcing, look for a matching AVC denial (`ausearch -m avc -ts recent`) before changing capabilities.
If the bind still fails with the capability granted, run the daemon in the foreground with `-F -L /dev/stdout -N NIV_DEBUG` and read the first Bind_sockets line, it names the exact address and port it attempted.
patterns.resumeFrom: not applicable, the server has not started; no client state is at risk

patterns.re: NCCL error in: .* unhandled system error \/ NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME mismatch on aks-ray-head.aks.cluster.local

patterns.re: raylet.cc on aks-ray-head.aks.cluster.local:.* Invalid configuration parameter: .*

patterns.summary: Disk filled up mid-write causing data corruption of spilled Ray blocks.

patterns.summary: NCCL watchdog timeout in sequence parallel ReduceScatter. Suggests one or more ranks failed to reach the collective boundary due to slow dataloading.
patterns.action: Check for straggler nodes or slow data preprocessing. Ensure no CPU-bound operations are blocking GPU training steps.

patterns.summary: AllGather along the first (sequence) dimension failed in Sequence Parallelism due to uneven dimension lengths across TP ranks.
patterns.action: Check for sequence cropping or dynamic padding layers that change the first dimension of tensors in a non-uniform manner.

patterns.summary: Scatter operation failed along the sequence dimension in a sequence parallel region because the sequence length is not divisible by the TP size.
patterns.action: Pad the input batch sequence length to be a clean multiple of the tensor_model_parallel_size configuration.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*gradient accumulation.*tensor parallel model.*
patterns.summary: Memory exhaustion when accumulating gradients across multiple micro-batches in tensor-parallel model layers.
patterns.action: Enable gradient clipping, or offload gradients to CPU if using a supported optimizer like DeepSpeed CPUOffload.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Out of memory.*activation buffer.*TP forward.*
patterns.summary: Activation buffer allocation failure during the forward pass across TP ranks. High sequence length causes local tensor allocations to fail.
patterns.action: Enable sequence parallelism (--sequence-parallel) to distribute activation tensors along the sequence dimension across TP ranks.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*grad reduction.*sharded optimizer.*TP.*
patterns.summary: OOM during gradient reduction with sharded optimizers (ZeRO / DistributedOptimizer) under TP. Memory spike occurs when assembling full gradients.
patterns.action: Enable overlap_grad_reduce or use cpu_offload to move optimizer states out of GPU memory.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*dropout mask.*SP region.*
patterns.summary: OOM during dropout mask allocation in TP sequence parallel regions. Occurs when storing masks for the backward pass.
patterns.action: Reduce dropout rate to 0.0 for large context pretraining, or enable dropout mask recomputation from seeds.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*shadow weights.*parameter sync.*
patterns.summary: OOM when allocating shadow weights (FP32 master parameters or parameter copies) for parameter synchronization during optimizer update.
patterns.action: Reduce model parameter count, use a 16-bit optimizer state, or run with fewer TP parameters per node.

patterns.summary: P2P communication channel blocked by driver or network deadlock. Occurs during heavy multi-stage pipeline communication phases.
patterns.action: Verify that NCCL_CROSS_NIC is enabled if crossing network cards, and check for correct PCIe peer-to-peer configurations.

patterns.summary: CUDA stream synchronization failed for async P2P pipeline calls, implying a kernel launch error or memory error occurred on the communication stream.
patterns.action: Enable CUDA launch blocking (CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1) to trace the exact line that generated the asynchronous CUDA error.

patterns.re: TypeError: Cannot convert.*during inter-stage pipeline transfer.*
patterns.summary: Error converting tensor dtype during inter-stage pipeline transfer. Occurs when cast parameters differ between stage modules.
patterns.action: Ensure all custom layer definitions at stage boundaries explicitly cast inputs to the expected forward precision.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*sharding gradients.*PP boundary.*
patterns.summary: OOM when sharding gradients across pipeline boundary ranks. Memory spike occurs when merging backward gradients with parameter shards.
patterns.action: Reduce the distributed optimizer partition size or switch to ZeRO-3 optimizer configuration.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*optimizer state copies.*PP boundary.*
patterns.summary: OOM during optimizer state copies at stage boundaries. Memory limits exceeded when creating parameter replicas for weight step.
patterns.action: Run with a sharded optimizer (like ZeRO Stage 1/2) or reduce model parameter count.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*global gradient norm.*PP boundary.*
patterns.summary: OOM during global gradient norm calculation across pipeline boundaries. High model dimension causes memory spikes during clip norm reduces.
patterns.action: Perform gradient clipping in FP32 on CPU, or shard the gradient clipping operation across pipeline nodes.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.*NCCL communication descriptors.*
patterns.summary: OOM in CUDA driver allocation for NCCL communication descriptors. Occurs when training has too many pipeline and tensor parallel groups.
patterns.action: Reduce total pipeline stages, or set NCCL_BUFFSIZE to a lower value (e.g. 1MB or 2MB) to save driver allocation memory.

patterns.re: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout.*cross-talk between TP and PP.*
patterns.summary: NCCL watchdog timeout from cross-talk between TP and PP communication groups. Network channels are saturated by simultaneous transfers.
patterns.action: Configure NCCL_CROSS_NIC=1, enable traffic isolation, or adjust port numbers to separate TP and PP traffic.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Hang in Context Parallelism stream overlap during long context training.*
patterns.summary: Hang in Context Parallelism stream overlap during long context training. Thread priority inversion blocks compute stream execution.
patterns.action: Insert explicit sync points on default CUDA stream, and make sure CP stream handles are properly resolved.

patterns.summary: RDMA local protection error (access violation).
patterns.action: Verify memory registration boundaries.

patterns.summary: Polling Completion Queue timed out.
patterns.action: Check fabric latency and congestion.

patterns.summary: TCP RST received during active SP forward pass.
patterns.action: Check intermediate firewalls dropping long connections.

patterns.summary: CPU OOM in dataloader caused NCCL rank to drop.
patterns.action: Reduce num_workers in PyTorch DataLoader.

patterns.summary: IPC shared memory segment removed unexpectedly.
patterns.action: Disable systemd RemoveIPC=yes in logind.conf.

patterns.summary: NCCL_COMM_BLOCKING mismatch across ranks.
patterns.action: Set NCCL_COMM_BLOCKING consistently on all nodes.

patterns.summary: Weights and Biases is rejecting the run with a rate limit. Every rank is logging to the same project at once, so a job that works at small scale starts failing the moment the world size grows, and the run dies for a reason that has nothing to do with the model.
patterns.action: Log from rank zero only, which is the fix in almost every case. Where every rank genuinely needs its own run, switch to offline mode for the duration of the job with `wandb.init(mode="offline")` and run `wandb sync` afterwards, so the training loop never blocks on the API. Increase the logging interval before increasing retries: retrying into a rate limit extends the outage.
patterns.resumeFrom: the last checkpoint before the run was terminated, once logging is restricted to one rank or moved offline

patterns.summary: The GPU Operator or DCGM exporter hit the pod process limit, so Kubernetes killed or prevented required helper processes despite available GPU memory.
patterns.action: Measure current pids.current and pids.max, then raise kubelet podPidsLimit through the approved node configuration and restart only the affected daemonset.
patterns.resumeFrom: not applicable, restore the device management plane first

patterns.re: NVLS[^\n]*(?:Failed to allocate multicast group|multicast slot[^\n]*(?:exhaust|unavailable)|resource exhaustion)
patterns.summary: NCCL could not allocate another NVLS multicast resource for the communicator layout. The sub-communicator count exceeded the available hardware or driver-managed slots.
patterns.action: Run one identical control with NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0. If it succeeds, reduce or reuse process groups and device meshes before restoring NVLS. Verify Fabric Manager health separately.
patterns.resumeFrom: the latest verified checkpoint, after communicator initialization passes

patterns.re: The current process just got forked, after parallelism has already been used|TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM[^\n]{0,60}(deadlock|disabl)
patterns.summary: The Rust tokenizer's thread pool was already active when the process forked, so the child inherits locks held by threads that do not exist in it. The warning precedes either a silent hang in the DataLoader workers or a large unexplained slowdown.
patterns.action:
NOW: set TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false in the environment before the process starts (not in Python after import, the pool may already exist).
INVESTIGATE: the fork is usually DataLoader with num_workers>0, or datasets.map(num_proc=N). Confirm by setting num_workers=0, if the hang disappears, this is it.
PREVENT: tokenize BEFORE forking. Pre-tokenize the dataset once and cache it, so the training loop's workers never touch a tokenizer. This is faster as well as safer.
ESCALATE: if throughput genuinely depends on parallel tokenization, keep it in the parent and use a pre-tokenized memory-mapped dataset rather than tokenizing inside workers.

patterns.re: failed to load model[^\n]{0,90}TensorRT engine built with CUDA[^\n]{0,60}(cannot run|incompatible)
patterns.summary: A TensorRT engine (a .plan/.engine file) was built against a different CUDA/TensorRT version than the one the server is running. TensorRT engines are not portable across versions, they are compiled artifacts tied to the exact runtime that produced them.
patterns.action:
NOW: rebuild the engine on the machine that will serve it, using the same container image. Do not attempt to load a plan built elsewhere.
INVESTIGATE: compare the build and serve environments, the TensorRT version, the CUDA runtime, and the GPU compute capability must all match. An engine built on an A100 (sm_80) will not load on an H100 (sm_90) either, regardless of CUDA version.
PREVENT: build engines as part of the same image build that serves them, or key the engine cache on (trt_version, cuda_version, gpu_arch) so a mismatched artifact is never selected.
ESCALATE: if engines must be prebuilt centrally, produce one per target architecture and select at load time.
patterns.resumeFrom: server start, after the engine is rebuilt

patterns.summary: FP8 matrix multiply was requested on a GPU without hardware FP8 support. torch._scaled_mm requires compute capability 8.9 or newer (Ada, Hopper, Blackwell); Ampere (sm_80/sm_86) has no FP8 tensor cores and cannot emulate them at useful speed.
patterns.action:
NOW: fall back to BF16 on this hardware. Confirm what you have: torch.cuda.get_device_capability(), it must be >= (8, 9).
INVESTIGATE: this usually appears when a config or container built for H100 is run on A100. Check whether the model checkpoint itself is FP8-quantized, if so it needs requantizing to BF16/INT8, not just a flag change.
PREVENT: gate the FP8 code path on the detected capability rather than on a config flag, so the same image runs correctly on mixed fleets.
ESCALATE: if FP8 throughput is required, the workload needs Hopper or newer; no software setting substitutes for the tensor cores.
patterns.resumeFrom: job start with BF16, or reschedule onto sm_89+

patterns.re: Cowardly refusing to serialize non-leaf tensor
patterns.summary: Something still attached to the autograd graph was handed to the checkpoint writer. Saving it would serialise the graph as well as the values, so torch refuses rather than writing a checkpoint that cannot be loaded cleanly.
patterns.action:
NOW: detach before saving.detach() on the offending tensor, or save model.state_dict() rather than tensors captured from the training loop.
INVESTIGATE: this is almost always a metric or a buffer accumulated inside the loop without detaching (running loss, a cached activation) that ended up in the checkpoint dict. Print which keys carry requires_grad: [k for k,v in sd.items() if torch.is_tensor(v) and v.requires_grad].
PREVENT: accumulate metrics as floats (loss.item()) rather than tensors. A tensor kept across steps also holds its whole graph alive, so this bug usually comes with a memory leak.
ESCALATE: if it is a genuine parameter, save it inside state_dict() where the framework handles detachment for you.

patterns.summary: The reference model and the policy model have different vocabulary sizes, so their logits cannot be compared. DPO scores the policy against the reference token by token, a vocab difference of even a few entries makes every comparison meaningless.
patterns.action:
NOW: check both vocabulary sizes, model.config.vocab_size on each. The difference is usually a handful of added special tokens (chat template, padding, tool tokens).
INVESTIGATE: this happens when the policy was fine-tuned with resize_token_embeddings() after adding tokens, while the reference was loaded from the original checkpoint. The policy is right; the reference is stale.
PREVENT: load the reference from the SAME checkpoint the policy was initialised from, after any token additions. In TRL, prefer the implicit reference (a frozen copy of the policy) over loading a separate model, which cannot drift by construction.
ESCALATE: if the reference must be a different model, resize its embeddings to match and confirm the added rows are not random, they must correspond to the same tokens.

patterns.re: Switch Tray ASIC[^\n]{0,80}link training failed|nvswitch-diag[^\n]{0,80}link training
patterns.summary: An NVLink switch tray port failed link training, the physical layer could not establish a clean signal. On an NVL72-class rack this removes a path from the fabric, and collectives crossing it either fail or silently take a much slower route.
patterns.action:
NOW: fence the affected tray/port and drain jobs whose topology crosses it. A partially trained fabric produces slow, non-deterministic collectives that look like a software problem.
INVESTIGATE: "eye diagram closed" is a signal-integrity result, not a configuration one, check cable/connector seating, contamination, and bend radius on the named port. Compare error counters at both ends; a fault at one end only narrows it to that side.
PREVENT: record link training results as part of rack acceptance and after any physical work, and alert on retrain events rather than only on hard failures.
ESCALATE: persists after reseat and cable swap → tray service request with counters from both endpoints and the port GUID.

patterns.re: ValueError: Mixed precision is required but not configured correctly in FSDP.* during ReduceScatter.*
patterns.summary: FSDP mixed precision configuration is inconsistent across nodes during Evaluation loop.
patterns.action: Synchronize mixed precision policies across all FSDP instances. (Observed in ReduceScatter).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: The server socket has failed to listen on any local network address.* during Gather.*

patterns.summary: InfiniBand initialization failed for NCCL during Forward pass.

patterns.re: KeyError: 'act_max' not found in calibration stats
