patterns.summary: Azure Accelerated Networking driver timeout.
patterns.action: Update Azure Linux agent and NIC drivers.

patterns.summary: Host memory bandwidth bottleneck caused NCCL timeout.
patterns.action: Ensure PCIe gen4/gen5 speeds and RAM frequency.

patterns.re: Overflow detected[^\n]{0,60}(fp16|gradient unscaling)|loss scale (halved|reduced) to [\d.eE-]+|Attempted loss scale: [\d.]+, reducing
patterns.summary: FP16 gradient overflow forced the loss scaler to halve repeatedly. Occasional skipped steps early in training are normal; a scale that keeps collapsing means gradients are genuinely exploding or the model is numerically unstable in FP16.
patterns.action:
NOW: distinguish transient from terminal, if the scale recovers and training continues, this is normal warm-up behaviour. If it keeps halving toward the minimum, stop the run.
INVESTIGATE: log the gradient norm per step. A norm that grows without bound is an optimization problem (learning rate, warm-up, missing gradient clipping), not a precision problem. A norm that is fine while the scale still collapses points at a single layer overflowing. LayerNorm and attention logits are the usual sites.
PREVENT: prefer BF16 over FP16 on Ampere and later; it has FP32's exponent range and does not need loss scaling at all. If FP16 is required, add gradient clipping and a longer warm-up.
ESCALATE: switching to BF16 resolves it → the model was never FP16-stable; do not treat the scaler as the bug.
patterns.resumeFrom: last checkpoint before the scale began collapsing

patterns.summary: Kubernetes lost connection to a worker node during Optimizer step.
patterns.action: Check cluster node health and network connectivity. (Observed in AllReduce).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Rank \d+ is calling collective \w+, but Rank \d+ is calling collective \w+.* during Scatter.*
patterns.summary: Different ranks called different collectives, causing a deadlock during Initialization.
patterns.action: Ensure all ranks execute the same communication operations in the same order. (Observed in Scatter).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: NCCL error in: .* during AllGather.* invalid usage
patterns.summary: Invalid argument passed to NCCL collective during Checkpoint save.
patterns.action: Ensure tensor sizes and types are supported by NCCL. (Observed in AllGather).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: NCCL error in: .* during Barrier.* invalid usage
patterns.summary: Invalid argument passed to NCCL collective during Checkpoint load.
patterns.action: Ensure tensor sizes and types are supported by NCCL. (Observed in Barrier).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate .* during Scatter.* bytes. .* during Scatter.* during DDP bucket allocation
patterns.summary: DDP gradient bucket allocation exceeded available GPU memory during Forward pass.
patterns.action: Reduce DDP bucket_cap_mb or batch size. (Observed in Scatter).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Rank \d+ is calling collective \w+, but Rank \d+ is calling collective \w+.* during AllGather.*
patterns.summary: Different ranks called different collectives, causing a deadlock during Backward pass.
patterns.action: Ensure all ranks execute the same communication operations in the same order. (Observed in AllGather).

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Gradient sync failed.* during Gather.*Accelerate
patterns.summary: HuggingFace Accelerate failed to synchronize gradients during Backward pass.
patterns.action: Check if gradient_accumulation_steps is consistent across instances. (Observed in Gather).

patterns.summary: System RAM was exhausted during weight loading in build.py.
patterns.action: Increase system memory or use --load_by_shard to load weights iteratively.

patterns.summary: Incompatible sharding specifications during AllGather.
patterns.action: Ensure jax.Array sharding specs align across all dimensions.

patterns.summary: Cross-replica CollectivePermute timed out waiting for peers in TPU pod.
patterns.action: Check for straggler nodes or uneven shard workloads.

patterns.re: XLA::HBM out of memory in AllReduce.*Allocated: [0-9]+ GiB, Requested: [0-9]+ GiB.*instance_46
patterns.summary: TPU High Bandwidth Memory exhausted during AllReduce.
patterns.action: Decrease batch size or enable activation checkpointing.

patterns.summary: Cross-replica CollectivePermute timed out waiting for peers in TPU pod.

patterns.summary: TPU High Bandwidth Memory exhausted during AllReduce.

patterns.summary: TPU worker was preempted by the scheduler.

patterns.summary: Worker died, likely OOM.

patterns.action: Monitor system memory.

patterns.re: Failed to offload weights in TensorRT
patterns.summary: DLA is not available or weights cannot be mapped.
patterns.action: Switch to GPU execution or verify DLA configuration.

patterns.re: Failed to register TensorRT Execution Provider
patterns.summary: ORT failed to load TensorRT provider for optimization.
patterns.action: Verify TensorRT libraries match the ORT version used by Triton.

patterns.summary: Multithreaded operations in Python stub caused a GIL deadlock.
patterns.action: Avoid blocking calls in model.py or use asyncio properly.

patterns.summary: Concurrent executions caused a deadlock inside the TorchScript runtime.
patterns.action: Limit instance count to 1 or fix thread-safety in custom ops.

patterns.re: Slow memory transfer in PyTorch backend
patterns.summary: Transferring non-pinned memory to GPU is causing latency spikes.
patterns.action: Ensure client sends pinned memory or enable Triton pinned memory pool.

patterns.summary: Batcher delay is too low for current QPS, dispatching size 1 batches.
patterns.action: Increase max_queue_delay_microseconds to accumulate more requests.

patterns.summary: Response ordering failed due to internal queue state corruption.
patterns.action: Disable preserve_ordering if strict ordering is not required.

patterns.summary: Sequence was evicted but state memory was not freed properly by backend.
patterns.action: Fix memory leaks in custom/Python backends when sequences end.

patterns.summary: Ensemble pipeline stalled, likely due to a component hanging.
patterns.action: Ensure component models have sufficient instances and timeouts.

patterns.summary: NFD encountered an unmapped PCI vendor/device ID.
patterns.action: Update NFD hardware database or ignore unknown IDs.

patterns.re: runc create failed: unable to start container process
patterns.summary: runc failed to create the container process.
patterns.action: Check containerd logs for prestart hook failures.

patterns.re: Failed to setup INTx for device
patterns.summary: Legacy interrupt setup failed for the GPU.
patterns.action: Force MSI/MSI-X interrupts for the VFIO device.

patterns.summary: Kubelet failed to sync the pod state.
patterns.action: Check for pod sandbox creation errors or storage issues.

patterns.summary: Legacy nvidia-docker wrapper encountered an error.
patterns.action: Migrate to the native nvidia-container-toolkit.

patterns.summary: Prestart hook failed to run ldconfig.
patterns.action: Check container root filesystem permissions.

patterns.summary: CPU affinity settings mismatch for the GPU NUMA node.
patterns.action: Review CPU manager policies in Kubelet.

patterns.re: Device plugin restarting due to config change
patterns.summary: Device plugin is stuck in a loop reloading configs.
patterns.action: Stabilize the time-slicing configuration map.

patterns.summary: Fabric Manager could not sync topology across nodes.
patterns.action: Check cluster network for Fabric Manager ports.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN NET\/Socket : failed to connect
patterns.summary: Unable to establish socket connection between nodes.
patterns.action: Verify firewall rules and inter-node routing.

patterns.summary: Mellanox SHARP plugin failed to initialize.
patterns.action: Ensure matching HPC-X and NCCL versions.

patterns.summary: Global variables mutated twice during init.
patterns.action: Remove duplicate init calls in custom scripts.

patterns.re: TP group ranks misaligned across physical nodes
patterns.summary: TP groups span across nodes unnecessarily.
patterns.action: Ensure node GPUs >= TP size to keep TP intra-node.

patterns.re: NCCL timeout caused by CPU bottleneck
patterns.summary: One rank stalled on data loading, causing others to time out.
patterns.action: Optimize data loader or increase num_workers.

patterns.re: Overlapping communication stream deadlock in RingExchange

patterns.summary: Ring attention P2P receive blocked on boundary node.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN Cannot use Direct P2P

patterns.summary: SHARP/CollNet initialization failed on fabric.

patterns.re: Thermal throttling on one GPU causing collective timeout

patterns.re: PyTorch infinite loop in data processing on one rank
patterns.summary: Regex or while-loop stuck in data transform on one rank.
patterns.action: Fix dataset preprocessing bug.

patterns.re: DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 parameter fetch colliding with TP all-reduce

patterns.action: Disable overlap_comm or adjust buffer sizes.

patterns.summary: Logging timer sync blocked indefinitely.

patterns.re: WandB \/ TensorBoard logging stall causing TP rank 0 to lag
patterns.summary: Rank 0 blocked on network IO for logging, crashing siblings.
