patterns.re: gradient norm spike[^\n]{0,70}without learning rate change|\d{2,}x gradient norm spike
patterns.summary: The gradient norm jumped by orders of magnitude with no change to the schedule. Most such spikes are a data or numerical problem, but a spike with no corresponding loss anomaly, on one rank only, is one of the few observable signatures of silent data corruption.
patterns.action:
NOW: check whether it is ONE rank or all of them. All ranks means data or optimizer; a single rank means that node, and it should be drained before it poisons the next checkpoint.
INVESTIGATE: correlate the step timestamp against that node's ECC counters (nvidia-smi -q -d ECC) and dmesg Xid events. A correctable-error ramp at the same moment is strong evidence of hardware. Re-run the exact batch on a different node, reproducing means data, not reproducing means the node.
PREVENT: log per-rank gradient norms, not just the global average, averaging is exactly what hides a single-rank anomaly. Gradient clipping bounds the damage but also masks the signal, so alert on the pre-clip norm.
ESCALATE: does not reproduce on other hardware and the node shows ECC activity → drain and run dcgmi diag -r 3; resume from a checkpoint predating the spike, because the intervening weights may be poisoned.

patterns.re: tensor core GEMM[^\n]{0,100}(calculation deviation|silent data corruption|bit flip)
patterns.summary: A GEMM result differs from a trusted recomputation without a CUDA exception. That is a silent data corruption signal, but the comparison must first rule out expected floating-point non-determinism and an input mismatch.
patterns.action:
NOW: quarantine the result and rerun the identical operands on a different GPU with a deterministic higher-precision reference path.
INVESTIGATE: hash the input tensors before both runs. A repeatable mismatch on the same operands implicates the kernel or numeric mode; a mismatch that follows one GPU implicates hardware.
PREVENT: sample critical GEMMs with redundant checks, retain per-rank operand hashes, and alert on unexplained result divergence before the next checkpoint is committed.
ESCALATE: if the deviation follows one device, drain it and run DCGM diagnostics. If it follows the kernel across devices, preserve the minimal reproducer for the framework or compiler owner.
patterns.resumeFrom: checkpoint predating the first verified corrupt result

patterns.re: Fair-share tree depth exceeded for queue .*
patterns.summary: Extremely complex nested queue structures cause the fair-share proportion plugin to fail traversal, skipping the queue entirely.
patterns.action: Flatten the queue hierarchy.

patterns.summary: CUDA OOM caused by aggressive forward_prefetch holding too many subsequent layer shards.
patterns.action: Disable forward_prefetch or reduce the prefetch queue depth.

patterns.summary: ZeRO-3 parameter partitions are not released during evaluation, causing an OOM.
patterns.action: Wrap evaluation blocks in DeepSpeed's zero.GatheredParameters(modifier_rank=None).

patterns.summary: Lustre IO throughput degraded due to stripe-unaligned Direct IO during checkpointing.
patterns.action: Align PyTorch tensor saves to Lustre stripe size (e.g., 1MB or 4MB blocks).

patterns.summary: Silent kernel abort triggered by out-of-bounds read during custom fused kernel execution leading to NCCL unhandled CUDA error (Case 2).
patterns.action: Check topology XML for suboptimal NIC-to-GPU affinity.

patterns.re: NVLink error .* bridge failure .* link 10 .* CRC
patterns.summary: Obscure NVSwitch bridging failure causing intermittent packet loss on inter-GPU transfers (Case 22).
patterns.action: Drain node, reset GPUs via nvidia-smi, and test IB bandwidth.

patterns.re: NCCL WARN IB polling timed out in Ring channel .* rank \d+
patterns.summary: Advanced NCCL topology timeout in multi-rail environment (Case 42). Suspected IB interface instability or CPU bottleneck during Ring/Tree synchronization.
patterns.action: RMA GPU due to unrecoverable NVLink CRC errors.

patterns.summary: Slurm GPU binding (--gpus-per-task) misconfigured leading to multiple processes trying to claim the same GPU.
patterns.action: Fix Slurm launch script to use --gpus-per-node and --ntasks-per-node correctly.

patterns.summary: FSDP backwards computation hang due to custom autograd function not calling distributed collective consistently across ranks.
patterns.action: Ensure all ranks execute identical collectives within custom autograd functions.

patterns.summary: Cilium eBPF map limits exceeded, preventing new connections or policy updates.
patterns.action: Increase eBPF map sizes in Cilium config (e.g., bpf-ct-global-any-max).

requiredEvidence.re: cilium.*bpf: Failed to update map: argument list too long|map full

patterns.summary: Ceph-CSI RBD image watcher limit reached on multi-node read-only access.
patterns.action: Increase rbd_max_watchers in Ceph configuration or use CephFS for ReadWriteMany.

patterns.summary: AWS SRD packet drop rate spike due to transient AWS internal network microbursts.
patterns.action: Increase NCCL retry counts and tune SRD congestion control parameters via FI_EFA_TX_MIN_CREDITS.

patterns.summary: MSCCL/MSCCL++ (Microsoft collective library) failure, custom algorithm XML/plan invalid for this topology or msccl runtime incompatibility with the NCCL base.
patterns.action:
NOW: disable custom algos (unset MSCCL_XML_FILES / fall back to stock NCCL) to unblock.
INVESTIGATE: validate the algo XML against world size/topology; check msccl version vs NCCL fork version.
PREVENT: gate algo files per cluster topology in config management.

patterns.summary: DeepSpeed-Ulysses sequence-parallel failure, attention heads not divisible by SP degree, or sequence length not divisible across the SP group, breaking the all-to-all.
patterns.action:
NOW: check num_attention_heads % sp_degree == 0 and seq_len % sp_degree == 0.
INVESTIGATE: config: ds sequence_parallel_size vs model heads; padded seq lengths reaching the a2a.
PREVENT: assert divisibility at job start.

patterns.re: UNAVAILABLE: (Invalid argument|Internal|Not found): .*model|failed to load '.*' version|Triton.*model repository.*(error|fail)|tritonserver.*(error|failed)
patterns.summary: Triton Inference Server model-load failure, config.pbtxt mismatch (dims/dtype/backend), missing backend library, or version-policy pointing at absent artifacts.
patterns.action:
NOW: tritonserver --log-verbose=1 names the exact field; validate config.pbtxt dims vs the actual saved model signature.
INVESTIGATE: backend (python/onnx/trt) installed in the image? model files under the expected numeric version dir?
PREVENT: CI: load every model repo change in a scratch tritonserver before deploy.

patterns.re: gcsfuse.*(input\/output error|transport endpoint is not connected|rate limit|429)|gcs.*fuse.*(stall|timeout)|ReadObject.*429|gcsfuse[^\n]{0,120}rename|atomic rename NOT supported
patterns.summary: GCS FUSE failure, mount died (transport endpoint not connected), or per-object read rate limits hit; reads return EIO mid-training.
patterns.action:
NOW: remount (fusermount -u && gcsfuse ...); for 429s reduce parallel readers of the SAME object.
INVESTIGATE: gcsfuse logs (--debug_gcs); object-level QPS (many readers, one shard?); consider --stat-cache-ttl tuning.
PREVENT: replicate hot shards; prefer parallel composite downloads to local NVMe over FUSE reads for training data.

patterns.summary: Podman rootless GPU access failure, device cgroup delegation or CDI spec missing for the rootless user; container starts but sees no GPU or fails at create.
patterns.action:
NOW: check CDI: nvidia-ctk cdi generate --output=/etc/cdi/nvidia.yaml, then podman run --device nvidia.com/gpu=all.
INVESTIGATE: /etc/nvidia-container-runtime/config.toml no-cgroups=true for rootless; user namespace mappings.
PREVENT: standardize on CDI (not legacy hook) for rootless.

patterns.summary: Training loss became NaN.
patterns.action: Enable gradient clipping, lower learning rate 5-10x, check for bad data batch.

patterns.summary: NCCL_BUFFSIZE too large for Socket transport, exceeds OS socket buffer limits causing stall.
patterns.action: Remove custom NCCL_BUFFSIZE and use default; or increase OS socket buffers (net.core.rmem_max, wmem_max).

patterns.summary: PyTorch Dynamo/torch.compile failed to compile the model graph, usually dynamic shapes or unsupported ops.
patterns.action: Disable compile for failing module: `@torch.compile(disable=True)`. Set `torch._dynamo.config.suppress_errors = True`. Use `TORCH_COMPILE_DEBUG=1` for verbose logs.

patterns.summary: FSDP multi-node hang with InfiniBand. SHARP plugin incompatibility on older NCCL versions.
patterns.action: Set `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` for TCP fallback, or upgrade NCCL beyond 2.18.x. Disable SHARP: `NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE=0`.

patterns.summary: PyTorch DataLoader worker process crashed (segfault or exception), usually a bug in the dataset or augmentation code.
patterns.action: Set `num_workers=0` to disable multiprocessing and get the full traceback. Check dataset __getitem__ for out-of-bounds access, file corruption, or custom transforms. For OpenCV/PIL issues, ensure worker processes are fork-safe.

patterns.summary: DataLoader worker aborted (SIGABRT), worker process hit an assertion failure or unhandled exception propagated from Python/C++ boundary.
patterns.action: Set `num_workers=0` to disable multiprocessing. Look for assertion failures in __getitem__, dataset file reads, or transform pipelines. For custom C++ ops, run `compute-sanitizer` to detect memory errors. Add `torch.multiprocessing.set_sharing_strategy("file_system")` as workaround.

patterns.summary: MosaicML Streaming sequence length exceeded, a sample is longer than the configured max_seq_len, usually from tokenization mismatch or corrupt data.
patterns.action: Increase `max_seq_len` in the streaming dataset config. Add truncation: `StreamingDataset(..., max_seq_len=<value>, truncate=True)`. Check dataset for unusually long sequences: `python -c "from streaming import StreamingDataset; ds = StreamingDataset(...); max_len = max(len(ds[i]['input_ids']) for i in range(len(ds)))"`. Filter out corrupt samples.

patterns.summary: Apache Arrow memory-mapped file corruption, mmap file was partially written or corrupted, causing segfault or read failure in Arrow IPC.
patterns.action: Delete the corrupt mmap cache: `rm -rf <cache_dir>/arrow/`. Re-download or regenerate the Arrow IPC files. Disable mmap: `pyarrow.ipc.open_file(source, memory_map=False)`. Validate Arrow file: `python -c "import pyarrow as pa; pa.ipc.open_file('data.arrow', memory_map=False)"`. Increase storage filesystem health checks.

patterns.summary: NCCL internal assertion or unexpected failure, often triggered by hardware instability or driver bugs affecting NCCL internal state.
patterns.action: Run with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO,NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=ALL for detailed trace. Check dmesg for GPU Xid errors. Update NCCL/PyTorch and CUDA driver. If persistent, set NCCL_PROTO=SIMPLE as fallback transport.

patterns.summary: Gloo hash store operation failed, in-memory hash-based rendezvous encountered a race condition or mismatch.
patterns.action: Switch to TCPStore or FileStore instead of HashStore. Ensure all ranks call init_process_group with identical backend and init_method.

patterns.re: VPC flow logs sampling.*dropping high throughput TCP
patterns.summary: Aggressive VPC flow logs sampling impacting TCP network performance.
patterns.action: Reduce VPC flow log sampling rate or disable for GPU subnet.

patterns.summary: Megatron-LM p2p_communication buffers fragmentation. (Stage/Variant 101)
patterns.action: Set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 or tune PyTorch allocator max_split_size_mb. Applied at step 101.

patterns.summary: GFD sleep cycle was prematurely terminated.
patterns.action: Usually ignorable, occurs during pod shutdown.

patterns.re: Local rank mapping to TP rank incorrect
patterns.summary: GPU device ID mapping desynced from PyTorch local_rank.
patterns.action: Ensure CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES matches local_rank.

patterns.re: Custom Megatron backward pass hook dropped collective
patterns.summary: Autograd hook bypassed a required backward TP all-reduce.
patterns.action: Ensure backward hooks execute unconditionally.

patterns.summary: NUMA topology discovery failed.
patterns.action: Check hwloc installation or NUMA node bindings.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Error\(s\) in loading state_dict for
patterns.summary: The checkpoint key set and the instantiated model do not match. This can be an intentional partial transfer, but it must be verified against the exact checkpoint and current model configurations.
patterns.action: Compare missing and unexpected keys against the checkpoint's saved model config and instantiate the matching architecture first. Use `strict=False` only when every omitted/new key is an intentional, reviewed transfer-learning change; it does not solve tensor shape mismatches.

patterns.summary: NCCL timeout during FSDP initialization because rank 0 took too long to broadcast weights.
patterns.action: Increase NCCL timeout or initialize weights on CPU before broadcasting.

patterns.summary: WekaFS SSD tier IOPS limit exceeded, causing checkpoint latency spikes and NCCL timeouts.
patterns.action: Increase WekaFS SSD quota or stagger checkpoint IO across ranks.

patterns.summary: XLA compiler crashed with a segfault inside LLVM backend, often an XLA bug with specific ops.
patterns.action: Try updating jaxlib/XLA, disable specific optimization passes, or report the stack trace to the JAX repository.

patterns.summary: Silent kernel abort triggered by out-of-bounds read during custom fused kernel execution leading to NCCL unhandled CUDA error (Case 20).
patterns.action: RMA GPU due to unrecoverable NVLink CRC errors.

patterns.re: NVLink error .* bridge failure .* link 4 .* CRC
patterns.summary: Obscure NVSwitch bridging failure causing intermittent packet loss on inter-GPU transfers (Case 40).
patterns.action: Reboot node to reset NVSwitch state and re-initialize NCCL communicators.

patterns.summary: NCCL crash due to overlapping IB paths with conflicting routing (e.g., adaptive routing misconfiguration).
patterns.action: Disable adaptive routing or adjust NCCL_IB_QPS_PER_CONNECTION.

patterns.summary: PyTorch FSDP hang during backward pass due to one rank skipping a layer activation via dynamic control flow.
patterns.action: Use torch.distributed.algorithms.join context manager for uneven inputs.

patterns.summary: Slurm preempted the job but NCCL didn't receive SIGTERM, causing a zombie process on one node.
patterns.action: Configure Slurm to send SIGTERM before SIGKILL on preemption.

patterns.summary: NCCL IB_GDR_LEVEL misconfiguration causing silent data corruption during AllReduce.
patterns.action: Set NCCL_IB_GDR_LEVEL=0 to disable GPU Direct RDMA if hardware compatibility is suspect.

patterns.summary: NCCL crash during graph instantiation (cudaGraphLaunch) combined with FSDP dynamic operations.
patterns.action: Disable CUDA graphs for FSDP or ensure static shapes for all inputs.

patterns.re: NCCL INFO Ring .* cross NUMA .* bandwidth degraded
patterns.summary: GPU and corresponding NIC are on different NUMA nodes, causing traffic to traverse the CPU UPI link and throttling bandwidth.
patterns.action: Set NCCL_TOPO_FILE to explicitly map GPU-NIC affinity, or reconfigure PCI slots physically.

patterns.re: NCCL INFO .* multi-rail .* unbalanced traffic distribution
patterns.summary: ECMP hashing in the switch fabric is mapping multiple NCCL RoCE flows to the same uplink, starving available bandwidth.
patterns.action: Enable NCCL_IB_SPLIT_DATA_ON_QPS to generate more flow entropy, or configure switch to use deeper packet inspection for hashing.

patterns.re: NCCL INFO .* fallback to RING due to incomplete IB topology
patterns.summary: NCCL failed to build optimal Tree structures because it could not query the IB topology (e.g., missing ibnetdiscover/libibmad permissions).
patterns.action: Run container with --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN or configure NCCL_TOPO_FILE manually.

requiredEvidence.re: NCCL INFO.*Trees are not supported.*falling back to Ring

patterns.re: NCCL INFO .* Storage Direct .* falling back to CPU DMA
patterns.summary: GPU Direct Storage (GDS) is routing NVMe DMA traffic over the CPU root complex instead of the PCIe switch, cutting bandwidth in half.
patterns.action: Reconfigure PCIe slots so the NVMe drive and the GPU share the same PCIe switch hierarchy.

patterns.re: NCCL INFO .* AllReduce latency is high
patterns.summary: PCIe Active State Power Management (ASPM) is aggressively putting links into L1 sleep state, causing massive wakeup latencies for NCCL.
patterns.action: Disable ASPM in BIOS or append pcie_aspm=off to the kernel boot parameters.

patterns.summary: Node SNAT port exhaustion during massive outgoing connections for dataset download.
patterns.action: Increase ip_local_port_range or use HostNetwork for dataset download jobs.

patterns.summary: NFS CSI volume lock not released after pod crash, preventing new pod from acquiring lock.
patterns.action: Clear lock on NFS server or mount NFS with nolock option (if safe).

patterns.summary: AWS SRD multi-path routing loop triggered fatal EFA queue pair reset under specific network topologies.
patterns.action: Update EFA driver to latest version which handles transient routing loops natively.

patterns.summary: GPU task stopped at user request, often caused by the OS OOM killer or cluster scheduler forcefully terminating the process.
patterns.action: Check host dmesg for OOM killer logs or Slurm node logs for preemption/cancellation events.

negativeEvidence.re: replay(?:ing|ed)? archived|archived dmesg|postmortem|historical log|end of archive

patterns.summary: BF16 matrix multiplication resulted in accumulator overflow despite BF16's wide range, likely a poorly scaled gradient.
patterns.action: Check gradient clipping and learning rate. Inspect activation scales.

patterns.summary: Hardware detected and mitigated a Row Hammer-like access pattern on HBM3, causing performance jitter.
patterns.action: Analyze memory access patterns in custom kernels. Usually a soft issue, but affects performance.

patterns.summary: Significant power phase imbalance on the rack PDU, which can trigger circuit breakers under heavy GPU load.
patterns.action: Rebalance server power supplies across PDU phases. Cap node power temporarily.

patterns.summary: GPU stalling clock cycles to stay under power limit despite max freq reporting.
patterns.action: Lower power limit slightly to force clean frequency downclocking instead of hidden clock stretching.

patterns.summary: BF16 mathematical truncation/divide-by-zero (e.g. RoPE or LayerNorm) causing NaN propagation.
patterns.action: BF16 has the same range as FP32, so overflow is rare. This is truncation. Ensure RoPE frequencies, LayerNorm, and Softmax are explicitly cast to torch.float32 before computation.

patterns.summary: NVLink Correctable/Recovery Errors - The link is experiencing high noise, causing CRC failures and replays.
patterns.action: Run `nvidia-smi nvlink -e` to check error counters. Reset counters with `nvidia-smi nvlink -c`. If errors rapidly accumulate during training, the link is degraded and requires hardware service.

patterns.summary: Persistence Mode Disabled - GPU persistence mode is not active, causing initialization latency and driver reload issues.
patterns.action: Enable persistence mode: `nvidia-smi -pm 1`. It is required for stable distributed training.

patterns.summary: Hung Rank - A training rank is deadlocked or entirely unresponsive.
patterns.action: Run `py-spy dump --pid <pid>` on the stuck rank to get a stack trace of the deadlock. Often caused by mismatched collective calls (e.g., one rank hits an `if` block the others don't).

patterns.summary: Checkpoint File Corruption - The PyTorch checkpoint file is truncated or corrupted, likely due to a previous crash during `torch.save()`.
patterns.action: Delete the corrupted checkpoint folder. Resume training from the previous healthy checkpoint epoch.

patterns.re: Out of memory: Killed process|oom-kill:constraint|Memory cgroup out of memory
patterns.summary: Host OOM Killer - The Linux Out-Of-Memory killer terminated the training process.
patterns.action: Increase node RAM, reduce `num_workers` in DataLoader, or set `pin_memory=False`. This is a host RAM exhaustion, NOT a GPU VRAM exhaustion.

patterns.summary: kmsg GPU Error - Unclassified GPU error found in kernel ring buffer.
patterns.action: Investigate `dmesg` for Xid codes surrounding this timestamp. Run `dcgmi diag -r 2` to verify GPU health.

patterns.summary: NCCL P2P Level and Topology Routing Limits
patterns.action: Set NCCL_P2P_LEVEL correctly to match the hardware topology (e.g., PIX, PXB), and ensure PCIe ACS is disabled in BIOS if true P2P is expected.

patterns.re: (?:next\(iterator\) taking longer than \d+ seconds|DataLoader worker \(pid\(s\) \d+\) exited unexpectedly|getting batch took \d+ seconds)
patterns.summary: Data Pipeline / DataLoader Stalls
patterns.action: Investigate underlying storage (NFS/S3/Lustre) latency or IOPS limits. Increase num_workers, or implement localized caching.

patterns.re: invalid load key|eoferror|unpicklingerror|checkpoint commit info mismatch|corrupt.*checkpoint|tarfile\.readerror|zipfile\.badzipfile|runtimeerror:.*(?:invalid load key|corrupt)
patterns.summary: Checkpoint Corruption - Failed to load a checkpoint due to file corruption or truncation.
patterns.action: Delete the corrupted checkpoint file (or directory) and resume from the *previous* known-good checkpoint. To prevent this, implement atomic checkpoint saves (save to a temporary file, then `os.rename` or `mv`) so interruptions never leave a partially-written checkpoint on disk.

patterns.re: AttributeError: .* has no attribute '(sp_model|use_cache_quantization|past_key_values_length)'|ImportError: cannot import name '\w+' from 'transformers'(?!.*circular)|FutureWarning: .*transformers.*removed in v\d
patterns.summary: Transformers API removal/deprecation break, code written for an older transformers version hits a renamed/removed symbol after an (often unintended) upgrade.
patterns.action:
NOW: pip show transformers vs your lockfile, was it upgraded by a transitive dependency?
INVESTIGATE: the release notes for the named symbol; most removals have a one-line replacement.
PREVENT: pin transformers exactly; forbid unpinned installs in images; run deprecation-warning CI (PYTHONWARNINGS=error::FutureWarning on a smoke batch).

patterns.summary: HF datasets cache/fingerprint inconsistency, cached arrow shards no longer match the dataset script/config (changed preprocessing, partial cache write, or shared cache across versions).
patterns.action:
NOW: retry with download_mode="force_redownload" or delete the specific cache entry (~/.cache/huggingface/datasets/<name>).
INVESTIGATE: shared HF_DATASETS_CACHE across users/versions? map() functions with changed closures but same fingerprint inputs?
PREVENT: per-run HF_DATASETS_CACHE, or new_fingerprint= explicit on map().

patterns.summary: nvidia-smi shows ERR!/Unknown Error fields, the driver can enumerate the GPU but a subsystem query fails: early sign of a wedged GPU, GSP fault, or driver/library skew.
patterns.action:
NOW: capture full nvidia-smi -q for the failing GPU before reset (evidence!).
INVESTIGATE: dmesg for Xid 119/120 (GSP) around the first ERR!; persistence mode state; recent driver change.
PREVENT: fleet alert on ERR! substrings in periodic smi scrapes.
ESCALATE: recurring after reboot → RMA with the -q capture.

patterns.summary: NCCL implicit launch order deadlock.
patterns.action: For NCCL 2.26+, set NCCL_LAUNCH_ORDER_IMPLICIT=1 to enforce GPU communication ordering matches CPU scheduling order, preventing deadlocks on conditional graphs.

patterns.summary: Process OOM-killed on host RAM (SIGKILL -9), often ZeRO CPU/NVMe offload.
patterns.action: Set pin_memory:false in the offload config, reduce stage3_max_live_parameters, disable CPU offload, or add nodes.

patterns.summary: WebDataset shard download HTTP 416. Range Not Satisfiable error when resuming partial shard download, indicates server or CDN does not support byte-range requests.
patterns.action: Check storage backend supports Range headers (S3/R2/GCS do, some CDNs do not). Re-download the full shard: `rm -f corrupted_shard.tar && wget <url>`. For iterable datasets, set `WebDataset(..., shardshuffle=False)` to avoid partial transfers.

patterns.summary: Rust tokenizers library panicked or segfaulted, memory corruption in the Rust/Python FFI boundary, often from unusual Unicode or oversized input.
patterns.action: Pin tokenizers version: `pip install tokenizers==0.15.2`. Set `TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false` to disable Rayon parallelism which triggers the FFI bug. Run on CPU only for tokenization to isolate. Wrap tokenizer call in try/except and log problematic text: `tokens = tokenizer(text, truncation=True, max_length=2048)`.

patterns.summary: HDF5 heap corruption or slab allocation failure, internal HDF5 memory allocator corrupted from incomplete writes or file version mismatch.
patterns.action: Regenerate the HDF5 file from source. Use `h5repair` to attempt recovery. Set environment: `HDF5_USE_FILE_LOCKING=FALSE`. Check HDF5 library version: `python -c "import h5py; print(h5py.version.hdf5_version)"`. Upgrade h5py: `pip install h5py>=3.8.0`. For large datasets, use chunked storage: `h5py.File(..., libver='latest')`.

patterns.summary: Parquet row group read error, corrupt row group metadata or compressed page within a parquet file.
patterns.action: Verify parquet file: `python -c "import pandas as pd; pd.read_parquet('data.parquet', engine='pyarrow')"`. Try alternative engine: `engine='fastparquet'`. Repair: re-serialize the DataFrame. For streaming, set `use_legacy_dataset=False` in pyarrow. Validate with `pyarrow.parquet.ParquetFile('data.parquet').metadata`.

patterns.summary: NCCL allreduce produced different results across ranks, silent data corruption (SDC) in the collective.
patterns.action: This is critical: weights desynchronized. Set NCCL_ALGO=RING (disables tree/LL which are more susceptible). Check NVLink SHARP: NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0. Run compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck. Verify GPU ECC: nvidia-smi -q -d ECC.

patterns.summary: Lustre llite page lock contention during checkpoint save.
patterns.action: lctl set_param llite.*.max_cached_mb=2048; clear page cache: echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches; reduce concurrency: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.

patterns.summary: Lustre file stripe count mismatch on open.
patterns.action: lfs getstripe <file>; lfs migrate -c <correct_count> <file>; lfs setstripe -c <count> <dir>.

patterns.summary: NFS readdir/getattr RPC timeout, large directory or network issue.
patterns.action: ls -f <dir> | wc -l; increase timeo: mount -o remount,timeo=1000 <mount>; use noatime: mount -o remount,noatime <mount>.

patterns.summary: S3 connection reset by peer during large file download.
patterns.action: curl -C - -o <file> <s3_url>; use range request: aws s3api get-object --range "bytes=0-<size>"; increase tcp keepalive: sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=60.

patterns.summary: flock/fcntl locking deadlock across ranks.
patterns.action: lslocks | grep <pid>; fuser <file>; strace -e flock,fcntl -p <pid>; use non-blocking: LOCK_NB with EAGAIN handling; consider per-rank lock files: <file>.lock.<rank>.

patterns.summary: Concurrent write to same file, non-atomic save race condition.
patterns.action: Implement atomic write: write to .tmp then rename(); use rank-based: <file>.rank<N>.pt; barrier before save: torch.distributed.barrier(); use file lock: import fcntl; fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX).

patterns.summary: Heterogeneous job step size mismatch between job components.
patterns.action: Ensure all hetjob components specify same --ntasks or --cpus-per-task; align #SBATCH directives.

patterns.summary: Step creation timed out, too many concurrent steps or overloaded controller.
patterns.action: Reduce srun parallel launches; increase SchedulerParameters=max_step_create_time; check slurmctld load.

patterns.summary: GPU resource contention. GPUs over-committed or device plugin misreported.
patterns.action: Check nvidia-smi on node; restart nvidia-device-plugin daemonset; cordon and drain node if needed.

patterns.summary: Pod requires privileged mode for GPU access but is not configured.
patterns.action: Add securityContext.privileged: true to pod spec; or set securityContext.capabilities.add: ["SYS_ADMIN"].

patterns.summary: CNI plugin not configured for RDMA. SR-IOV or InfiniBand not ready.
patterns.action: Check sriov-network-operator pods; verify ibdev or netdev availability; kubectl get nodenetworkstate.

patterns.summary: NVIDIA MPS control daemon error. MPS server not running or crashed.
patterns.action: export CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY=/tmp/nvidia-mps; nvidia-cuda-mps-control -d; check /var/log/mps.log.

patterns.summary: Ray task argument serialization error, object too large or unpickleable.
patterns.action: Call ray.put on large objects before passing to tasks; use cloudpickle for custom serialization; reduce task args.

patterns.summary: PyTorch 2.0 dynamic loading issue disabling Fastrak.
patterns.action: Preload the Fastrak plugin via LD_PRELOAD.

patterns.summary: Last PP stage OOM during pipeline flush gradient accumulation. (Stage/Variant 20)
patterns.action: Use fp8/bf16 optimizer or reduce gradient accumulation steps. Applied at step 20.

patterns.summary: Transformer layer activation recomputation vs PP bubble size mismatch. (Stage/Variant 40)
patterns.action: Use selective activation recomputation. Applied at step 40.

patterns.summary: PyTorch caching allocator fragmentation during PP alternating forward/backward. (Stage/Variant 60)
patterns.action: Set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128. Applied at step 60.

patterns.summary: Megatron-LM p2p_communication buffers fragmentation. (Stage/Variant 80)
patterns.action: Set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 or tune PyTorch allocator max_split_size_mb. Applied at step 80.

patterns.summary: Interleaved 1F1B increases activation memory footprint. (Stage/Variant 100)
patterns.action: Decrease virtual pipeline parallel size. Applied at step 100.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: parameters are out of sync across ranks
patterns.summary: ZeRO-3 parameter broadcast mismatch due to desynced RNG states.
patterns.action: Ensure random seeds are identically set across all ranks before model initialization.

patterns.re: error while loading shared libraries: libibverbs\.so\.2: cannot open shared object file
patterns.summary: HPC cluster node is missing libibverbs.so.2, preventing RDMA/InfiniBand driver initialization.
patterns.action: Install rdma-core or libibverbs-dev package on the affected node. Check LD_LIBRARY_PATH if it's installed in a non-standard prefix.

patterns.summary: Lustre CSI client evicted by MDS due to timeout, invalidating mounted volumes.
patterns.action: Tune Lustre client timeouts or investigate MDS load/network latency.

patterns.summary: Arrow dictionary batch read failure, dictionary batch encoding is corrupt or the IPC stream contains an invalid dictionary delta.
patterns.action: Re-serialize the Arrow file without dictionary encoding: `pa.ipc.new_file(sink, schema, options=pa.ipc.IpcWriteOptions(compression=None))`. Validate with: `python -c "import pyarrow as pa; t = pa.ipc.open_file('data.arrow').read_all(); print(t.num_rows)"`. Avoid dictionary encoding for high-cardinality columns.

patterns.summary: DeepSpeed ParamCoordinator deadlock due to irregular forward pass access patterns.
patterns.action: Disable parameter prefetching in ZeRO-3 or ensure symmetric forward pass control flow across ranks.

patterns.summary: File close() or fsync() hanging in uninterruptible sleep during DFS flush.
patterns.action: Reboot affected node and tune DFS flush background threads.

patterns.summary: Strict ARP sysctls blocking valid pod-to-pod routing via CNI bridge.
patterns.action: Set net.ipv4.conf.all.arp_ignore=0 and arp_announce=0 if not using IPVS.

patterns.summary: Containerd FD leak on exec probes causing health checks and new execs to fail.
patterns.action: Restart containerd service and upgrade to patched version.

patterns.summary: torchrun ChildFailedError, a worker process died and torchelastic is reporting the WRAPPER error. The real failure is in the per-rank traceback above/below this block (exitcode -9 = OOM kill, 1 = python exception, -11 = segfault).
patterns.action:
NOW: find the FIRST failing rank's own traceback (torchrun prints root-cause section with rank/exitcode/time).
INVESTIGATE: exitcode -9 → host OOM (dmesg oom-kill) not GPU; -11 → segfault (core dump); 1 → scroll for the python exception.
PREVENT: --redirects 3 --tee 3 on torchrun so per-rank logs are separated.
ESCALATE: per the underlying error, never file bugs on ChildFailedError itself.

patterns.re: dcgm-exporter.*(error|failed|cannot connect)|Failed to (start|watch) DCGM|nv-hostengine.*(error|failed to start)
patterns.summary: DCGM exporter/hostengine failure. GPU metrics pipeline down (blind fleet), often after driver upgrades or duplicate hostengine instances. Training itself unaffected.
patterns.action:
NOW: restart nv-hostengine + exporter; check only ONE hostengine instance owns the GPUs.
INVESTIGATE: driver/DCGM version compat; socket permissions (/var/run/nvidia-dcgm).
PREVENT: alert on metric absence, not just metric values.

patterns.summary: Generic CUDA unknown error (999), usually a GPU in a bad state or a version mismatch.
patterns.action: Run with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO; scan dmesg for Xid on the failing rank; align NCCL/torch/CUDA versions; reset the GPU/node.

patterns.summary: DataLoader pin_memory thread crashed, pinned memory transfer from CPU to GPU failed, often from host memory pressure or CUDA driver issue.
patterns.action: Reduce `num_workers` or set `pin_memory=False` in DataLoader. Check host RAM: `free -h`. Reduce host memory load from other processes. Update CUDA driver. For persistent issues, add `prefetch_factor=2` to DataLoader.

patterns.summary: MosaicML Streaming dataset download failed. HTTP 500+ error from cloud storage, usually transient or permission-related.
patterns.action: Retry the run, cloud storage might recover. Verify bucket permissions: `aws s3 ls s3://your-bucket/streaming/ --no-sign-request`. Run `python -c "from streaming import StreamingDataset; ds = StreamingDataset(local=..., remote=..., validate_hash=False)"` to isolate the failing shard. Add `StreamingDataset(..., download_retry=3, download_timeout=300)`.

patterns.summary: NumPy memmap read error or .npy file write failed, memory-mapped array file is corrupt or was incompletely written.
patterns.action: Regenerate .npy files from source data. Verify integrity: `python -c "import numpy as np; arr = np.load('data.npy', mmap_mode=None); print(arr.shape)"`. Set `np.save(..., allow_pickle=False)` for safety. For large arrays, use `np.savez` instead. Check disk space: `df -h`. Validate checksums against original.

patterns.summary: Missing or unexpected keys warning from load_state_dict with strict=False, non-critical but indicates architectural drift between checkpoint and current model (files 30-31).
patterns.action: Review warnings: log all missing/unexpected keys. If benign (e.g., new LoRA adapters, removed classification head), suppress with `strict=False`. Add `model.load_state_dict(ckpt, strict=False)` with explicit `missing_keys, unexpected_keys = ...` handling. For expected mismatches, create a filtered checkpoint dict: `{k: v for k, v in ckpt.items() if k in model_sd}`.

patterns.summary: Systemd TasksMax limit reached for containerd service, preventing new containers.
patterns.action: Set TasksMax=infinity in containerd.service systemd unit file.

patterns.summary: HDF5 file lock timeout, parallel HDF5 file access lock acquisition timed out, usually from concurrent conflicting access on NFS/Lustre.
patterns.action: Set `HDF5_USE_FILE_LOCKING=FALSE` in environment. Set `HDF5_FILE_LOCKING=FALSE` before opening files. For NFS, set `H5Pset_fapl_sec2(fapl)` to bypass locking. Use `mode='r'` (read-only) when not writing. Organize data: one HDF5 file per worker group to reduce contention.

patterns.re: error while loading shared libraries: libibverbs\.so\.14: cannot open shared object file
patterns.summary: HPC cluster node is missing libibverbs.so.14, preventing RDMA/InfiniBand driver initialization.
patterns.action: Install rdma-core or libibverbs-dev package on the affected node. Check LD_LIBRARY_PATH if it's installed in a non-standard prefix.

patterns.summary: Calico BGP peer connection flapping, causing intermittent pod network unreachability.
patterns.action: Check BGP Route Reflector limits and node network connectivity.

patterns.re: persistent_workers.*(deadlock|hang|stale|timeout)|DataLoader.*persistent.*worker.*(died|timeout)|AssertionError: can only join a started process
patterns.summary: persistent_workers=True worker lifecycle failure, long-lived workers hold stale dataset/FS state across epochs (deleted files, rotated shards, forked CUDA ctx) and hang or die on reuse.
patterns.action:
NOW: persistent_workers=False to unblock (small epoch-start cost).
INVESTIGATE: did the dataset directory change mid-run? worker holding FDs to rotated/deleted files (ls -l /proc/<worker>/fd | grep deleted).
PREVENT: version dataset dirs immutably per run; spawn start method.

patterns.summary: Cross-device link error (EXDEV), os.rename across different filesystems fails, typically from checkpoint save to NFS/Lustre using atomic rename pattern.
patterns.action: Replace `os.rename(tmp, dest)` with `shutil.move(tmp, dest)` which handles cross-device moves: `import shutil; shutil.move(tmp_path, final_path)`. Use copy + delete pattern: `shutil.copy2(tmp, dest); os.remove(tmp)`. Configure all checkpoint paths on the same filesystem. For NFS, set checkpoint dir directly on the NFS mount without atomic tmp rename.

patterns.re: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout: ncclTimeout
patterns.summary: NCCL timeout deadlock caused by limit_all_gathers stream synchronization issues.
patterns.action: Disable limit_all_gathers or upgrade PyTorch to a version where the sync bug is fixed.

patterns.summary: POSIX page cache thrashing during massive checkpoint writes causing memory exhaustion and hangs.
patterns.action: Use O_DIRECT for checkpointing or tune vm.dirty_ratio and vm.dirty_background_ratio.

patterns.summary: Host kernel OOM killer terminated the Pax process, frequently caused by heavy data loaders or tf.data prefetching.
patterns.action: Reduce dataset prefetch size, lower tf.data num_parallel_calls, or increase host memory swap.

patterns.re: UCX  ERROR  Transport retry count exceeded.*ep=4
patterns.summary: UCX transport error caused by connection reset. RoCE/InfiniBand link dropped packets leading to retry exhaustion on ep=4.
patterns.action: Check InfiniBand fabric for flapped links. Set UCX_MAX_RETRY_COUNT=100 or adjust switch QoS settings.

patterns.summary: Slurm prologue script lingering and holding the IB device lock.
patterns.action: Fix Slurm prologue script to exit cleanly and release resources.

patterns.summary: PyTorch FSDP hitting CUDA limit of streams due to aggressive collective overlap and deep network layers.
patterns.action: Disable overlap_comm or limit the number of FSDP unit wraps.

patterns.re: NCCL INFO .* Topology detection found .* GPU .* NIC .* reverse mapping
patterns.summary: Logical ordering of GPUs does not match logical ordering of NICs, causing sub-optimal PCI switch traversal.
patterns.action: Set CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID to align GPU IDs with PCIe topology enumeration.

patterns.re: NCCL INFO .* mapping GPU [0-9] to NIC [0-9] .* sub-optimal
patterns.summary: Logical GPU ordering does not match logical NIC ordering, breaking NCCL's default affinity heuristics.
patterns.action: Use NCCL_TOPO_FILE to explicitly pair the correct GPU to the correct NIC.

requiredEvidence.re: NCCL WARN.*Tree pattern cannot be used

patterns.summary: Orphaned containerd-shim processes holding GPU handles, blocking device injection.
patterns.action: Kill defunct containerd-shim processes and restart containerd daemon.

patterns.summary: Cilium bandwidth manager aggressively throttling RDMA/RoCE traffic.
patterns.action: Bypass bandwidth manager for GPU traffic or increase bandwidth annotations.

patterns.summary: NCCL Hang (Generic) - Collective communication timed out waiting for ranks, with no obvious compute fault.
patterns.action: Run with `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=ALL`. Check for missing collective calls on specific nodes (indicates compute hang) vs matching calls (indicates network hang).

patterns.summary: Hardware Slowdown - GPU is derating clock speeds, reason undetermined from current logs.
patterns.action: Run `nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE` to identify whether the throttle is thermal or power related.

patterns.summary: Byte fallback encoding error in tokenizer, tokenizer failed to encode/decode a byte-level token, usually from malformed UTF-8 input or tokenizer vocabulary mismatch.
patterns.action: Set `tokenizer(text, add_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=True)` to handle whitespace edge cases. Check for non-UTF-8 input: `text.encode("utf-8", errors="replace")`. Validate tokenizer config has `byte_fallback=True` or update `tokenizer.json`. Switch to `use_fast=False` for more verbose errors.

patterns.summary: torchvision video/audio transforms segfaulted. C++ decoder library crash in torchvision IO operations, typically from corrupted media or GPU decoder buffer overflow.
patterns.action: Update torchvision: `pip install torchvision>=0.16.0`. Set `TORCHVISION_USE_VIDEO_CODEC=0` to disable hardware decoding. Fall back to OpenCV: use `cv2.VideoCapture` instead of `torchvision.io.read_video`. Run with `num_workers=0` to get the full traceback. Validate media: `ffprobe <video.mp4>`.

patterns.summary: Network namespaces leaking on pod deletion, hitting fs.max_net_namespaces limit.
patterns.action: Manually clean up leaked netns in /var/run/netns and upgrade CNI plugin.

patterns.summary: Concurrent read/write to same file across multiple processes, no file locking causes data corruption or partial reads in multi-worker training.
patterns.action: Configure each worker to write to separate files: `worker_id = torch.utils.data.get_worker_info().id; file = f"data_{worker_id}.ext"`. Use tempfile + atomic rename for writes. For shared datasets in streaming mode, use read-only access. Set `filelock` timeout: `from filelock import FileLock; lock = FileLock("data.lock", timeout=60)`. Use per-rank file naming: `f"checkpoint_rank{rank}.pt"`.

patterns.summary: Macvlan CNI intercepting InfiniBand RDMA traffic incorrectly, causing unreachable events.
patterns.action: Exclude InfiniBand interfaces from Macvlan CNI configuration.

patterns.summary: Augmentation random seed desync across DataLoader workers, non-deterministic augmentation output from unseeded RNG in multi-worker mode.
patterns.action: Set seeds per worker: `def worker_init_fn(wid): np.random.seed(wid + 42); random.seed(wid + 42); torch.manual_seed(wid + 42)`. Pass `worker_init_fn=worker_init_fn` to DataLoader. For Albumentations: `A.Compose([...], additional_targets=..., is_check_args=False, p=1.0)` with explicit seed. Use `torch.utils.data.default_collate` for reproducibility.

patterns.summary: OpenMPI encountered a segmentation fault in shared memory (vader BTL) on node18.
patterns.action: Disable vader BTL or increase shared memory size (e.g. --mca btl ^vader or --mca btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism none)

patterns.re: UCX  ERROR  Transport retry count exceeded.*ep=19
patterns.summary: UCX transport error caused by connection reset. RoCE/InfiniBand link dropped packets leading to retry exhaustion on ep=19.
patterns.action: Check InfiniBand fabric for flapped links. Set UCX_MAX_RETRY_COUNT=100 or adjust switch QoS settings.

patterns.summary: Weka CSI driver falling back from RDMA to TCP under load, causing latency spikes.
patterns.action: Investigate InfiniBand fabric congestion or Weka RDMA configuration.

patterns.re: cuda kernel launch fail|unspecified launch failure|illegal memory access|misaligned address|illegal instruction|\bcuda error\b
patterns.summary:
The failure originated from an asynchronous CUDA kernel crash.
NCCL watchdog timeout is a downstream symptom because the failed CUDA
context prevented rank 347 from completing the collective operation.

Evidence:

PRIMARY:
- CUDA error: unspecified launch failure
- Previous kernel execution failed asynchronously

SECONDARY:
- NCCL ALLREDUCE timeout
- ProcessGroupNCCL watchdog triggered

Missing evidence:
- No NVIDIA Xid code found
- No ECC errors found
- No PCIe/NVLink errors found

Conclusion:
Cannot classify as hardware failure yet.
Need GPU telemetry before replacing hardware.
patterns.action:
Collect:

dmesg -T | grep -iE "xid|nvrm|pcie|aer|nvlink"

nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,PAGE_RETIREMENT,ROW_REMAPPER

dcgmi diag -r 3

If it finds:
NVRM: Xid 48, ECC double bit error
then Diagnosis: GPU_HARDWARE_FAILURE (98% confidence)

If it finds nothing:
then Diagnosis: CUDA_KERNEL_FAILURE (75% confidence)

Likely causes:
1. FlashAttention kernel bug
2. Triton generated invalid kernel
3. illegal memory access
4. driver regression

negativeEvidence.re: GPU has fallen off the bus

patterns.summary:
This is a NCCL bandwidth measurement. busbw is the number to read.

algbw is the rate your algorithm saw. busbw normalises for how much data the collective
actually has to move across the bus for a given rank count, so it is the figure that can
be compared against the fabric's capability and across different collectives and scales.

Rough expectations, so the number means something. On 8 GPU NVLink within one node, an
all-reduce should reach a large fraction of the NVLink bandwidth. Across nodes on
400 Gb/s InfiniBand with GPUDirect RDMA working, tens of GB/s is normal. Single-digit
GB/s between nodes almost always means one of three things, in this order of frequency:
NCCL fell back to TCP sockets, GPUDirect RDMA is not loaded so traffic is bouncing
through host memory, or the lossless fabric configuration (PFC and ECN) is wrong and the
link is spending its time in congestion control.

What this does not establish. Denpex cannot tell from a pasted table alone what your
fabric is capable of, so it will not claim your number is bad. Compare it against the
same test on a known-good node set. If you have not run one, that comparison is the next
step and it is cheap.
patterns.action:
Turn the number into a cause.

1. Establish what "good" is for this hardware. Run the same test on a single node first:
   all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 8G -f 2 -g 8
   Intra-node uses NVLink. If THAT number is also low, the problem is not the network.

2. If intra-node is healthy and multi-node is not, prove which transport is in use:
   NCCL_DEBUG=INFO NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=INIT,NET <launch> 2>&1 | grep -E "NET/(IB|Socket)"
   NET/Socket means TCP fallback and is the single most common cause. Denpex has a
   dedicated entry for it.

3. If NET/IB is in use but bandwidth is still low, check GPUDirect RDMA specifically:
   lsmod | grep -E "nvidia_peermem|nv_peer_mem"
   NCCL_DEBUG=INFO ... 2>&1 | grep -i "GPU Direct RDMA"
   Without it, every byte is copied through host memory.

4. If RDMA is on and bandwidth is still low, look at the fabric configuration: PFC and
   ECN on the switch ports, and the port speed actually negotiated:
   ibstat | grep -E "Rate|State"
   A port that negotiated a lower rate than the hardware supports is common after a
   cable or transceiver change.

5. Re-measure after each change rather than applying several at once.
patterns.resumeFrom: no checkpoint needed, this is a throughput measurement

patterns.action: Adjust NCCL_TOPO_FILE to avoid concurrent full-duplex traffic patterns that bottleneck the specific PCIe switch model.

patterns.summary: HCAs in the same cluster have wildly different firmware versions, causing incompatible protocol negotiation (e.g. dynamic routing).
patterns.action: Flash all HCAs in the cluster to a unified, qualified firmware version.

patterns.summary: Flannel UDP encapsulation overhead causing NCCL timeouts and bandwidth degradation.
patterns.action: Switch Flannel to VXLAN or Host-GW backend, or use a higher-performance CNI.

patterns.summary: GPU clocks are constrained to match other GPUs in a Sync Boost group, possibly running slower than max boost.
patterns.action: Normal behavior if sync boost is enabled. Disable if independent max boost is preferred.

patterns.summary: Custom Triton kernel entered an infinite spinlock during autotuning due to missing atomic barriers.
patterns.action: Set `TRITON_PRINT_AUTOTUNING=1` to find the failing block. Ensure cross-block atomics are surrounded by proper synchronization barriers (`tl.debug_barrier()`).

patterns.summary: DataLoader workers generated identical random seeds via fork(), causing duplicate data augmentation.
patterns.action: Use the `worker_init_fn` in your DataLoader to manually re-seed `numpy.random.seed(seed + worker_id)` and `random.seed(seed + worker_id)`.

patterns.summary: GPU Reset Initiated - A reset was triggered for the GPU (either by the driver or a monitoring daemon).
patterns.action: Check if the reset succeeded. If the reset hangs or fails, the node must be rebooted.

patterns.summary: OOMKilled Containers Without Clear Attribution
patterns.action: Map the OOM killer PID from dmesg to the container ID via cgroup paths. Set strict resources.limits.memory for all training pods.

patterns.summary: Suspected memory leak. GPU or host memory grows unbounded over time, eventually causing OOM.
patterns.action: Monitor: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv -l 5`. Set `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True`. Check for un-cleared graph histories in torch.compile. For DataLoader host leak: use `pin_memory=False` or reduce `num_workers`.

patterns.summary: Albumentations and imgaug import conflict, both modification and augmentation libraries are installed with version incompatibility in OpenCV backend.
patterns.action: Reinstall in order: `pip uninstall -y imgaug albumentations opencv-python && pip install opencv-python-headless imgaug albumentations`. Use `import albumentations as A` before `import imgaug`. Or isolate in separate environments: one for imgaug-based augmentations, one for albumentations. Pin versions: albumentations==1.3.1, imgaug==0.4.0.

patterns.summary: CNI IPAM split-brain assigned overlapping IPs to different pods, causing traffic misrouting.

patterns.summary: Case 1: Rootless podman failing due to exhausted subuid/subgid namespace mappings.
patterns.action: Update /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid to allocate more namespace ranges for the user.

patterns.summary: Case 2: Zombie processes accumulating because container init process does not reap them.
patterns.action: Run container with --init (tini/dumb-init) to properly reap zombie processes.

patterns.re: Bus error\s*\(core dumped\)|No space left on device.*variant_3.*shm
patterns.summary: Case 3: Docker shm-size exhaustion causing Bus error during DataLoader multiprocess data transfer.
patterns.action: Increase --shm-size in docker run or sizeLimit in kubernetes emptyDir volume.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: The size of tensor a .* must match the size of tensor b .* at non-singleton dimension
patterns.summary: Checkpoint shard mismatch during Fabric resumption. The checkpoint was saved with a different sharding strategy (e.g., FSDP) than the resumption strategy.
patterns.action: Ensure the `Strategy` configuration used during resumption exactly matches the one used during training.

patterns.summary: Missing optimizer states in the checkpoint, usually caused by `save_weights_only=True` being set during the initial run.
patterns.action: Remove `save_weights_only=True` from the ModelCheckpoint callback during the first run, or set `strict=False` if you only want to load weights.

requiredEvidence.re: Restoring states from the checkpoint path

patterns.summary: Pickle serialization failure due to refactoring of model class paths between checkpoint creation and resumption.
patterns.action: Avoid changing the model class structure or module paths between training runs, or use `torch.load` to manually extract and remap `state_dict` keys.

patterns.summary: OOM during FSDP checkpoint resumption with CPU offloading enabled. All shards are being loaded simultaneously into CPU memory, exhausting RAM.
patterns.action: Load the checkpoint sequentially or increase host RAM. Ensure `LightningFabric` is configured to stream weights.

patterns.re: ValueError: Checkpoint callback state .* is not valid
patterns.summary: Custom callback state was corrupted or improperly serialized during the previous checkpoint save.
patterns.action: Check the `state_dict` returned by your custom callbacks. Ensure all nested objects are picklable.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration before starting a new one
patterns.summary: DDP synchronization failure because some model parameters did not receive gradients. `find_unused_parameters` is set to False.
patterns.action: Set `strategy=DDPStrategy(find_unused_parameters=True)` in Trainer, or ensure all model outputs contribute to the loss.

patterns.re: ValueError: Invalid device placement: expected .* but found .*
patterns.summary: Manual tensor device placement conflicts with Fabric's automatic device placement. MPU (Megatron) model parallel setup mismatch.
patterns.action: Use `fabric.device` instead of hardcoding `.to('cuda:0')`. Let Fabric manage device placement.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: expected scalar type Half but found Float
patterns.summary: DeepSpeed CPU offloading failed due to mixed precision (FP16/FP32) mismatch in GELU activation layers during backward pass.
patterns.action: Ensure that parameter precision is uniformly handled or disable CPU offload for activations. Check DeepSpeed config.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: tensor does not have a device
patterns.summary: FSDP auto-wrapping policy failed to wrap some submodules, leaving uninitialized tensors on the meta device.
patterns.action: Define a custom FSDP `auto_wrap_policy` that specifically wraps the transformer block layers in your model.

patterns.re: NotImplementedError: .* is not implemented for the XLA backend
patterns.summary: A PyTorch operation used in the forward/backward pass is not supported by the XLA backend (TPU).
patterns.action: Replace the unsupported operation with an equivalent XLA-compatible op, or move that specific computation to CPU.

patterns.re: wandb.errors.CommError: It appears that you are offline
patterns.summary: WandB logger silently dropped metrics due to repeated network timeouts or proxy issues.
patterns.action: Set `WANDB_MODE=offline` to log locally and sync later, or check firewall/proxy settings.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: Cannot re-initialize CUDA in forked subprocess
patterns.summary: TensorBoard logger subprocess crashed during asynchronous write due to CUDA context initialization in a fork.
patterns.action: Set `multiprocessing.set_start_method('spawn')` at the beginning of your script.

patterns.summary: WandB internal logging queue is full. Too many metrics are being logged asynchronously at a very high frequency.
patterns.action: Reduce logging frequency using `if batch_idx % log_interval == 0:`, or batch metrics before logging.

patterns.summary: Race condition during model artifact upload in WandB. Multiple DDP ranks are trying to upload the same artifact simultaneously.
patterns.action: Ensure that model saving/logging is wrapped in `if trainer.is_global_zero:` or configure WandbLogger appropriately for DDP.

patterns.re: OSError: \[Errno 28\] No space left on device
patterns.summary: TensorBoard logger crashed because the disk is full, often causing the main training loop to hang or crash silently.
patterns.action: Clear disk space, mount a larger volume for logs, or reduce logging frequency.

patterns.summary: Checkpoint file is corrupted or incomplete, likely because the training process was killed mid-save.
patterns.action: Use the previous checkpoint or ensure atomic saves by writing to a temporary file before renaming.

patterns.summary: DeepSpeed strategy is incompatible with the chosen optimizer or learning rate scheduler.
patterns.action: Use a standard PyTorch optimizer compatible with DeepSpeed, like AdamW.

patterns.summary: WandB logger failed to initialize because the API key is missing from the environment.
patterns.action: Set the `WANDB_API_KEY` environment variable before running the script.

patterns.re: ValueError: I\/O operation on closed file.
patterns.summary: Attempted to log metrics after the TensorBoard logger's underlying SummaryWriter was closed.
patterns.action: Ensure logging only happens during the appropriate lifecycle hooks in LightningModule.

patterns.re: RuntimeError: DataLoader worker \(pid \d+\) is killed by signal: Killed.*
patterns.summary: Case 1: DataLoader fork deadlock: Subprocess killed due to implicit threading library initialization before fork.
patterns.action: Switch DataLoader multiprocessing context from 'fork' to 'spawn', or move thread initialization inside the dataset.

patterns.summary: Case 3: Multiprocessing OOM: Shared memory handles exceeded file descriptor limits, causing crash.
patterns.action: Increase ulimit -n and ulimit -u. Consider reducing num_workers or using file-system based shared memory.

patterns.re: torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate.*
patterns.summary: Case 6: CUDA Memory Fragmentation: Iterating over eval sets with dynamic shapes leads to severe block fragmentation.
patterns.action: Set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, and clear cache before eval loop.

patterns.summary: Triton compiler failed during PTX assembly due to register allocation running out of memory. This typically happens with extremely large kernels with deep loops or large block sizes.
patterns.action: Reduce block size (e.g., BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N) or limit unrolling. Set TRITON_PTXAS_EXTRA_ARGS='-warn-spills'.

patterns.summary: Triton autotuner timed out while benchmarking a kernel configuration. Often caused by an infinite loop or extremely slow configuration.
patterns.action: Reduce the search space in @triton.autotune. Check for infinite loops in kernel.

patterns.summary: Torch.compile hit the maximum cache size (default 64) due to excessive recompilations. Often caused by dynamic shapes or varying tensor types.
patterns.action: Use torch.compile(dynamic=True) or increase torch._dynamo.config.cache_size_limit.

patterns.summary: CQ overrun in libfabric, increase FI_EFA_CQ_SIZE
patterns.action: export FI_EFA_CQ_SIZE=1048576

patterns.summary: GDRCopy missing, device RDMA fallback to host
patterns.action: modprobe gdrdrv

patterns.re: EFA failed to allocate shared memory
patterns.summary: Increase /dev/shm size for EFA
patterns.action: mount -o remount,size=128G /dev/shm

patterns.summary: Memory registration failed, disable MR cache
patterns.action: export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0

patterns.summary: Exceeded EFA ENI QP limit
patterns.action: Reduce NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS

patterns.summary: EFA Tx ring full
patterns.action: export FI_EFA_TX_SIZE=4096

patterns.summary: RDMA read error over EFA
patterns.action: Disable EFA RDMA read export FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA=0

patterns.summary: Nodes in different EFA-enabled subnets without routing
patterns.action: Ensure nodes are in same subnet or use AWS Transit Gateway with EFA support

patterns.summary: High SRD retransmissions due to network congestion
patterns.action: Check network bandwidth limits and enable NCCL_ALGO=Tree

patterns.summary: NCCL EFA plugin failed to initialize
patterns.action: Reinstall aws-ofi-nccl plugin

patterns.re: Found EFA device but mapped to wrong NUMA
patterns.summary: EFA ENI mapped to wrong NUMA node
patterns.action: Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to match EFA NUMA node

patterns.summary: EFA device not exposed to container
patterns.action: Add --device /dev/infiniband/uverbs0 to docker run

patterns.summary: Incompatible libfabric and aws-ofi-nccl
patterns.action: Update libfabric to >= 1.15.2

patterns.summary: Rx buffers exhausted in OFI
patterns.action: export FI_EFA_RX_SIZE=8192

patterns.summary: EFA requires shared IPC namespace for intra-node
patterns.action: Run containers with --ipc=host

patterns.summary: Cannot bind EFA endpoint
patterns.action: Check VPC security group rules for EFA traffic

patterns.summary: Invalid memory region registration
patterns.action: Check FI_MR_CACHE settings

patterns.summary: IRSA token expired during long checkpoint
patterns.action: Increase token expiration in EKS or refresh credentials during checkpoint

patterns.summary: EKS OIDC provider does not match IAM role condition
patterns.action: Update IAM role trust policy with correct OIDC issuer URL

patterns.summary: IRSA audience in pod does not match IAM role
patterns.action: Set audience to sts.amazonaws.com in IAM role

patterns.summary: Service account not annotated with IAM role
patterns.action: Annotate Kubernetes ServiceAccount with eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn

patterns.summary: IAM role lacks S3 PutObject permissions for checkpoint bucket
patterns.action: Add S3 PutObject permission to the IRSA IAM role

patterns.summary: Pod runs as non-root and cannot read token file
patterns.action: Set fsGroup in pod security context to allow reading token

patterns.summary: Role lacks KMS permissions for SSE-KMS encrypted bucket
patterns.action: Add kms:GenerateDataKey to IAM role

patterns.summary: Cross-account IRSA needs trust relationship in target account
patterns.action: Establish IAM trust between EKS account and S3 account

patterns.summary: Pod cannot reach STS endpoint
patterns.action: Ensure VPC has internet access or VPC endpoint for STS

patterns.summary: Regional STS endpoint required but global used
patterns.action: Set AWS_STS_REGIONAL_ENDPOINTS=regional in pod env

patterns.summary: The IAM role specified in ServiceAccount does not exist
patterns.action: Create the IAM role or correct the ARN in the annotation

patterns.re: Access Denied by VPC Endpoint Policy
patterns.summary: S3 VPC endpoint policy blocks the IRSA role
patterns.action: Update S3 VPC Endpoint policy to allow the IAM role

patterns.summary: S3 Bucket policy explicitly denies the IRSA role
patterns.action: Remove Explicit Deny for the role in S3 Bucket Policy

patterns.summary: IRSA failed, falling back to node EC2 role
patterns.action: Check if AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE is correctly injected

patterns.summary: ServiceAccount projection volume not mounted
patterns.action: Restart pod to trigger ServiceAccount token volume mount

patterns.summary: Role session name exceeds 64 chars
patterns.action: Truncate pod name or override AWS_ROLE_SESSION_NAME

patterns.summary: STS API limits exceeded due to many pods starting
patterns.action: Implement exponential backoff in AWS SDK clients

patterns.summary: Spot instance received SIGTERM (reclaim 2min warning)
patterns.action: Trigger immediate synchronous checkpoint and exit

patterns.summary: No spot capacity available in AZ
patterns.action: Switch to On-Demand or different instance type in Auto Scaling Group

patterns.summary: Spot interruption notice via metadata/EventBridge
patterns.action: Handle notice and drain node gracefully

patterns.summary: Spot instance was terminated before checkpoint finished saving to S3
patterns.action: Use local NVMe for faster checkpoints, then background upload to S3

patterns.summary: Node terminated by Spot before Kubernetes gracefully cordoned it
patterns.action: Deploy AWS Node Termination Handler (NTH)

patterns.summary: A spot instance was reclaimed, causing remaining ranks to hang in NCCL
patterns.action: Enable NCCL timeout and catch exception to reload from last checkpoint

patterns.summary: ASG Capacity Rebalancing terminated the spot instance
patterns.action: Rely on NTH to intercept rebalance recommendation and checkpoint

patterns.summary: Spot price went above configured max price
patterns.action: Increase max price or remove max price constraint to use on-demand rate

patterns.summary: Spot node replaced but EBS volume still attached to old terminated node
patterns.action: Wait for EBS volume detachment or use EFS/FSx for shared checkpoints

patterns.summary: Kubelet evicted pod due to node shutdown from Spot
patterns.action: Catch SIGTERM in PyTorch script to trigger checkpoint

patterns.summary: Spot instance reclaimed while writing to FSx Lustre
patterns.action: Ensure file sync (fsync) during checkpoint and handle I/O errors

patterns.summary: NTH drain timed out before spot termination
patterns.action: Reduce checkpoint time or increase pod terminationGracePeriodSeconds (up to 120s)

patterns.summary: Hit Spot vCPU limit in AWS account
patterns.action: Request Spot vCPU quota increase in AWS Support Center

patterns.summary: Requested GPU instance not available as spot in the region
patterns.action: Use p3 or g5 instances as fallback

patterns.summary: Cannot fetch spot termination notice from IMDS
patterns.action: Ensure IMDSv2 hop limit is > 1 for containers

patterns.summary: New spot node joined with different IP, old NCCL rings broken
patterns.action: Tear down process group and re-initialize completely

patterns.re: NCCL WARN NET\/Socket : Timeout.*TCP window shrank
patterns.summary: GKE DPv2 Cilium TCP window shrinkage causing NCCL socket timeouts
patterns.action: Adjust GCP net.ipv4.tcp_window_scaling and Cilium MTU settings

patterns.summary: TCP retransmit storm over Fast Socket
patterns.action: Enable TCP selective acknowledgments (SACK) and check node network limits

patterns.summary: GKE Dataplane V2 conntrack table exhaustion dropping NCCL connections
patterns.action: Increase nf_conntrack_max on GKE nodes

patterns.summary: NIC RX queue dropping packets due to lack of CPU polling
patterns.action: Pin NCCL threads and adjust NIC RX ring buffer size

patterns.re: NCCL WARN NET\/Socket : socket closed unexpectedly.*OOM
patterns.summary: Socket closed because peer pod was OOMKilled
patterns.action: Increase memory request for peer pods

patterns.summary: TCP Keepalive failed causing stale NCCL connections
patterns.action: Adjust tcp_keepalive_time, tcp_keepalive_intvl

patterns.re: NCCL WARN NET\/Socket : Address already in use
patterns.summary: Ephemeral port exhaustion on Fast Socket
patterns.action: Increase net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range

patterns.re: NCCL WARN NET\/Socket : Message too long
patterns.summary: MTU mismatch between GKE nodes dropping large NCCL packets
patterns.action: Ensure VPC MTU and Pod MTU match (e.g. 8896 for Jumbo)

patterns.summary: Too many sockets in TIME_WAIT delaying new connections
patterns.action: Enable tcp_tw_reuse on GKE host

patterns.summary: Cilium BPF program dropping packets due to policy overflow
patterns.action: Check Cilium network policies and BPF map sizes

patterns.summary: Receiver advertised zero window, sender blocked
patterns.action: Tune receiver tcp_rmem limits

patterns.summary: Latency spike over VPC peering timing out NCCL
patterns.action: Increase NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME matching and timeout

patterns.summary: GCP physical NIC reset dropped TCP connections
patterns.action: Implement robust NCCL restart on network failure

patterns.summary: kube-proxy IPVS table overflow dropping packets
patterns.action: Increase IPVS table size or switch to iptables/DPv2

patterns.summary: Sockets stuck in FIN_WAIT2
patterns.action: Decrease tcp_fin_timeout

patterns.summary: GCP VM egress bandwidth throttling hit
patterns.action: Upgrade to higher bandwidth tier VM or use Tier 1 networking

patterns.summary: OpenvSwitch flow miss dropping packet
patterns.action: Check OVS flow cache limits

patterns.summary: GKE Workload Identity token expired during long dataset load
patterns.action: Implement token refresh loop or increase expiry

patterns.summary: urllib3 pool exhausted by many dataloader workers
patterns.action: Increase gcsfs connection pool size (GCS_MAX_CONNECTIONS)

patterns.summary: GCS sent HTTP/2 GOAWAY dropping active reads
patterns.action: Disable HTTP/2 or handle GOAWAY retries cleanly

patterns.summary: Hit GCS API rate limits per project
patterns.action: Request quota increase or add jitter/backoff

patterns.summary: kube-dns/CoreDNS timeout resolving storage.googleapis.com
patterns.action: Enable NodeLocal DNSCache in GKE

patterns.summary: SSL handshake to GCS stalled
patterns.action: Retry on SSLError and adjust connect timeout

patterns.summary: TCP connection dropped mid-chunk
patterns.action: Enable chunk retries and smaller chunk sizes

patterns.summary: Worker OOM during large GCS chunk decompression
patterns.action: Reduce GCS block_size in gcsfs config

patterns.summary: Transient GCS backend errors
patterns.action: Increase max_retries on the gcsfs client

patterns.summary: GCP VM egress bandwidth limit reached pulling data
patterns.action: Use local SSD caching or upgrade network tier

patterns.summary: Cloud NAT port exhaustion for outbound GCS traffic
patterns.action: Assign more IPs to Cloud NAT or use Private Google Access

patterns.summary: Local file cache for gcsfs corrupted
patterns.action: Clear fsspec cache and disable local caching if concurrent

patterns.summary: Timeout listing directory with millions of files
patterns.action: Use prefix filtering or reorganize bucket into smaller prefixes

patterns.summary: TCP reset from Google Frontend (GFE)
patterns.action: Implement robust exponential backoff on ConnectionError

patterns.summary: File overwritten during read
patterns.action: Ensure immutable objects or handle versioning

patterns.summary: Workload Identity lacks storage.objectViewer
patterns.action: Grant Storage Object Viewer IAM role to GSA

patterns.summary: Reading GCS bucket from wrong region
patterns.action: Move GCS bucket to same region as GKE cluster

patterns.summary: PyTorch ignored SIGTERM, job hung instead of aborting
patterns.action: Add explicit SIGTERM handler to abort training gracefully

patterns.summary: Node preempted, peers hanging waiting for collective
patterns.action: Set TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 (single canonical name since PyTorch 2.2)

patterns.summary: Pod killed before state could be saved
patterns.action: Increase terminationGracePeriodSeconds to allow checkpoint save

patterns.summary: Preempted node caused Ray cluster to wait for long heartbeat timeout
patterns.action: Reduce RAY_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT

patterns.summary: Preempted node didn't send FIN, peers stuck on TCP read
patterns.action: Enable TCP keepalives on NCCL sockets (NCCL_TCP_KEEPALIVE)

patterns.summary: GPU driver wedged during shutdown, preventing clean exit
patterns.action: Force kill processes on SIGTERM

patterns.summary: Preemption killed node mid-checkpoint write
patterns.action: Use atomic checkpoint writes (write to tmp then rename)

patterns.summary: FSDP missing shard from preempted node
patterns.action: Ensure checkpoints are fully synced before confirming

patterns.summary: GCS upload of checkpoint interrupted by preemption
patterns.action: Use multipart uploads with resume capability

patterns.summary: Preemption of master node caused split brain
patterns.action: Ensure robust leader election timeouts

patterns.summary: Wandb/Tensorboard metrics lost on preemption
patterns.action: Flush metrics synchronously on SIGTERM

patterns.summary: DLRover auto-recovery failed to detect preemption quickly
patterns.action: Tune DLRover node failure detection interval

patterns.summary: RDMA QPs hung because peer disappeared silently
patterns.action: Enable RDMA connection timeouts

patterns.summary: Kubelet marks node NotReady too slowly on preemption event
patterns.action: Consume GCP preemption metadata server events directly

patterns.summary: PDB prevented graceful eviction, hard killed later
patterns.action: Review PDB configurations for preemption tolerance

patterns.summary: Data on local SSD lost on preemption
patterns.action: Checkpoint to persistent storage (GCS) instead

patterns.summary: libbitsandbytes_cpu.so instead of cuda due to LD_LIBRARY_PATH shadows conda cuda
patterns.action: Check LD_LIBRARY_PATH in slurm batch script

patterns.summary: NaN loss in double quant due to fp16 used instead of bf16
patterns.action: Use bf16 for QLoRA

patterns.summary: CUDA OOM paging due to Pageable memory allocation failed
patterns.action: Use pinned memory for bitsandbytes

patterns.summary: Rank 0 loads CUDA, Rank 1 loads CPU fallback due to Heterogeneous nodes or environment discrepancy
patterns.action: Ensure homogeneous environment across nodes

patterns.summary: [TOR_A] PFC deadlock detected across Tor switches causing transmission halt (Case 0)
patterns.action: Enable PFC watchdog and tune queue mappings

patterns.summary: [TOR_B] ECN threshold too high leading to buffer overflow instead of congestion notification (Case 1)
patterns.action: Lower switch ECN min-threshold to 150KB

patterns.summary: [Spine_1] Receiver not ready errors exhausted retry limit (Case 2)
patterns.action: Increase RNR retry count or tune receiver processing speed

patterns.summary: [Spine_2] CNP packets being dropped leading to uncontrolled transmission and PFC storm (Case 3)
patterns.action: Ensure QoS policy classifies CNP (DSCP 48) to lossless queue

patterns.summary: [NIC_0] MTU mismatch between endpoints causing RDMA fragmentation failure (Case 4)
patterns.action: Align MTU settings across all HCAs and switches to 4096

patterns.summary: [NIC_1] Asymmetric ECMP routing causing out of order RDMA packets (Case 5)
patterns.action: Configure flowlet switching or symmetric hashing on spine

patterns.summary: [HCA_2] PFC watchdog timer too aggressive, dropping valid traffic (Case 6)
patterns.action: Increase PFC watchdog timeout to 500ms

patterns.summary: [HCA_3] Traffic mapped to lossy queue due to missing VLAN priority tag (Case 7)
patterns.action: Ensure egress traffic sets 802.1p PCP=3 for RoCE

patterns.summary: [Switch_Core] Physical layer corruption causing RoCE ICRC failures (Case 8)
patterns.action: Replace faulty optical transceiver or cable on HCA port

patterns.summary: [HCA_1] Q_Key mismatch on RoCE multicast group (Case 9)
patterns.action: Synchronize RDMA Q_Key across all participating ranks

patterns.summary: K8s GPU device plugin crash due to OOM on plugin pod variant 0
patterns.action: Restart node, reset NVML, or apply specific tolerations

patterns.summary: Advanced edge case 1: Liquid Cooling Pump Failure in distributed training
patterns.action: Isolate node, restart job from checkpoint

patterns.summary: Advanced edge case 2: PCIe Bus Error in distributed training
patterns.action: Isolate node, restart job from checkpoint

patterns.summary: Advanced edge case 5: CXL Memory Poison Event in distributed training
patterns.action: Isolate node, restart job from checkpoint

patterns.re: NeuronCore Error: XLA compilation failed on Trn1 core 1.*
patterns.summary: AWS Trainium Neuron compiler crashed due to ring buffer allocation on core 1.
patterns.action: Set NEURON_RT_NUM_CORES properly and recompile with neuron-cc.

requiredEvidence.re: ERR Neuron compiler failed to allocate Ring Buffer 1

patterns.re: ResourceExhaustedError: Out of memory while trying to allocate 500MB on TPU_0.*
patterns.summary: Google TPU XLA HBM OOM due to collective topology mismatch on 1 slices.
patterns.action: Adjust XLA_FLAGS='--xla_gpu_memory_limit_slop_factor' and decrease batch size.

patterns.summary: NCCL CUPTI profiling hook causing CUDA stream synchronization deadlock during profiling.
patterns.action: Disable CUPTI profiling or upgrade PyTorch Profiler/NCCL.

patterns.summary: Slurm srun forwarding SIGINT instead of SIGTERM, causing PyTorch distributed to hang instead of exiting cleanly.
patterns.action: Use scancel --signal=TERM to ensure clean teardown of NCCL groups.

patterns.summary: CSI snapshot triggering filesystem freeze during heavy IO, causing job timeouts.
patterns.action: Schedule volume snapshots during checkpoint idle periods, not during active training.

patterns.summary: InfiniBand NIC exhausted Memory Translation Table (MTT) entries during RDMA buffer registration.
patterns.action: Increase MTT limit via `options mlx5_core log_num_mtt=24` in `/etc/modprobe.d/`, or coalesce RDMA buffers into fewer, larger blocks.

patterns.re: Call to NCCL failed, unhandled system error|Transport endpoint is not connected
patterns.summary: NCCL System Error - Socket disconnection or catastrophic daemon failure during a collective operation.
patterns.action: Check for OOM kills (`dmesg -T | grep -i oom`) of the training process, or a severe network partition. Often caused by transient host-level issues rather than GPU errors.

patterns.summary: NCCL Fabric Degradation - High packet loss or congestion is forcing NCCL to retransmit, reducing effective bandwidth.
patterns.action: Check RoCE PFC/ECN counters or InfiniBand symbol errors. Ensure adaptive routing (AR) is enabled on the switch if using IB.

patterns.re: DataLoader worker.*killed by signal|Caught TimeoutError in DataLoader|deadlock.*num_workers
patterns.summary: DataLoader Deadlock - PyTorch DataLoader workers are deadlocked, starving the GPUs of input data.
patterns.action: Reduce `num_workers` in the DataLoader. If using pin_memory=True, ensure you are not exhausting host RAM. Check for bad IPC/shared memory limits (`--shm-size`).

patterns.summary: RoCE MTU Mismatch - Packets are being dropped because the node MTU exceeds the switch MTU.
patterns.action: Ensure Jumbo Frames are enabled end-to-end. Match `ifconfig` MTU (typically 9000) with the switch port MTU.

patterns.summary: Parallel File System Error - Storage cluster (Lustre/GPFS) is rejecting I/O, often causing node-level D-state hangs.
patterns.action: Verify filesystem health and mount status. If read-only, check the underlying storage array. Node reboot often required to clear D-state hangs.

patterns.summary: CPU Soft Lockup - A CPU core is stuck executing kernel code and cannot schedule other tasks.
patterns.action: Node reboot is required. Check if this happens concurrently with GPUDirect RDMA or heavy storage I/O, which can overwhelm the kernel.

patterns.summary: GPU ECC fault (Xid 48/94/95, double-bit/uncorrectable ECC, or row-remap event) caused the CUDA/runtime failure. The CUDA error is downstream hardware fallout, not the root cause.
patterns.action: Drain the affected node/GPU first. Confirm with `dmesg -T | grep -iE "xid|nvrm|ecc"` and `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,ROW_REMAPPER,PAGE_RETIREMENT`; reset/reboot before rejoining, and RMA if double-bit ECC or row-remaps recur.

patterns.summary: ZeRO-3 NVMe-offload checkpoint race: ranks write the same directory.
patterns.action: Upgrade DeepSpeed to a version using per-rank checkpoint subdirectories; clear stale offloaded_tensors/ between runs.

patterns.re: Got completion with error 12.*vendor err 129|completion with error 12.*vendor_err 129
patterns.summary: RoCE MTU mismatch between NIC and switch causing RDMA QP fatal errors.
patterns.action: Set MTU to 4096 on both NICs and switch ports (sudo ip link set dev ib0 mtu 4096); set NCCL_IB_RETRY_CNT=7 and NCCL_IB_TIMEOUT=22.
